2181.business_summary: Persol Holdings Co.,Ltd. provides human resource services under the PERSOL brand worldwide. It operates through five segments: Staffing, Business Process Outsourcing, Technology, Career, and Asia Pacific. The company offers temporary job placement and staffing, and other services for clerical work and technology; support services for permanent placement, recruitment media, direct recruiting, and others; and outsourcing for contact center, sales and marketing, design and development, prototyping, evaluation, and testing IT Software development, etc. It also provides professional consulting, technology implementation support, and digital solutions incubation services. The company was formerly known as Temp Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Persol Holdings Co.,Ltd. in July 2017. Persol Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

2183.business_summary: Linical Co., Ltd., a global contract research organization provides full spectrum of drug development services to pharmaceutical companies worldwide. The company offers drug development consulting services, such as market analysis of products in development, regulatory affairs, and licensing support. It also provides clinical research and development, and contract medical affairs services, including front-end services comprising project management, monitoring, quality control, vendor management, auditing, and clinical research secretariats; and back-end services, which include data management, bio statistical analysis, medical writing, pharmacovigilance, and medical management. It provides technical information, such as user manuals, AR manuals, data structuring, and XML editor; personnel development solutions, including training events, staff manuals, training programs, and virtual work experiences; process improvement solutions, such as knowledge transfer and management, process improvement, document management, and RPA applications; and marketing strategy, such as web/video, VR, and AR content, as well as event activation. The company also offers various services, such as ATOM knowledge, AR tools, VR showroom, Hiyari Hatto VR, AI contact, AI contents search, MaaS business development, multiplay VR, VR prototyping, AR repair manual, workplace kaizen, VR content, automotive business development, and total printing, Kaizen farm, Raku Raku aiming, as well as knowledge master. It also provides firmware and device drivers for digital cameras, video and signage, televisions, liquid-crystal projectors, various recorders, switchers, digital complex machines, laser and ink-jet printers, sublimation and label printers, scanners, handy terminals, and embedded browsers. In addition, the company offers application software, such as video editing and delivery, poster creation supporting, document and print management, and car navigation software, as well as graphic library and various simulators; and Web application services for answering machines, portal sites, medical information transmission systems, and various internal systems, as well as employment support for schools. Further, the company provides hardware products, which include image filter, display, and analysis circuits, as well as various arithmetic circuits. Sobal Corporation was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

218A.business_summary: Liberaware Co., Ltd. engage in the development, processing and analysis technologies provide small drones specialized for industrial fields system using IoT technology and artificial intelligence. It also provides Cookpad News, an online cooking magazine; and Tabemiru, an analytical tool that accumulates recipe search data. The company was formerly known as Coin Ltd. and changed its name to Cookpad Inc. in June 1999. Cookpad Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Meguro, Japan.

2195.name: AMITA HOLDINGS CO LTD

It also provides Co-Creation City, a sustainable urban development service; and environmental certification audit services based on third-party certification systems. In addition, the company supplies alternative resources to cement manufacturers as alternative raw materials and fuels for cement; and imports and export of alternative resources. The company is involved in operation of paid nursing homes and provision of nursing care services; provision of services, such as planning and management for wedding ceremonies, and receptions; planning, development, and sales of wedding favors, sweets, and other gift items; and providing services, comprising planning and operation of photo weddings, and photo studios. The company was formerly known as IKK Inc. and changed its name to IKK Holdings Inc. in May 2021. IKK Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Imari, Japan.

The company's lead product is HS-001 for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction indications, including dilated cardiomyopathy, old myocardial infraction, and dilated phase of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. It also develops products using autologous iPSC and HLA knock-out iPSC. In addition, the company offers differentiation induction, mass culture, purification, and myocardial globule production technology. 2204.name: NAKAMURAYA CO LTD
2204.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2204.business_summary: Nakamuraya Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various Japanese sweets and Western sweets, bread, and other food products in Japan. The company produces and sells health-related products, retort food, ice cream, milk, dairy products, western confectioneries, chocolate, biscuits, wheat protein, modified starch, coloring, fine chemical materials and others. It also provides baby formula and processed foods. It sells its products in offices and stores, as well as through e-commerce. 2212.business_summary: Yamazaki Baking Co., Ltd. engages in the food business in Japan. The company operates through Food Business, Distribution Business, and Other Business segments. 2264.name: MORINAGA MILK INDUSTRY CO
2264.business_summary: Morinaga Milk Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of various dairy products in Japan and internationally. The company offers milk products, including homogenized, sterilized whole, and enriched milk; beverages comprising milk-based, coffee, chilled tea, and various other beverages; Greek, fruit, and various other yogurt products; chilled desserts, such as baked, milk, and low carb pudding; and ice cream products. It also provides cheese and butter; infant formula and baby food products; milk powder, milk supplements, and bifidobacterium longum BB536 capsule; liquid diet and nursing care food products; and other products, including creaming powder, condensed milk, and tofu. The company was formerly known as Nippon Rennyu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Morinaga Milk Industry Co., Ltd. in 1949. Morinaga Milk Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2266.name: ROKKO BUTTER CO
2266.business_summary: Rokko Butter Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells cheese and other food products under the QBB and EMINA brand names in Japan. The company offers cheese, nuts, desserts, and chocolate products. The company was formerly known as peace Oil Industries Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Rokko Butter Co., Ltd. in July 1954. Rokko Butter Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

2267.name: YAKULT HONSHA CO
2267.business_summary: Yakult Honsha Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells food and beverage products in Japan, the Americas, Asia, Oceania, and Europe. The company operates through Food and Beverages (Japan), Food and Beverages (The Americas), Food and Beverages (Asia and Oceania), Food and Beverages (Europe), and Others segments. It offers fermented milk drinks, energy drinks and fermented fruit beverage, plant-derived ingredients, juices, noodles, etc. through its home delivery and retail store channels. The company also provides pharmaceutical products; offers cosmetics; and operates the Tokyo Yakult Swallows, a professional baseball team. The company was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2268.name: BR 31 ICE CREAM CO.LTD
2268.name_from_universe: Ｂ－Ｒ　サーティワン　アイスクリーム
2268.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2268.business_summary: B-R 31 Ice Cream Co.,Ltd. manufactures, imports, exports, and sells ice cream and related products in Japan. It also offers ice cream shop franchise development, product supply, and management services. It sells its products through ice cream specialty stores. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2269.name: MEIJI HOLDINGS CO LTD
2269.name_from_universe: 明治ホールディングス
2269.business_summary: Meiji Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of dairy products, confectionery food products and pharmaceuticals in Japan and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Food and Pharmaceuticals. The Food segment provides yogurt, milk, beverages, cheese, butter, margarine, cream, ice cream, prepared food, chocolate, gummy candy, sports nutrition, infant milk, liquid food, beauty products, feed, sugar, and corn sweeteners. The Pharmaceutical segment offers drugs for infectious and central nervous system disorders, vaccines, blood plasma products, generic drugs, and animal health products. Meiji Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

226A.name: KATSU MI JAPAN INC
226A.business_summary: Katsu Mi Japan Inc. engages in the production, import, and sale of frozen vegetable and food products. The company offers frozen steamed vegetables and cooked frozen food products for medical meals. It serves hospitals, elderly care facilities, central kitchens, food service contractors, food wholesalers, and food manufacturers. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2270.name: MEGMILK SNOW BRAND CO.LTD
2270.business_summary: MEGMILK SNOW BRAND Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells milk, milk products, and other food products in Japan and internationally. It operates through Dairy Products, Beverages & Desserts, and Feedstuffs & Seed segments. The company offers processed and natural cheese, condensed and skim milk, butter, powdered milk, and margarine; nutrition products, including infant formula and functional food; and other products. It also provides milk and milk beverages, yogurt, fruit and vegetable juice, soft drinks, and desserts; and infant formula and functional food. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacture and sale of cattle feed, and pasture forage/crop and vegetable seeds; landscaping business; and distribution center services, real estate rental, and other businesses. MEGMILK SNOW BRAND Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

227A.name: INSIGHT LAB  INC.
227A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他

It operates TERASU, a data solution platform; MatoMeru for organizing scattered data; KakeDashi that supports DX promotion; KizuKi for visualizing data; +One that solves practical problem through data and cutting-edge technology; and CON PASS, a DX consulting solution. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2281.name: PRIMA MEAT PACKERS
2281.business_summary: Prima Meat Packers, Ltd. produces and markets hams and sausages, meats, processed foods, and other products in Japan. It is involved in processed foods, fresh meat, and hog farming business. The company also manufactures products for convenience stores, as well as sell its products through online stores. Prima Meat Packers, Ltd. was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2282.name: NH FOODS LTD
2282.business_summary: NH Foods Ltd. engages in manufacturing and selling ham, sausage, processed food, meat, and dairy product in Japan and internationally. It operates through Processed Foods Business Division and the Fresh Meat Business Division. The Processed Foods Business division offers ham and sausages under the SCHAU ESSEN brand; and Chinese food meal kits under the Chuka Meisai brand; chilled pizza under the Ishigama Kobo brand; and other meat product under the Hokkaido Carl Ramon and Kamakura Ham Tomioka brands. This segment also provides dairy products, such as cheese and yogurt products. The Fresh Meats Business division is involved in the production and raising, slaughtering, processing, distribution, and sale of fresh meat product. The company also engages in the operation of a football club, baseball club, and ballpark. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Nippon Meat Packers Inc. and changed its name to NH Foods Ltd. in June 2014. NH Foods Ltd. was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

2286.name: HAYASHIKANE SANGYO CO
2286.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2286.business_summary: Hayashikane Sangyo Co.,Ltd. produces and sells food products in Japan. The company operates through Food Business and Feed Business segments. It offers fish meat products, fish hams and sausages, and functional foods, as well as fish and livestock feed. In addition, the company engages in information processing, refrigerated warehouse, and real estate related activities. Hayashikane Sangyo Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Shimonoseki, Japan.

2288.name: MARUDAI FOOD CO
2288.business_summary: Marudai Food Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells hams and sausages, cooked processed food, and meat products in Japan and internationally. It operates through Processed Meat Products, Meat Products, and Other segments. The company offers hams and sausages, including wiener; prosciutto; grilled pork; frank; hamburger seal and meatballs; ham; bacon; sausage; and fish and meat products. It also provides processed food products, such as chicken side dishes, Korean food ingredients, cooking soup sauce, curry, meat side dishes, frozen side dishes, frozen food, and snack products. The company offers its products through mass retailers and restaurants. Marudai Food Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Takatsuki, Japan.

228A.name: OPRO CO LTD
228A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他

The company offers Report DX, a cloud report service; Kamiles, an electronic application service for financial and government agencies; Agent files, a document distribution platform; kintone, a kintone linked report service; docutus, a monday.com linked report output app; Peppol, an international digital invoice standard; Opro Arts, a report function embedding service; and Docutone. It also provides Soask, which provides subscription business management services; and Monosuku, a subscription business management service for goods. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

2291.name: FUKUTOME MEAT PACKERS
2291.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

It also manages restaurants and meat prepared food retail stores. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

2292.name: S FOODS INC
2292.business_summary: S Foods Inc., a meat company, engages in manufacture, wholesaling, retailing, and food servicing of meat-related food products in Japan. It offers products under the Kotechan brand; and seasonal and standard products. The company was formerly known as Stamina Foods Inc. and changed its name to S Foods Inc. in August 2000. S Foods Inc. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Nishinomiya, Japan.

2293.name: TAKIZAWA HAM CO
2293.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

It is involved in the processing of beef and pork business. In addition, the company manufactures and sells retort and prepared food; and expansion of meat shops. The company was formerly known as Takizawa Takashi Shoten Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Takizawa Ham Co., Ltd. in 1966. The company was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Tochigi, Japan.

2294.name: KAKIYASU HONTEN
2294.business_summary: Kakiyasu Honten Co., Ltd., a food company, engages in production and sale of meat, prepared foods, Japanese sweets primarily in Japan. The company offers meat, such as beef, pork, and chicken under the Mie Kakinoyasu beef and Premium Agu brand names; western and Chinese style delicatessen; Japanese confectioneries, including Ohagi and mitarashi dango through a network of stores; and processed food products. It also operates Japanese and Chinese buffet style restaurants. Kakiyasu Honten Co., Ltd. was founded in 1871 and is headquartered in Kuwana, Japan.

2296.name: ITOHAM YONEKYU HOLDINGS INC
2296.name_from_universe: 伊藤ハム米久ホールディングス
2296.business_summary: Itoham Yonekyu Holdings Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of processed meat and processed/precooked food products in Japan. The company operates in two segments: Processed Food Division and Meat Division. It offers ham, sausages, cooked, and processed foods products. The company was founded in 1928 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

229A.name: ASUMI HD INC
229A.name_from_universe: アスミホールディングス
229A.business_summary: Asumi HD Inc. engages in the construction business. It is involved in the railway-related construction works, including demolition, temporary construction, soil and concrete, and ground improvement works; and manufacture and sale of concrete masonry and lamination blocks for riverside housing construction, as well as custom-made concrete products for roads. The company also focuses on the port construction business; and construction works for net fences and foundation concrete. In addition, it operates a baseball team. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Kobe, Japan.

2300.name: KYOKUTO CO LTD
2300.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2300.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2300.business_summary: Kyokuto Co., Ltd. engages in home cleaning business in Japan. The company involved in the dry cleaning and laundry business; and sale of promotional items, including detergent to distributors and semi-direct stores. It also provides ozone and aqua dry, water repellent protects cats, setup line, insect proofing, stain removal processing, and sneaker cleaning services. Kyokuto Co., Ltd. was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

2301.name: GAKUJO CO LTD
2301.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2301.business_summary: Gakujo Co., Ltd. engages in the employment information business. It offers job information, corporate PR, and information services, as well as recruitment consulting, recruitment, and temporary staffing services. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

2303.name: DAWN CORP
2303.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2303.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2303.business_summary: Dawn Corp. engages in the development and maintenance of various safety and security cloud services in Japan. It provides NET119, a cloud emergency call services; Live110 and Live119, a video reporting system; DMaCS, a disaster information sharing service; AED GO, an AED transportation support system; mailio, a message delivery service; and Town Guidance Town Development Map, an Internet public map service. In addition, it provides systems related to geographic information; and license sales of software for the construction of geographic information systems. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

2304.name: CSS HOLDINGS LTD
2304.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2304.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2304.business_summary: CSS Holdings,Ltd. provides steward management services in Japan. The company also offers dishwashing and management services primarily for hotels and restaurants; and engages in contract management of cafeteria and restaurants, as well as restaurant business. It also designs, constructs, sells, and maintains video, audio, broadcasting, and security related space production services. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2305.name: STUDIO ALICE
2305.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2305.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2305.business_summary: STUDIO ALICE Co.,Ltd. operates children's photo studios in Japan. It operates through Photography Business and Clothes Manufacturing & Wholesale Business segments. The Photography Business segment engages in taking, producing, processing, displaying, and printing photographs. The Clothes Manufacturing and Wholesale Business segment is involved in manufacturing and selling clothing for photography. The company also manufactures and sells printed products. STUDIO ALICE Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

2307.name: CROSS CAT CO LTD
2307.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2307.business_summary: Cross Cat Co., Ltd. engages in information services and related operations in Japan. The company offers digital transformation services, including CC-BizMate, which provides data collection and attendance management cloud services; CC-Dash AI, which offers data utilization and analysis, AI utilization consulting services, and PoC services; CC-MicView, which provides data utilization and analysis management dashboard construction support services; CC-Dash, which offers business intelligence (BI) system maintenance and operation services; and CC-SmartReservation, a conference booking system. It also provides system integration services for credit, banking, corporate, insurance, and public institutions, as well as staffing services. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

2311.name: EPCO CO LTD
2311.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2311.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2311.business_summary: EPCO Co.,Ltd. provides design services for housing and renewable energy facilities in Japan. The company offers various design services, such as water supply and drainage equipment design, electrical equipment design, energy-saving equipment design, rain gutter design, housing equipment design, standardization support, design and application assistance support, and implementation support. It also provides layout diagrams for solar panels and prepares application drawings for EV chargers and renewable energy services and maintenance services, such as inbound tourism, inside sales, back office, construction company support, and application and video content for support. In addition, the company engages in the design, planning, proposal, and construction work related to energy saving of new and existing houses; construction work related to solar power generation systems, storage batteries, and other electric equipment; design and maintenance services for solar power generation systems for overseas; call center operation and customer information management work; and contract services for water supply and drainage equipment design and electrical equipment design. EPCO Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Sumida, Japan.

2315.name: CAICA DIGITAL INC
2315.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2315.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2315.business_summary: CAICA DIGITAL Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology services in Japan. The company offers system development, system consulting, and system maintenance and support; and management and support services. It is also involved in the research, development, consulting, and sale of cryptocurrency-related systems; operation of corporate support platforms and related system development; sale of software; website planning, production, and management services; investment and management of cryptocurrency; and operation of NFT sales offices. In addition, the company engages in the development and sale of communication equipment using various wireless methods; and media business that provides crypto asset-related content. The company was formerly known as CAICA Inc. and changed its name to CAICA DIGITAL Inc. in November 2021. CAICA DIGITAL Inc. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2317.name: SYSTENA CORPORATION
2317.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2317.business_summary: Systena Corporation engages in the solution and framework design, IT service, business solution, and cloud businesses in Japan. The company operates through Solution Design, Next Generation Mobility, Framework Design, IT & DX Service, Business Solution, and DX & Subscription segments. It engages in planning, design, development, and verification support for various products and telecommunications carrier services; provision verification support for internet businesses, business applications, web services, social infrastructure-related systems, IOT, artificial intelligence, and robotics-related services; provision of engineering and in-house services, such as MaaS for the automotive industry; and development of core systems for life and non-life insurance, and banking. The company is also involved in the provision of IT outsourcing services, including IT project promotion/PMO, DX support, system construction and operation, data entry, large-volume output, software testing, and DX verification; sale of servers, computers, peripherals, software, and other IT-related products to enterprises; provision of services related to IT equipment that includes building infrastructure and virtualization, as well as planning, development, and provision of product implementation services, such as RPA and business intelligence tools. In addition, the company provides in-house services Canbus., Canbus.IoT, Cloudstep, and Web Shelter services; and implementation support of cloud-based services such as Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. Systena Corporation was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2321.name: SOFTFRONT HOLDINGS
2321.name_from_universe: ソフトフロントホールディングス
2321.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2321.business_summary: Softfront Holdings provides communication software services in Japan. It is involved in the development and sale of products and services related to real-time communication using voice, video, messaging, and related commissioned development, as well as brokerage sale of IT solutions. The company offers commubo, a natural conversation AI platform that uses voice robots instead of humans; telmee, a cloud-based telephone business automation service; and SITE PUBLIS, a content management system for website management. In addition, it engages in the planning, development, and sale of web-based products and services; website construction; and the provision of utilization support services. The company was formerly known as Softfront Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Softfront Holdings in August 2016. Softfront Holdings was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

2323.name: FONFUN CORPORATION
2323.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2323.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2323.business_summary: fonfun corporation provides content information services for internet-enabled mobile phones. It operates through two segments, Cloud Solutions Business and DX Solutions Business. The Cloud Solutions Business segment engages in planning, developing, and providing various cloud-based services, applications, and software that facilitate smooth communication, improve business efficiency, and provide diverse information access to corporate and individual customers. SMS solution, Voice solutions, Food tech solutions, employee benefit solution, and remote solutions. The DX Solutions Business segment engages in planning, developing, and providing solutions and software that promote digitalization of various business. It also offers business system development, development track record, process management, SMS distribution infrastructure, chat tools, email distribution infrastructure, etc. The company was formerly known as Net Village Co., Ltd. and changed its name to fonfun corporation in October 2006. fonfun corporation was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. fonfun corporation is a subsidiary of CYBRiDGE GROUP CORPORATION.

2325.name: NJS CO. LTD
2325.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2325.business_summary: NJS Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, primarily engages in water and environmental consulting, digital transformation, and customer services business in Japan and internationally. The company provides community and environmental solutions, including global environmental, water environment, urban development, and disaster prevention and mitigation solutions; infrastructure solutions comprising survey and planning of water supply and sewerage system, pipeline, treatment plant, infrastructure management, and management consulting; and survey and planning, infrastructure development, and operational capacity building support services. It also offers software, system construction and operation services, infrastructure management services, disaster prevention and mitigation, business operations, and AI utilization system; develops drones, robotics, sensors, and data analysis used for inspection; and customer service, such as information dissemination, customer relations, and communication services. The company was formerly known as Nippon Jogesuido Sekkei Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NJS Co., Ltd. in April 2015. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2326.name: DIGITAL ARTS INC
2326.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2326.business_summary: Digital Arts Inc. develops and markets internet security software and appliances in Japan, the United States, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. The company offers i-FILTER, a web security product; m-FILTER, a mail security product; D-SPA, a secure proxy appliance; FinalCode, a file encryption and tracking solution; DigitalArts@Cloud, a cloud security product that covers web browsing, email, and files; Desk, a chat/online conference tool; f-FILTER, a data protection and transfer solution; and StartIN, a single sign-on ID and ID management solution. It also provides security consulting services. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2327.name: NS SOLUTIONS CORPORATION
2327.name_from_universe: 日鉄ソリューションズ
2327.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2327.business_summary: NS Solutions Corporation provides information technology solutions in Japan and internationally. The company offers business and information system consultation services; and plans, designs, develops, implements, operates, and maintains information systems. It develops, manufactures, sells, and rents software and hardware related to information systems; and provides outsourcing services using information technology. In addition, the company offers data center and cloud computing, ERP, management visualization, system integration and workflow, and production and sales management solutions, as well as IT infrastructure and global expansion support services. It serves manufacturing, retail, distribution, transportation, finance, telecommunication, and government sectors. The company was formerly known as Nippon Steel Information and Communication Systems Inc. and changed its name to NS Solutions Corporation in 2001. NS Solutions Corporation was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. NS Solutions Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Nippon Steel Corporation.

2329.name: TOHOKUSHINSHA FILM CORPORATION
2329.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2329.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2329.business_summary: Tohokushinsha Film Corporation operates as media business company in Japan. It operates through Advertising Production, Content Production, Media, and Properties segments. The company develops and produces feature films and drama series for television; animations and games; and dubbing/subtitling activities. It is also involved in the commercial and promotion planning/production, creative agency, broadcasting and streaming, localization, and licensing and merchandising services; digital production; sale of video equipment; import of fabrics for interiors; and production of sake. Tohokushinsha Film Corporation was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2330.name: FORSIDE CO LTD
2330.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2330.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2330.business_summary: Forside Co.,Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in prize, content, event, master rights, AI-related, and logistics-related businesses in Japan. The company involved in the planning, manufacturing, and selling of prizes for crane games and other prize games; operates Mobibook, an e-book distribution site; and publishing business. It also exhibits and sells famous content at event venues in commercial facilities. In addition, the company engages in the development of business tools; sale of GPU servers; general freight trucking and freight forwarding businesses; human resources services; and provision of temporary staffing, contract work, IT solutions, and transportation services, as well as act as a sales agent. The company was formerly known as SmartEbook.com Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Forside Co., Ltd. in April 2015. Forside Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2331.name: ALSOK CO LTD
2331.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2331.business_summary: Alsok Co.,Ltd. engages in the electronic, stationed, and transportation security services in Japan and internationally. The company offers home security systems and services, such as housework contracting and safety confirmation services for senior citizens; stalker countermeasures for women; and long-term care services. It also provides various systems for corporate customers, including online security systems, electronic security systems, condominium complex security systems, and automated management system for ATMs, as well as security systems for supporting schedule management at unmanned stores and other buildings; and damage insurance policies. The company was formerly known as Dormant Company Pine Co., Ltd. and changed its name to System Location Co.,Ltd. in July 1992. It issues Town News, a local information paper and selling advertising space on local politics, economy, society, culture, sports, and other topics. It also publishes commemorative magazines, various printed materials, and engages in operation of website and video production. In addition, it provides Political village, database of politicians in the newspaper's publishing area; RareA, neighborhood information site; and Town News for LINE, distribution service. Further, it engages in the regional production and public private partnership projects. Townnews-Sha Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

2483.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他

The company offers translation for patent documents comprising application-related, court-related, and others; and medical documents, including basic research/non-clinical development, clinical development, regulatory submission, and post-marketing. It also provides financial and legal translations comprising finance, legal, disclosure and related documents, and corporate and other documents; and translation services for IT related documents and manuals documents. In addition, the company offers translation of industrial documents, such as R&D, planning, and design documents; production, quality assurance, implementation, and maintenance service documents; sales and marketing documents; and non-manufacturing industry related documents. Further, it provides medical writing, grammar check, transcription, staffing, multilingual contact center, proofreading and back translation, and foreign patent application services, as well as services related to computer games, e-learning, and Websites; and prepares drawings. Additionally, the company offers translation services for VISA application documents required to apply for marriage, work, residency, study abroad, and other visas; and DTP, printing, document, and e-book translation related services, as well as pamphlets and catalogues, press releases and newsletters, and presentation documents. The company serves clients in a range of industries, such as auto, mechanical, electronics, pharma, patent, law, finance, R&D, education, and other fields. Honyaku Center Inc. was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

The Digital Innovation Business segment provides a human resource development solution service that provides LearningBooster, a learning data utilization platform for IT engineers; security service that provides solutions to counter internal threats to companies; and DX development service that supports the promotion of DX in companies. The ICT Business segment offers ICT system design, construction, operation and maintenance services for ICT systems. The Life Science Business segment provides maintenance services for medical equipment, chemical analyzers, etc.; consulting services for overseas medical equipment manufacturers; and ICT services in the life signs sectors. It also provides BtoB Platform Negotiations for Matching sellers, food wholesalers, restaurants, and other businesses with buyers; V-Manage to digitally manage store operations and management task; AI-OCR (invox), an AI OCR processes and digitizes faxes, emails, and PDF purchase orders; BP Workflow to digitizing internal approval and application procedures; electronic bill early payment that convert pending invoices into cash; BtoB Platform Quotation which centralized and digitized receipt and quotation; BtoB platform industry channel, an industry information portal site that streamlines sales and planning operations; Menu Plus, digitize your restaurant's menu management; Kauri Kessai, streamline processes, such as credit checks for business partners, payment collection, and payment reconciliation; BtoB platform order placement; and BtoB eSmart, a commercial food ingredients, supplies, and materials site.
