265A.business_summary: Hmcomm Inc. develops products using voice recognition processing, abnormal sound detection, and natural language analysis processing. The company provides AI utilization consulting solutions. It also promotes cybernics business related to sound, such as information technology, artificial intelligence, and robotics. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2664.name: CAWACHI LIMITED
2664.business_summary: Cawachi Limited manages drugstores in Japan. It is involved in retail and insurance dispensing of medicines, medical-related products, health foods, childcare products, cosmetics, daily necessities, general foods, confectionery. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Oyama, Japan.

2666.name: AUTOWAVE CO LTD
2666.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2666.business_summary: AUTOWAVE Co., Ltd. engages in the sales of automobile supplies and related services in Japan. The company offers tires and wheels, vehicle inspection and maintenance, sheet metal and scratch repair, oil changes, regular replacement parts, battery, and other car supplies. It also offers car navigation, rear monitor, backup camera, and terrestrial digital tuner. In addition, the company sells and installs speakers, woofers, and power amplifiers. Further, it provides body coat, car film, window glass water repellent coat, wheel coat, headlight coat, and safety products, as well as purchases and sells new and used cars. AUTOWAVE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.

2667.name: IMAGEONE CO LTD
2667.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2667.business_summary: ImageONE Co., Ltd. provides healthcare and global environmental business solutions in Japan. The company's Healthcare Solutions Business segment sells medical image storage, distribution, and display systems, ultrasound image reporting systems, cloud-based electronic medical record systems, nuclear medicine dose management systems, medical gloves, PCR detection reagents, antigen test kits, etc., as well as remote image diagnosis and other businesses. The Global Environmental Solutions Business segment sells automatic orthomosaic and 3D processing software for UAV-captured images, etc. It offers medical systems, such as medical software and EHR/EMR, as well as PACS medical image storage, distribution, and display systems; medical supplies, medical gloves, and PCR and antigen test kits; CTs, MRIs, x-rays, and mobile medical trucks; and clinical management support services. The company also provides solar panels and wind turbines; and GEO mapping, GIS solution, and UAV capability services, as well as distributes and reuses EV batteries. In addition, it offers tritium separation technology; tritium continuous measurement; radiation tolerant cameras; viDocRTKrover, a measurement tool that uses tablet terminals; and 3D image processing software for use in construction, civil engineering, and surveying sites. The company serves companies, hospitals, medical institutions, government agencies, and power companies. ImageONE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

2668.name: TABIO CORPORATION
2668.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2668.business_summary: Tabio Corporation plans, manufactures, wholesales, and retails socks. The company offers five finger, plain, ankle, crew, high, over knee high, and parts socks; foot covers and cover socks; tights; short, wedding, and all-through stockings; and sports socks comprising running, golf, soccer and futsal, and yoga socks, as well as leg warmers. It also provides health/beauty socks, including inner, pressure, and cold socks, as well as socks for swelling, foot fatigue, foot odor, shoe slip, and sleep measures; leggings and spats; and fresher, ceremonial occasion, suit casual, and long shoe socks. The company offers its products through a chain of franchised and directly managed stores. Tabio Corporation was formerly known as DAN Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tabio Corporation in September 2006. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

2669.name: KANEMI CO LTD
2669.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2669.business_summary: Kanemi Co., Ltd. operates retail stores in Japan. The company operates through Tenant Business and Retail segments. The Tenant Business segment operates food stores in supermarkets, department stores, station buildings, and inside train stations. The Retail segment is involved in the production of bento boxes, rice balls, pastas, sushi, and other prepared foods for convenience stores. Kanemi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

266A.name: GLOCAL MARKETING CO LTD
266A.name_from_universe: グローカルマーケティング
266A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
266A.business_summary:
Glocal Marketing Co., Ltd. engages in marketing support, and human resource recruitment and development support businesses in Japan. The company offers marketing and sales consulting, seminars and training, marketing research, SNS utilization support, Google ads, SNS advertising operation support, and press release creation support services; photography, video production, flyer, pamphlet, etc. design production; customer management system and implementation support services. It also provides strategy design support seminars and
training support for formulating personnel evaluation systems; and drafting and creating a DX promotion roadmap AI, implementation consulting, and groupware implementation consulting service, as well as planning and implementation of events for child-rearing families. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Nagaoka, Japan.

2670.name: ABC-MART INC
2670.name_from_universe: エービーシー・マート
2670.business_summary: ABC-Mart,Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the retailing of shoes, clothing, and general merchandise products for men, women, and kids in Japan. It develops and manufactures shoes; and licenses various brands. The company is also involved in the sale of owned and purchased products through ABC-MART stores. In addition, it provides sneakers, sports, business, loafers, casual, outdoor, sandals, pumps, rain boots, working, socks, bag, cap, sunglasses, accessories, wear, shoe care, shoelace, and insoles. The company offers its products under the VANS, HAWKINS, Saucony, NUOVO, DANNER, SPERRY, WHITE'S BOOTS, and byA brand names. It operates various stores in Hokkaido, Tohoku, Tokyo, Kanto, Kansai, Chugoku and Shikoku, Kyushu and Okinawa, as well as South Korea, Taiwan, Vietnam, and the United States. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2673.name: YUMEMITSUKETAI CO LTD
2673.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2673.business_summary: YUMEMITSUKETAI Co.,Ltd. engages in the value-added mail order business in Japan. It offers fashion accessories, men's apparel, women's fashion, household goods, AV equipment, car accessories, healing goods, business and stationery, as well as beauty, health, food, golf, and hobby products through its own catalogs and website. The company is also involved in the real estate business; and elderly care business. YUMEMITSUKETAI Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

2674.name: HARD OFF CORPORATION CO LTD
2674.name_from_universe: ハードオフコーポレーション
2674.business_summary: Hard Off Corporation Co.,Ltd. operates reuse shops in Japan. It operates through Reuse Business and FC Business segments. The company's shops offer TVs, audio and video products, computers, games, watches, cameras, smartphones, tablets, sets and power tools, and musical instruments; CDs, DVDs, and vinyl records; furniture and interior, and home appliances; women, men, and kids and baby clothing; shoes, bags, accessories, and towels; gold and platinum jewelry; fashion accessories; sports goods and camping outdoors; gifts and toys; trading cards, figures, mini cars and railroad models, plastic models, radio control products, and gun military goods; car audio, seats, car parts, tire and wheel products, and bicycles; books, comics, novels, and magazines; and wine, champagne, brandy, whiskey, beer, sake, and shochu products, as well as glasses and sake cups. It operates its shops under the Hard Off, Off House, Hobby Off, Garage Off, Mode Off, Liquor Off, Book ON, and Book Off brand names. It also operates directly operated and franchised stores. The company was formerly known as Sound Hokuetsu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hard Off Corporation Co.,Ltd. in 1995. Hard Off Corporation Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Shibata, Japan.

2676.name: TAKACHIHO KOHEKI CO
2676.business_summary: Takachiho Koheki Co.,Ltd. operates as a technology trading company in Japan. It offers mechanical component products, including slide rails, cable guides, conston springs, dampers, gas springs, lifting and cylinder lock systems, monitor arms, and other mechanical components; and semiconductor products, such as communication devices, power modules and devices, sensors, connectors, trans, coils, and GPU boards. The company also provides retail security products comprising electronic article surveillance, display product security, image surveillance, image analysis, store management, and remote monitoring systems, as well as source tagging labels; and business solution products consisting of WAN/LAN and network security products, as well as office security products, such as access control and properties removal management systems, and IP solutions/IP cameras/NVR systems. In addition, it offers video sensing cloud service, estimation for male and female customers, shelf browsing time service, and IQ Lane, a checkout service; and support, maintenance, operation and management, installation, and tuning solutions. The company was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

2678.name: ASKUL CORP
2678.business_summary: ASKUL Corporation engages in e-commerce business in Japan. The company operates ASKUL, a website for small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as SOLOEL ARENA, a website for mid-tier and larger companies that provides office supplies, living supplies, furniture, general medical, pharmaceuticals, and medical equipment products. It also provides various services comprising make printed materials, such as business cards, envelopes, stamps, and personalized novelty goods; office coordinate services; and support services on an e-commerce website where customers can get advice by professional staffs, as well as sells SaaS, communication tools, and seminars for beginners. In addition, the company sells maintenance, repair, and operation supplies; provision of purchase solutions for large companies, and e-commerce website of professional items for dentists; and engages in agent business. Further, it is involved in the operation of e-commerce site for pet and gardening products; provision of logistics and small-cargo transportation, product storage, warehouse management, and delivery services for manufacturers and direct-order companies; and produces and sells bottled natural mineral water. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

267A.name: TOWARISE CORPORATION
267A.business_summary: Towarise Corporation engages in the credit business in Japan. The company offers individual and comprehensive credit purchase intermediation, cashing, various consumer loans, and financial institution affiliated loan guarantees. It also sells computers and mobile phones; and rents buildings, as well as offers software development and network consulting services. Further, the company provides transaction services, such as factoring and payroll payment services. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Yonago, Japan.

2681.name: GEO HOLDINGS CORP
2681.name_from_universe: ゲオホールディングス
2681.business_summary: Geo Holdings Corporation engages in the operation of various used and new product stores in Japan. The company operates 2nd STREET, a store that buys and sells fashion items, furniture, household electrical appliances, and daily necessities; OKURA, a store for luxury products procured from commercial auctioneers through e-commerce and online auctions; Luck Rack, an off-price store for second-hand goods; GEO, a store that offers amusement products; and Mobile, an outlet that provides smartphones, tablets, earphones, smartwatches, SIM cards, and other smartphone peripherals. It is also involved in the development of a platform that consists of digital content, as well as production and sale of content; operation of amusement facility; wholesale and trading of fashion and lifestyle goods; and system development activities. In addition, the company operates Pleasure, a store that purchases used agricultural machinery; Kotaro, a store that purchases antiques and paintings; 2nd STORAGE, a self-storage service with free home pick-up and delivery; and GEO Are Kore Rental, a rental service for cameras, smartphones, home appliances, and other items. Geo Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

2683.name: UOKI CO LTD
2683.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2683.business_summary: Uoki Co.,Ltd. engages in the retail sale of seafood in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Fresh Fish Business, Food and Beverage Business, and Real Estate Business. The Fresh Fish Business segment offers fresh fish, sushi, and prepared foods. The Food and Beverage Business segment operates conveyor belt sushi restaurants. The Real Estate Business segment manages operates, and rents supermarkets. The company operates 38 fresh fish retail stores and 7 restaurants. The company was formerly known as K.K. Uoki Suisan and changed its name to Uoki Co.,Ltd. in 1990. Uoki Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Fujisawa, Japan.

2685.name: AND ST HD CO LTD
2685.business_summary: and ST HD Co.,Ltd. plans, produces, and retails clothes and sundry goods in Japan and internationally. The company offers women's, men's, and kid's clothing products; and household products under various brands. It also operates restaurants and stores; and engages in the resale business, such as disposal inventory and sample products, as well as licensing business for casual wear. and ST HD Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Adastria Co., Ltd. and changed its name to and ST HD Co.,Ltd. in September 2025. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2686.name: GFOOT CO.LTD
2686.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2686.business_summary: Gfoot Co.,Ltd. sells footwear in Japan. It provides men's shoes, ladies' shoes, sports shoes, and imported goods. The company was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2687.name: CVS BAY AREA INC
2687.name_from_universe: シー・ヴイ・エス・ベイエリア
2687.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2687.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2687.business_summary: CVS Bay Area Inc. engages in apartment front desk service business in Japan. The company operates through Hotel, Apartment Reception Service, Cleaning Service, Convenience Store Business, and Other segments. It operates business and unit hotels under the BAY HOTEL brand name. The company also provides cleaning referral service centered on the contracted service of apartment front desk services for apartment residents, management associations, and management companies; lifestyle support services for residents, such as managing cafes and shops, and planning and hosting events; and undertakes reception duties. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of cleaning services for clothes and curtains in educational institutions, and sheets and uniforms in hotels and other accommodation facilities, as well as house cleaning and clothing storage and individual delivery services; linen supply service for corporations that handles sheets and uniforms for hotels and other accommodation facilities; operates Lawson stores that provides retail sales of fast food, such as rice, side dishes, and other foods and daily necessities, as well as the collection and payment of utility bills. Further, it engages in the operation of hair cutting salons; real estate rental business; and provision of support for development and rebranding of existing facilities. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.

2689.name: OLBA HEALTHCARE HLDGS INC
2689.name_from_universe: オルバヘルスケアホールディングス
2689.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2689.business_summary: OLBA HEALTHCARE HOLDINGS, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a distributor of medical equipment and pharmaceuticals in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Medical Equipment Business, Specialty Product Delivery (SPD) Business, and Nursing Care Products Business. The Medical Equipment Business segment engages in the wholesale of medical equipment comprising artificial joints, coronary stents, steel instruments, osteosynthesis materials made of metal and ceramics, ultrasonic scalpels, and pacemakers and catheters related to examination, diagnosis, and treatment of the heart and blood vessels; X-ray fluoroscopy and CT equipment for tumor and embolism treatment, and endoscopes for cancer treatment; and diagnostic imaging equipment, such as MRI and CT to ventilators, and intraoperative monitors, as well as operating room equipment, including shadowless lights. This segment also offers reagents and equipment for genetic research, cell culture, and protein analysis; automatic analyzers for biochemical, immunological, and blood; and test reagents, as well as undertakes services for DNA analysis in the field of life sciences. The Specialty Product Delivery (SPD) Business segment provides inventory management, medical material masters and data analysis, and purchase management services. The Nursing Care Products Business segment engages in the sale and rental of nursing care equipment; the sale of welfare equipment, such as portable toilets and bathing chairs; and home renovation works, as well as provides nursing care services. The company was formerly known as Kawanishi Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to OLBA HEALTHCARE HOLDINGS, Inc. in January 2021. OLBA HEALTHCARE HOLDINGS, Inc. was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

268A.name: RIGAKU HOLDINGS CORPORATION
268A.name_from_universe: リガク・ホールディングス
268A.business_summary: Rigaku Holdings Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of scientific equipment in Japan, the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company offers multipurpose analytical instruments, such as X-ray diffraction equipment, X-ray fluorescence, and X-ray imaging; semiconductor process control equipment, including semiconductor X-ray inspection and X-ray transmission equipment; and product-related warranty, repairs, maintenance, relocation, and other products. Its products are used in life science, academia, semiconductor electronic device, battery, and other applications. The company was founded in 1951 and is based in Akishima, Japan.

2692.name: ITOCHU SHOKUHIN CO
2692.business_summary: ITOCHU-SHOKUHIN Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale of food products and alcoholic beverages in Japan. The company sells processed foods and alcoholic beverages, imported products, health products, and gifts; and develops and sells frozen side dishes and sweets, and cakes. It is also involved in the logistics management, storage, transportation, and distribution merchandising businesses; and provision of goods information services, as well as engages in the retail business. The company was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. ITOCHU-SHOKUHIN Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of ITOCHU Corporation.

2693.name: YKT CORPORATION
2693.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2693.business_summary: YKT Corporation, a machinery trading company, imports and exports machine tools, industrial machinery, measuring instruments, and electronic equipment in Japan and internationally. The company provides products for tool, parts, die and mold, medical parts, and machine machinery, as well as lifestyle/infrastructure, surface treatment, measurement, and after-sales services. It also offers dimensional and geometry measurement, inclination measurement, and inspection equipment; electronic component mounting, semiconductor packaging, and digital assembly; and peripheral devices for tool grinders, turning machines, and machining centers. YKT Corporation was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2694.name: YAKINIKU SAKAI HOLDINGS INC
2694.name_from_universe: 焼肉坂井ホールディングス
2694.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2694.business_summary: Yakiniku Sakai Holdings Inc. operates in the food service industry in Japan. The company engages in the restaurant business, operating a variety of dining establishments, including yakiniku restaurants under the brands Nikusho Sakai and Yakinikuya Sakai, sushi restaurants under the Heiroku Sushi brand, izakaya restaurants such as Toriaezu Gohei and Murasara, as well as fast food restaurants including Omuraisutei and Nagasaki Chanmen; and franchise and food processing businesses, as well as business revitalization consulting business. The company was formerly known as G.taste Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Yakiniku Sakai Holdings Inc. in July 2021. Yakiniku Sakai Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

2695.name: KURA SUSHI INC
2695.business_summary: Kura Sushi, Inc. operates a chain of managed conveyor-belt sushi restaurants in Japan, North America, and Asia. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

2698.name: CAN DO CO LTD
2698.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2698.business_summary: Can Do Co., Ltd. operates a chain of retail stores in Japan. It offers daily necessities and processed food products through managed stores. The company is also involved in the wholesale business to franchisees. Can Do Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

269A.name: SAPEET INC
269A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
269A.business_summary: Sapeet Inc. provides artificial intelligence (AI) solutions and products in Japan. The company's services include sales AI agent construction service, generative AI consulting/development support, planning and support for store DX and OMO measures, DX support for customer service standardization, AI posture and motion analysis, and new business support in the healthcare and wellness fields. It also offers Culticloud, a cloud service that streamlines communication between business owners and their customers. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2700.name: KITOKU SHINRYO CO
2700.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2700.business_summary: Kitoku Shinryo Co., Ltd. engages in the procurement, processing, sale, and import/export of rice and rice products, animal feed, hen's eggs in Japan and internationally. The company operates through the Rice Business, Feed Business, Egg Business, and Food Business segments. It provides commercially polished rice, household polished rice, brown rice, minimum-access and processed rice; feed and feed ingredients; eggs for home and commercial use; processed eggs; rice flour, processed foods, protein-adjusted rice, and wheat flour; and corn oil. Kitoku Shinryo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2702.name: MCDONALD'S HOLDINGS COMPANY(JAP
2702.name_from_universe: 日本マクドナルドホールディングス
2702.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2702.business_summary: McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), Ltd. owns and operates hamburger restaurant chain under the McDonald's brand in Japan. The company was formerly known as Japan McDonald's K.K. and changed its name to McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), Ltd. in July 2002. McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), Ltd. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2705.name: OOTOYA HOLDINGS CO LTD
2705.name_from_universe: 大戸屋ホールディングス
2705.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2705.business_summary: OOTOYA Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, plans, manages, and operates a chain of restaurants in Japan and internationally. Its restaurants offer set meals and boxed lunches. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

2708.name: KUZE CO LTD
2708.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2708.business_summary: Kuze Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the food wholesale business for food service industries in Japan and internationally. It offers commercial ingredients and materials, such as dressing base, Italian prosciutto slice, crispy sheep intestine pork wiener, beer germanwurst, pan au specialty, pain au segle, pan aux noiresans, rolled egg, grated radishes, smoked salmon slices, scrambled eggs, sauces, pork cutlets, kinpei burdock, potato salad, pate de campagne, beef steak slice, beef burger patty, beef hamburger, radish and bamboo shoots, boiled radish and carrot soup stock, extra virgin olive oil, tempura flour, hakata mentaiko barako, fried chicken thighs, wheat fragrant baguette, shredded cheese, white miso, oil-free dressing Japanese style ginger, and grated onion dressing under the Kuze brand. The company also provides chiffon cakes, baked cakes, pound chocolate, danjou, shortcakes, roll cakes, mousses, mousse cakes, sponge sheets, ice creams, beans, whipping creams, coffee powder, and rice flour under the Dolceze brand name; and commercial wraps, paper towels, cooking sheets and papers, aluminum foil, alcohol spray bottle, neutral detergent, sterilizer / bleach, liquid detergent, dishwasher rinse, and hand soap. It distributes its products to hotels, halls, restaurants, pubs, fast food restaurants, catering, delicatessens and side dishes, and in-flight meal services. In addition, it proposes menus and offers products through catalog-sales system. Kuze Co., Ltd. was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Toshima, Japan.

271A.name: ACCELIA INC
271A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
271A.business_summary: Accelia, Inc. operates as a Content Distribution Service (CDS), offering Internet infrastructure and technologies required for distribution of Internet data. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2721.name: J-HOLDINGS CORP
2721.name_from_universe: ジェイホールディングス
2721.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2721.business_summary: J-Holdings Corp. engages in the sports business. It operates real estate tech platform and provides web business, energy, environmental solutions business, regenerative medicine-related business, and solar business services. The company also operates two futsal facilities: Football Park Higashiyamada in Kanagawa Prefecture and Futsal Court Tsukashin in Hyogo Prefecture; and engages in the school management business. J-Holdings Corp. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2722.name: IK HOLDINGS CO LTD
2722.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2722.business_summary: IK HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd., together with its subsiadiries, engages in the direct marketing, sales marketing, and IT solution businesses in Japan. The company sells miscellaneous goods and foods, as well as cosmetics through TV shopping, internet shopping, and brick-and-mortar stores. It sells its cosmetic products under the hince, fillimilli, CAREPLUS, AROMATICA, BRAYE, klrairs, and SKINFOOD brands. The company also operates wholesale business to consumer cooperatives, mail order companies, retail stores, and overseas companies. In addition, it sells chat systems and voice call recording systems. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

2726.name: PAL GROUP HOLDINGS CO LTD
2726.name_from_universe: パルグループホールディングス
2726.business_summary: PAL GROUP Holdings CO., LTD. engages in the planning, manufacture, wholesale, and retail of clothing products, including men's and women's clothing and accessories in Japan. The company was formerly known as Pal Co., Ltd. and changed its name to PAL GROUP Holdings CO., LTD. in September 2016. PAL GROUP Holdings CO., LTD. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

2730.name: EDION CORP
2730.business_summary: EDION Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a home appliance retailer in Japan. It also sells personal computer, printer, multifunction device, various office equipment, projectors, video conferencing systems, office lighting products, commercial air conditioners, digital camera drive and recorder drones, ceremony, event prizes, souvenirs, smartphone/IP phone, and routers; and operates mobile shop. The company engages in the robot programming education, energy management system, real estate brokerage, photovoltaic power generation systems, renovation and housing related businesses, as well as operates as a communication Internet service provider. It operates home electronics stores under the EDION brands; and EDION net shop, an online shop; and franchised stores. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

2733.name: ARATA CORPORATION
2733.business_summary: Arata Corporation engages in the wholesale of daily goods, cosmetics, household goods, pet supplies, and others in Japan. The company offers health and beauty products, including cosmetics, hair and body care, oral care, pharmaceuticals, and health foods; household detergents, such as clothing detergents, home-related cleaners, and dishwashing and kitchen detergents; home care products, including insecticides, air fresheners and Recording media and deodorizers, lighting supplies, electrical application products, OA supplies, photo-related products, and batteries; paper products, which include tissues, toilet paper, and disposable diapers; and household goods comprising Kitchen consumables, toiletries, cleaning supplies, storage supplies, seasonal products, preservation supplies, cooking supplies, tabletop supplies, vacation supplies. It is also involved in the retail, wholesale, and import/export sale of pets, and pet food and accessories, as well as sells pet-related products online; pet styling and grooming activities; recruiting of franchised stores; and store management activities, as well as research and development of pet shop franchise systems; operation of pet hotels; and manufacturing and sale of cosmetics. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2734.name: SALA CORPORATION
2734.name_from_universe: サーラコーポレーション
2734.business_summary: SALA Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the energy supply and solution business in Japan. The company operates through Energy & Solutions Business, Engineering & Maintenance Business, Housing Business, Car Life Support Business, Animal Health Care Business, and Property Business segments. It provides natural gas and LP gas/petroleum products; sells heat and electricity; and generates biomass power, as well as engages in the transportation of gas and petroleum, and delivery services for private homes. The company also engages in the water delivery, renovation, and cultural lectures and cooking classes businesses. In addition, it develops social infrastructure facilities, including office buildings, hospitals, schools, condominiums, parks, roads, bridges, and harbor facilities; manufactures and sells construction materials; offers infrastructure maintenance services to urban functions, such as gas, water supply/sewage, civil engineering, paving, and harbor construction; and provides integrated services comprising electric, air conditioning, and plumbing design, as well as construction and maintenance. Further, the company engages in the system development business for various industries, including factories and universities; develops houses; operates automobile dealerships; provides automobile inspection and maintenance services; and sells pet pharmaceuticals, as well as provides dietetic treatment for unwell or obese animals for recovery and health management. Additionally, it operates restaurants under the SHISEN HANTEN and XIÈ XIÈ names; and hotels and sports clubs, as well as offers real estate leasing and brokerage services. The company also provides various insurance/financing products and credit cards; and manufactures electronic equipment for automobiles and motorcycles. SALA Corporation was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Toyohashi, Japan.

2735.name: WATTS CO LTD
2735.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2735.business_summary: Watts Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale and retail business of daily necessities and miscellaneous goods in Japan and internationally. The company's product categories include cosmetics; hygiene, medical, and nursing care products; baby products; clothing; clothing accessories; bath and toiletries; toilet supplies; laundry supplies; kitchen supplies; home and living supplies; cleaning supplies; interior products; storage items; stationery and office supplies; hobbies and entertainment; toys and games; camping and outdoor equipment; electrical appliances and digital products; events and seasons; and handmade and craft supplies. The company also operates its stores under the Watts, 100 YEN SHOP FLET's, Buona Vita, Tokino:ne, Real, Komonokaen, Komonoya, Value 100, and Nippan brands. In addition, it offers its products through online. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

2736.name: FESTARIA HOLDINGS CO LTD
2736.name_from_universe: フェスタリアホールディングス
2736.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2736.business_summary: Festaria Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing, processing, and sale of jewelry and accessories through department stores and shopping malls in Japan. It also imports its products. The company was formerly known as SADAMATSU Company Limited and changed its name to Festaria Holdings Co., Ltd. in March 2018. Festaria Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2737.name: TOMEN DEVICES CORPORATION
2737.business_summary: Tomen Devices Corporation engages in the trading of semiconductors and electronic components in Japan and internationally. It offers memory semiconductors, including dynamic random access memory (DRAM), flash memory, solid state drive (SSD), and multi chip packages (MPC) and embedded MPCs (eMPCs); system LSI semiconductors comprising system on a chip (SoC) and application specific integrated circuit (ASIC), display drive IC, and CMOS image sensors; display products, such as liquid crystal display (LCD) and organic light emitting diode (OLED); and LEDs and multi-layered ceramic capacitors. The company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Tomen Devices Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Toyota Tsusho Corporation.

273A.name: SBI ASSET MANAGEMENT CO LTD SBI
273A.name_from_universe: ＳＢＩ　サウジアラビア株式上場投信

2742.name: HALOWS CO LTD
2742.business_summary: Halows Co.,Ltd. operates a network of food supermarket stores in Hiroshima, Okayama, Kagawa, Ehime, Tokushima, Hyogo, Yamaguchi of Japan. The company was formerly known as Fuchu Supermarket Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Halows Co.,Ltd. in March 1988. Halows Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Tsukubo, Japan.

2747.name: HOKUYU LUCKY CO.LTD.
2747.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2747.business_summary: Hokuyu Lucky Co.,Ltd. operates a supermarket in Japan. Its supermarket offers fresh and general food, family clothing, and daily necessities. Hokuyu Lucky Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

2749.name: JP-HOLDINGS INC
2749.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
2749.business_summary: Jp-Holdings,Inc. provides childcare support services in Japan. The company is involved in the operation of child-rearing support facilities, such as nursey schools, after-school clubs, and children's centers, as well as community centers; and development and provision of programs comprising English, gymnastics, rhythmic, dance, and early childhood learning programs. It also engages in the provision of meals for child-rearing support facilities, and advisory services regarding meals; conduction of training and research on childcare and child development; and planning and sale of childcare-related products, such as toy shelves and picture book shelves. In addition, it operates Kodomel, a child-rearing support platform; engages in consignment of food service; provides contract training for child development to corporations and local governments; and manages real estate. Further, the company is involved in food education activities. Jp-Holdings,Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

274A.name: GARDEN CO LTD
274A.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
274A.business_summary: Garden Co., Ltd. owns and operates restaurants in Southeast Asia. It also operates franchise stores. The company operates through Ichikakuya and Yamashita Honki Udon brands. Garden Co., Ltd. was founded in 2015 and is based in Shinjuku, Japan.

2750.name: S. ISHIMITSU & CO LTD
2750.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2750.business_summary: S.Ishimitsu & Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture, processing, import, and sale of coffee, tea, alcoholic beverages, and foodstuffs in Japan and internationally. It also exports and sells alcoholic beverages, food products, and confectionery products. The company handles coffee green beans, regular coffee, instant coffee, black tea for drinks; packaged products, including coffee and tea; canned fruits and vegetables; western food products, such as pasta and olive oil, and frozen foods; chicken related products; and seafoods comprising shrimps, squid, octopus, and others. It also imports and sells fresh vegetables and processed agricultural products to food manufacturers, cut vegetable suppliers, restaurant chains, mass retailers, etc. In addition, the company engages in the provision of Japanese ingredients, such as seasonings, processed foods, sake, shochu, marine products, sweets, alcoholic beverages, and other luxury goods. The company was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

2751.name: TENPOS HOLDINGS CO LTD
2751.name_from_universe: テンポスホールディングス
2751.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2751.business_summary: TENPOS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. operates kitchenware and equipment stores in Japan. The company provides designing, constructing, and management services for kitchen; and information and services for restaurant management; interior construction contracting; and financing services, such as leasing and credit. It also offers new and recycled cooking utensils, tableware, chairs, tables, kitchen equipment, etc.; and financing activities, such as sales of order entry systems, sales promotion consulting, temporary staffing, and M&A introductions, as well as operates restaurants and develop franchisees. The company was formerly known as Tenpos Busters Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TENPOS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. in November 2017. TENPOS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2752.name: FUJIO FOOD GROUP INC
2752.name_from_universe: フジオフードグループ本社
2752.business_summary: Fujio Food Group Inc. operates various types of restaurants and restaurant franchise chains in Japan and internationally. The company operates restaurants under the Maidoookini Shokudo, Kushiya Monogatari, Kappogi, and Tsurumaru Udon brands, as well as Tenzura Ebinoya, Tarte & Cafe Delice, Coffee Shop Pinocchio, Fujioken, SAM'S, Mountain Man, and other sub-brands. Fujio Food Group Inc. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

2753.name: AMIYAKI TEI CO LTD
2753.business_summary: Amiyaki Tei Co., Ltd. operates a chain of restaurants under Amiyakitei brand name in Japan. Amiyaki Tei Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Kasugai, Japan.

2760.name: TOKYO ELECTRON DEVICE
2760.name_from_universe: 東京エレクトロン　デバイス
2760.business_summary: Tokyo Electron Device Limited, a technology trading company, engages in the electronic components and computer networks businesses worldwide. It designs, develops, and distributes semiconductor products, boards, software, and other electronic components. The company provides microprocessors, DSPs, memory ICs, ASICs, FPGAs, PLDs, security applications, peripheral LSIs, image processors, telecom applications, wireless ICs, sensor ICs, AD/DA,s logic ICs (and interfaces), clock/timing ICs, analog ICs/power supply ICs, inductors/discrete devices, telecom/network applications, RF/microwave applications, optical devices, other products. It also offers software solutions/electronic components, including operating systems, BIOSs, development tools, RTOSs, CPU and media processor boards, interface and communication boards, evaluation boards, panel PCs, LCDs/plasma panels, power supplies, connectors, IC sockets, storage devices, measuring instruments, and energy harvesting and other products. In addition, the company provides network solutions, such as datacenter/campus switches, load balancers, DHCP/DNS appliances, VPN appliances, and others; and storage solutions comprising SAN fabric switches, data protection, data storage, hyper-converged infrastructure, and other products; and security solutions consisting of firewalls, DNSSEC, SSL, CASB, and other products. Tokyo Electron Device Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

2762.name: SANKO MARKETING FOODS CO
2762.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2762.business_summary: Sanko Marketing Foods Co., Ltd. engages in the operation and management of restaurant and fishery business in Japan. The company engages in retail and wholesale of fresh fish, seafood, and marine products; and engages in disinfection, sterilization, and cleaning of retail stores. It also operates food and beverage facilities and offers alcoholic drinks and side dishes. In addition, the company engages in contract management of restaurants and cafeterias in government offices, hot spring facilities, etc. Further, it engages in brokerage and agency business. The company was formerly known as Sanko Foods Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sanko Marketing Foods Co., Ltd. in October 2002. Sanko Marketing Foods Co., Ltd. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

2763.name: FTGROUP CO LTD
2763.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2763.business_summary: FTGroup Co., Ltd. engages in the network infrastructure business in Japan. The company operates as a retail electricity supplier and provide its electricity services Fene Denki and FT Denki; rent and sale the water-saving device under the JET brand; act as an intermediary for the sale of water servers; sale, installation, and after-sales services for appliances and office automation equipment, as well as air conditioning equipment, LED lighting, and air purifiers; and sale and installation of solar power generation equipment and storage batteries. It also provides optical internet service under the Hikari Hayatoku brand; network security products, file servers, security products, information, and communication equipment for small and medium-sized businesses and individual business owners. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. FTGroup Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Hikari Tsushin, Inc.

2764.name: HIRAMATSU INC
2764.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2764.business_summary: Hiramatsu Inc. operates and manages cafes, restaurants, and hotels in Japan. It also plans and manages weddings. The company was formerly known as Hiramatsu-Tei Ltd. and changed its name to Hiramatsu Inc. in December 1994. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2767.name: TSUBURAYA FIELDS HOLDINGS INC
2767.name_from_universe: 円谷フィールズホールディングス
2767.business_summary: Tsuburaya Fields Holdings Inc. engages in the content-related businesses in Japan. The company plans, develops, manufactures, sells, and maintains pachinko/pachislot (PS) machines. It is also involved in the planning and development of software for PS machines; management and operation of a fitness gyms; provision of information services through the Internet; and planning and production of computer graphics, etc. In addition, the company engages in the planning and production of movie/TV; and planning, production, and sale of character goods. Further, it manages, leases, and trades in real estate assets. Tsuburaya Fields Holdings Inc. was formerly known as Fields Corporation and changed its name to Tsuburaya Fields Holdings Inc. in October 2022. Tsuburaya Fields Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2768.name: SOJITZ CORPORATION
2768.business_summary: Sojitz Corporation operates as a general trading company worldwide. The company operates through Automotive; Aerospace, Transportation & Infrastructure; Energy Solutions & Healthcare; Metals, Mineral Resources & Recycling; Chemicals; Consumer Industry & Agriculture Business; Retail & Consumer Service; and Others segments. It is involved in the assembly and sale of automobiles, auto-financing business, and parts quality assurance business; operation as an authorized dealer for premium brand vehicles; commercial aircraft, defense, and related equipment agency and sales activities; business jets, used aircraft, and parts out businesses; transportation, airport, port, and other social infrastructure projects; and marine, healthcare, renewable energy, gas-fired power plant, energy conservation, nuclear power related, ICT infrastructure project, and industrial and urban infrastructure park businesses, as well as steel-related and resource recycling businesses. The company also offers cloud and network services; industrial machinery, bearings, and automobile and motorcycle parts; organic, inorganic, functional, and fine chemicals; industrial salt, and healthcare and natural products; rare earths, resins, packaging materials, advanced films, plastic molding machines, and other plastic products; liquid crystals, electrolytic copper foils, printed circuit board electronics materials, and fiber materials and products; and coal, iron ore, ferroalloys, ores, alumina, aluminum, copper, zinc, precious metals, ceramics and minerals, coke, and carbon products. It engages in developing operations in the fields of agribusiness, foodstuffs, animal feed, livestock, and forest products; retail and consumer businesses comprising food distribution, aquaculture and livestock, shopping center management, consumer goods distribution, and real estate activities, as well as offers logistics and insurance services. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2769.name: VILLAGE VANGUARD CO LTD
2769.name_from_universe: ヴィレッジヴァンガードコーポレーション
2769.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2769.business_summary: Village Vanguard CO.,LTD., together with its subsidiaries, retails books, miscellaneous goods, CDs, DVDs, food, and apparel in Japan. It sells its products through stores, pop-ups, and online stores. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

276A.name: CCREB ADVISORS INC
276A.name_from_universe: ククレブ・アドバイザーズ
276A.business_summary: CCReB Advisors Inc. provides corporate real estate (CRE) solution in Japan. It develops real estate tech systems to support businesses, such as real estate investment, real estate buying and selling, rental brokerage, consulting, and project management. The company also offers CCReB GATEWAY, a B2B portal site that provides the latest management trends and essential information for corporate management; CCReB AI, a CRE sales support system; CCReB CREMa, a commercial real estate matching system; CCReB PROP, a fixed asset data extraction tool; CCReB Clip, an information support tool that creates target lists based on computer disclosure documents, including prospect lists, market statistics, and other analytical datasets; CCReB BI, a real estate research tool; and CCChat, a chat system utilizing generative AI. CCReB Advisors Inc. was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2776.name: SHINTO HOLDINGS INC
2776.name_from_universe: 新都ホールディングス
2776.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2776.business_summary: SHINTO Holdings, Inc. engages in trading business. It operates through Retail Business, Apparel Business, and Real Estate-Related Services business segment. The company offers casual wear, and cut-and-sew products, including T-shirts and sweatshirts products; real estate properties and brokerage business services; and import and export transaction services, which includes polyethylene terephthalate, etc.; and recycled plastic products. The company is also involved in metal recycling business; real estate related services business; domestic sales and leasing of GPU equipment; operation and management of AI data centers; sales, import, and export of daily necessities, alcoholic beverages, etc.; and industrial waste disposal business. The company was formerly known as Crymson Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Shinto Holdings, Inc. in October 2017. Shinto Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2778.name: PALEMO HOLDINGS CO LTD
2778.name_from_universe: パレモ・ホールディングス
2778.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2778.business_summary: Palemo Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of specialty stores in Japan. The company sells women's clothing, apparel, and accessories under Palemo Store, Lucid Park, Re-J&SUPURE, Hare no hi, INCENSE, Dosch, Gal Fit, and Suzutan brands. It is also involved in the delivery agency business. The company was formerly known as Palemo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Palemo Holdings Co.,Ltd. in August 2017. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

277A.name: GLOBE-ING INC
277A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
277A.business_summary: Globe-ing Inc. provides DX and strategic consulting, and digital analytics/data services in Japan. The company offers cloud products, including Sales Suite, a solution to improve sales productivity; and Spend Intelligence Suite, a solution to optimize a company's external spending. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2780.name: KOMEHYO HOLDINGS CO LTD
2780.name_from_universe: コメ兵ホールディングス
2780.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2780.business_summary: Komehyo Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the purchase and sale of used and new products through stores in Japan. The company offers jewelry, metals, clocks, bags, cloths, cameras, musical instruments. It is involved in the brand fashion business, tire and wheel business, and real estate leasing business. Komehyo Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

2782.name: SERIA CO LTD
2782.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2782.business_summary: Seria Co., Ltd. operates stores in Japan. The company's stores sell merchandise and private brand products. It operates directly managed and franchise chain stores. It offers its products through permanent in-shop stores, tenants in commercial facilities, and independent roadside stores. The company was formerly known as Sanyo Agency Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Seria Co., Ltd. in April 2003. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Ogaki, Japan.

2784.name: ALFRESA HOLDINGS CORP
2784.name_from_universe: アルフレッサ　ホールディングス
2784.business_summary: Alfresa Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, wholesale, marketing, and import/export of pharmaceuticals, diagnostic reagents, and medical devices/equipment in Japan and internationally. It is also involved in the operation of dispensing pharmacies and conducting related businesses; ethical pharmaceuticals wholesaling business; self-medication products wholesaling business; and other medical-related businesses. In addition, the company manufactures and markets active pharmaceutical ingredients; contract distribution services in hospitals; operation, maintenance, and development of information system; supply of cell raw materials; manufacturing of specific processed cells and regenerative medicine products. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2788.name: APPLE INTERNATIONAL CO LTD
2788.name_from_universe: アップルインターナショナル
2788.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2788.business_summary: Apple International Co., Ltd. operates as an automobile exporter in Japan and internationally. It is involved in the franchise business of used cars; and auto auction business. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Yokkaichi, Japan.

2789.name: KARULA CO LTD
2789.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2789.business_summary: Karula Co.,LTD. operates Japanese style family restaurants in Japan. It operates stores in Tohoku and Northern Kanto region, including Japanese-style restaurant Marumatsu and Jushoan stores; crab restaurant Kani Masamune; pork cutlet restaurant Katsu Gourmet; Japanese soba restaurant Marumatsu; and other stores. Karula Co.,LTD.was formerly known as Marumatsu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Karula Co.,LTD. in March 1991. The company was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Tomiya, Japan.

278A.name: TERRA DRONE CORPORATION
278A.business_summary: Terra Drone Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of industrial drone solutions. It operates through two segments, Aircraft Solutions and Aircraft Management. The company is involved in the development of unmanned aircraft system traffic management systems for enhancing the safety of drone and urban air mobility flights. The company also provides aerial solutions for spraying pesticides, fertilizers, and pest control products for agricultural plantations, as well as land survey and plant monitoring, mapping and analysis of soil conditions, and monitoring weather conditions and rainfall. In addition, it offers Terra UT drones and Terra 3D Inspect, a cloud-based platform for inspection of tanks, boilers, and various infrastructure facilities in the petrochemical and electric power industries. Further, the company provides Terra Lidar drones for construction and engineering, mining exploration, and GIS solutions. It serves land surveying, forest survey, mine surveying, infrastructure inspection, and oil and gas inspection sectors. The company has a strategic alliance with Quest UAV Ltd. Terra Drone Corporation was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2790.name: NAFCO CO LTD
2790.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2790.business_summary: NAFCO Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of home and furniture retail stores in Japan. It operates through three segments: Materials, DIY, and Gardening Supplies; Livingware; and Furniture and Home Fashion Items. The company offers home improvement products, including DIY, gardening, exterior, and pet supplies, car accessories, daily and household goods, interior products, and other items; and furniture and home fashion products, such storage, dining, living room, wedding, study, and small furniture, as well as beds and beddings. It also provides carpentry tools; building hardware; paint; plastering and plumbing supplies; timber; shelves; room accessories; work supplies; greenery; electrical materials; seasonal and storage items; stationery; daily necessities; cooking appliances; footwear; food; health and beauty; and outdoor goods, as well as floor coverings; curtains; lighting; renovation materials; and flooring. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Kitakyushu, Japan.

2791.name: DAIKOKUTENBUSSAN CO
2791.business_summary: Daikokutenbussan Co.,Ltd. operates discount stores primarily in Japan. It is also involved in the general food wholesale business. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Kurashiki, Japan.

2792.name: HONEYS HOLDINGS CO LTD
2792.name_from_universe: ハニーズホールディングス
2792.business_summary: Honeys Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, manufacture, sale and wholesale of women's clothing and fashion accessories. It offers products under the GLACIER, Cinema club, and Colza brand names. The company also provides products through stores and online shopping sites. Honeys Holdings Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Honeys Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Honeys Holdings Co., Ltd. in March 2017. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Iwaki, Japan.

2795.name: NIPPON PRIMEX INC
2795.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2795.business_summary: nippon primex inc. manufactures and sells printers and other electronic devices in japan and internationally. the company offers kiosk printers, face mount printers, panel mount printers, ticket printers, journal printers, portable printers, pos printers, desktop printers, presenters, bezels, paper holders, and power supplies. nippon primex inc. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in tokyo, japan.

2796.name: PHARMARISE HOLDINGS CORPORATION
2796.name_from_universe: ファーマライズホールディングス
2796.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2796.business_summary: Pharmarise Holdings Corporation manages dispensing pharmacies in Japan. Its dispensing pharmacies provide patients with dispensing services based on prescriptions drawn up by medical institutions. The company also manages drug stores and convenience stores. In addition, it is involved in the storage and management of medical examination records of patients on behalf of medical institutions; and operation of medical malls. It also provides system integration services to pharmaceutical companies; medical IT solutions; and temporary help and employment placement services. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2798.name: Y'S TABLE CORP
2798.name_from_universe: ワイズテーブルコーポレーション
2798.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2798.business_summary: Y's Table Corporation engages in the planning, development, and operation of various restaurants in Japan and internationally. It operates directly managed stores and franchise stores. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Minato, Japan.

279A.name: INTERG INC
279A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
279A.business_summary: Interg Inc. engages in the digital media and insurance businesses in Japan. The company operates various comparison websites for insurance products and related consultation services; and lifestyle services, such as hair removal salon/clinics, men's hair removal, and golf schools, as well as video streaming services. It also provides human resources media, including nurse, pharmacist, caregiver, childcare worker, and other job change sites/agents comparison guides; and financial media comprising card loan and credit card review websites. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2801.name: KIKKOMAN CORP
2801.business_summary: Kikkoman Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of food products in Japan and internationally. It offers soy sauce, soy sauce soup bases, and Del Monte seasonings; soy milk and Del Monte beverages; mirin and wines. The company also manufactures and sells canned fruits, corn products, and tomato ketchup; health foods; and purchases and sells oriental food products, as well as other products. In addition, it produces and sells clinical diagnostic enzymes, hygiene test agents, hyaluronic acid, as well as chemical products; and offers real estate rental, transportation, logistics, and warehousing services. The company was formerly known as Kikkoman Shoyu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kikkoman Corporation in 1980. Kikkoman Corporation was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Noda, Japan.

2802.name: AJINOMOTO CO INC
2802.business_summary: Ajinomoto Co., Inc. engages in the seasonings and foods, frozen foods, and healthcare and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The Seasonings and Foods segment offers sauces and seasoning products under the AJI-NO-MOTO, HON-DASHI, Cook Do, Ajinomoto KK Consommé, Pure Select Mayonnaise, Ros Dee, Masako, Aji-ngon, Sazón, Sajiku, and CRISPY FRY names. This segment also provides instant noodles under the Knorr Cup Soup and YumYum names; coffee beverages under the Birdy and Blendy brands; powdered drink under the Birdy 3in1 name; MAXIM brand products; A Little Luxury Coffee Shop brand products and various gifts, office drinks, cup vending machines, and tea dispensers, etc. The Frozen Foods segment offers Gyoza dumplings, rice dishes, noodles, sweets, shumai, processed chicken, and other products. The Healthcare and Other segment provides amino acids for applications in various industries, such as pharmaceuticals and foods; contract development and manufacturing services for pharmaceutical intermediates and active ingredients, and sterile preparations. This segment also offers Ajinomoto Build-up Film, an interlayer insulating material for semiconductor packages; functional materials under the Plainset names; AFTINNOVA, such as activated carbon, release paper, etc.; feed amino acids, sports nutrition under the brand Aminovital, personal care materials under the brand Amisoft, amino acid-based makeup oil under the brand Eldew, and powder under the brand Amihope, medical foods, and agricultural services, etc. Ajinomoto Co., Inc. was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2804.name: BULL DOG SAUCE CO
2804.business_summary: Bull-Dog Sauce Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells brown sauces and other seasonings in Japan. The company offers dressings and sauces under the &Bull-Dog brand name. The company was formerly known as Bull-Dog Foods Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Bull-Dog Sauce Co., Ltd. in 1962. Bull-Dog Sauce Co., Ltd. was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2805.name: S & B FOODS INC
2805.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2805.business_summary: S&B Foods Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of spice and herb, instant food, spicy seasoning, and other product primarily in Japan. It also offers pure curry, pepper, western, and seasoning spice; golden curry, fond de bauddiner curry, melty curry, and thick stew; spicy seasoning, such as wasabi and grated raw ginger; and oden mix, retort pouch curry, and pasta sauce, etc., as well as herb-related and other food product. The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2806.name: YUTAKA FOODS CORP
2806.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2806.business_summary: Yutaka Foods Corporation manufactures and sells food products in Japan. It offers granular food, liquid seasoning food, such as soy sauces, dashi, miso processed products, as well as provides dashi and miso processed products. The company also provides powder mixing, granule products, solid products, and tableting. In addition, it offers noodles comprising chilled /instant noodles and other products. The company was founded in 1919 and is based in Chita, Japan.

2809.name: KEWPIE CORP
2809.business_summary: Kewpie Corporation, through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sales food products in Japan and internationally. The company offers mayonnaise, salad dressings, pasta sauces, side dishes, and other condiments; baby food, childcare food, and nursing care food products; packaged salads, delicatessen food, and other household products; vinegar, liquid and frozen eggs, dried eggs, and egg processed food products; and jam orange marmalade, frozen fruit, and other processed products. It also provides fine chemicals, including hyaluronic acid, egg yolk lecithin, and other materials. In addition, the company is involved in the processing and sale of fresh vegetables; planning, production, and services for sales promotion; production and sale of condiment, bottled and canned food, and retort pouch food products; manufacture and sale of feed and fertilizer; manufacturing equipment for food articles and medical drugs, and other various machines and equipment, and engineering; provision of agency service for advertising, publicity, and exhibitions, as well as warehousing and transportation services; and planning, development, sale, maintenance, and operations support of computer systems. Further, it engages in the plumbing work, machinery and equipment installation work, construction work and electrical work; and building designing, construction, supervisory and consulting businesses. Kewpie Corporation was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

280A.name: TMH INC
280A.business_summary: TMH Inc. engages in the purchase, repair, and sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment parts in Japan, Asia, the United States, and internationally. It also operates LAYLA, an online marketplace for the semiconductor industry. In addition, the company offers heater, bratron, ceramic heater, chamber parts, chiller, dome, equipment parts, esc, generator, jacket heater, LFM, magnet, mass flow controller, motor driver, sensor, spindle, touch panel, valve, VODM, cryopump, turbo pump, and robot products. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Oita, Japan.

2810.name: HOUSE FOODS GROUP INC
2810.name_from_universe: ハウス食品グループ本社
2810.business_summary: House Foods Group Inc. engages in the manufacture, sale, import, and export of spices, seasonings, and processed foods in Japan and internationally. It operates through Spice/Seasoning/Processed Food Business, Health Food Business, Overseas Food Business, Restaurant Business, and Other Food Related Business segments. The company offers roux curry and stew, retort curry, spice products, starch noodles, stew, retort pouched foods, processed meat products, starch, etc.; prepared dishes, baked breads, and dessert products; soy-bean products; tofu, meat alternatives, and other plant-based food products; frozen vegetables, mustard essential oil, processed foods, etc.; agricultural products; and health foods and functional beverages. It also operates restaurants; and provides transport and warehouse, analysis service relating safety and sanitation of foods, restaurant operations consulting and trading, and agricultural management services. House Foods Group Inc. was formerly known as House Foods Corp and changed its name to House Foods Group Inc. in 2013. House Foods Group Inc. was founded in 1913 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2811.name: KAGOME CO LTD
2811.business_summary: Kagome Co., Ltd. is involved in the manufacturing, purchasing, and sale of vegetable drinks and food products in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Domestic Processed Food Business, International Business, and Others. The Domestic Processed Food Business segment manufactures and sells beverages, preserved food, seasonings, and other products. The International Business segment engages in seed, seedling, and farming product development, processing, and sale activities. The Others segment offers tomato paste, diced tomatoes, carrot juice, frozen Mediterranean vegetables, pizza sauce, barbecue sauce, and tomato ketchup. In addition, the company develops and sells health support services. Further, the company serves processed food manufacturers, food service providers, retail outlets, DtoC, and home meal replacement vendors. Additionally, it sells its products through local distributors and cross-border e-commerce channels. Kagome Co., Ltd. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

2813.name: WAKOU SHOKUHIN CO
2813.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2813.business_summary: Wakou Shokuhin Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells soups and natural extracts in the United States and Japan. The company offers Ramen soups; and acts as an OEM manufacturer of various seasonings. It sells its products through convenience stores, restaurants, and other industries. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Otaru, Japan.

2814.name: SATO FOODS INDUSTRIES CO
2814.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2814.business_summary: Sato Foods Industries Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of tea extracts, plant extracts, natural seasonings, and powdered alcohol in Japan and internationally. Its powdered alcohol is used in snacks, premixes, drinks, soups, processed seafood and livestock foods, prepared meals, pickles, foods boiled in soy sauce, processed agricultural foods, etc.; and plant extracts are used in fruit juice powders, vegetable powders, and coffee extracts. The company's powdered tea extracts are used in instant teas, tea machines and cup vending machines, health foods, cakes, and various types of general food processing; and naturally derived flavorings are used in noodle broths, sauces, soups, dressings, Chinese noodles, snacks, oden, pickles, and prepared dishes. Sato Foods Industries Co., Ltd. was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Komaki, Japan.

2815.name: ARIAKE JAPAN CO
2815.business_summary: ARIAKE JAPAN Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and sells natural seasoning products with extracts from chicken, pork, beef, and other fresh livestock ingredients. It provides chicken bone base soups, ramen soups, chanpon soups, bouillon and consomme products, sauce bases, and Japanese bouillon products; and livestock meat, including beef, pork, and chicken, as well as shrimps, garlic, and seasoning oils. The company also engages in the production, processing, export/import, and sale of agricultural and livestock products. It operates in Japan, China, Taiwan, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, and Indonesia. The company was formerly known as Ariake Tokushu Suisan Hanbai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ARIAKE JAPAN Co., Ltd. in April 1990. ARIAKE JAPAN Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2816.name: DAISHO CO LTD
2816.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2816.business_summary: Daisho Co.,Ltd. engages in the production and sale of sauce, soup, and seasoning ingredients in Japan and internationally. It offers sauces, salt-pepper seasonings, dipping sauce, soup mixes, pork stomach soup mixes, salad dressings, green vegetable juices, and other blended seasoning products. The company was formerly known as Daisho Shokuhin Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Daisho Co.,Ltd. in April 1994. Daisho Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2818.name: PIETRO CO LTD
2818.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2818.business_summary: PIETRO Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells food products in Japan. The company's products include dressings such as shoyu, original and roasted sesame; pasta sauces such as crab and crab butter with tomato, sea urchin cream, sardine and vegetables peperoncino, bolognese for meat lovers, eggplant and ground meat with spicy tomato, mentaiko carbonara, takana and bacon, garlic and tarako peperoncino, sesame, soy and garlic, peperoncino, tomato and garlic, tarako (pollack roe) mayonnaise and basil; pasta; seasoning such as garlic oil, and green and raw chili sauce; toppings such as fried onion and nuts, and fired onion and garlic; soups, salads, pizza, doria, drinks, frozen products, and other products. It is also involved in the management of restaurants and fast food restaurants that primarily serve pasta dishes; and rental of office buildings, etc. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

2819.name: EBARA FOODS INDUSTRY INC
2819.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2819.business_summary: Ebara Foods Industry,Inc. produces and sells food condiments in Japan. It offers sauces, ketchup, and seasoning. The company sells its products under the Ohgon no aji and Sukiyaki no tare. EBARA Foods Industry,Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

281A.name: INFORMETIS CO LTD
281A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他

It offers ienowa and enenova for reducing the use of electricity by home appliances, generating electricity from solar power, and store electricity; and hitonowa, an energy management service for electric power companies. Informetis Co., Ltd. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

2820.name: YAMAMI COMPANY
2820.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2820.business_summary: Yamami Company manufactures and sells tofu in Japan. The company offers firm, silken, filling, grilled, thick fried, fried, deep-fried chopped, and commercial tofu, as well as okara powder. It also provides soybeans and noodles; processed marine foods; and other related products. Yamami Company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Mihara, Japan.

The company engages in the manufacture, processing, and sale of frozen, retort packaged, and canned foods, as well as packaged ice and other products. It also manufactures and sells marine, meat, and poultry products, as well as processed products. In addition, the company offers logistics services, such as temperature-controlled storage, cargo handling, distribution processing, transportation and delivery, and 3PL. Further, it engages in the manufacture and sale of diagnostics and raw materials for cosmetics, as well as offers real estate management services. The company was formerly known as Nippon Reizo Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Nichirei Corporation in February 1985. Nichirei Corporation was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

The company offers frozen desserts, such as ice cream bars and cups, as well as Japanese sweets, including sasa dango, etc. It also engages in the refrigerated warehouse business. The company was incorporated in 1916 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.

2874.name: YOKOREI CO LTD
2874.business_summary: Yokorei Co.,Ltd. engages in the food distribution and refrigerated warehouse businesses in Japan and internationally. It imports, exports, processes, and sells marine products, such as scallop, yellowtail and salmon, octopus, fish roe, crab, squid, mackerel, fish, trout species, saury, shrimp, sardines, and others to wholesalers, food product manufacturers, marine product processing companies, volume retailers, ready meal vendors, restaurants, catering-related businesses, and others; livestock products, including pork, chicken, and beef to manufacturers, wholesalers, volume retailers, and restaurant chains; and agricultural products comprising potatoes, onions, and pumpkins to frozen food product manufacturers, restaurant chains, and wholesalers. The company provides logistics outsourcing services consisting of customs clearance, storage, and delivery; information and communication technology services; and electronic data interchange services. In addition, it engages in the real estate leasing, freight forwarding and trucking, restaurant and coffee shop management, food and drink sales, and other related businesses. The company was formerly known as Yokohama Reito Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Yokorei Co.,Ltd. in December 2021. Yokorei Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

2875.name: TOYO SUISAN KAISHA
2875.business_summary: Toyo Suisan Kaisha, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells food products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Seafood Business, Overseas Instant Noodles Business, Domestic Instant Noodles Business, Low Temperature Food Business, Refrigeration Business, Processed Food Business, And Other segments. It also purchases, processes, and sells seafood products. In addition, the company manufactures and sells instant cup noodles, instant noodles, soup, chilled noodles and foods, frozen food, rice, seafood, commercial frozen food, and other processed foods, as well as fish, ham, and sausage. Further, it engages in the manufactures and sale of low- temperature foods; refrigeration and freezing of cargo activities; provision of warehouse, transportation, and customs clearance services; and bento and prepared food business. Toyo Suisan Kaisha, Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

2876.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

The company offers pizza crust and dough products; bread products, including naan, focaccia, tortilla, pita, and biscuits; shredded cheese; and cheese fry and naan dog snack products to supermarket chains and various food service companies. It also trades in pizza and basil sauces, and curries; olives and jalapenos; meat and chicken products comprising pepperoni, Italian sausages, taco meat, chicken sticks, chicken drops, and spicy chicken drops. In addition, the company operates restaurants and department store food counters, as well as provides take-out and home delivery services. Delsole Corporation distributes its products under the Del Sole label. The company was formerly known as JC Comsa Corporation. Delsole Corporation was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

287A.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
287A.business_summary: Kuroda Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells goods and materials for data storage, automotive, and electronics industries in Japan and internationally. It offers oriented film printing plates for liquid crystal displays; materials for electric facilities; die-casting, CNC machining, mold, injection, and assembly; components for hard disk drives and solid state drives; automation equipment; and plastic injection mold for automotive interior parts. The company is also involved in the contract development services for electronic circuit design/board design; and laser processing business of electronic components for automobiles and mobile devices. In addition, it trades in electronic parts and materials. Kuroda Group Co., Ltd. was formerly known as KM Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kuroda Group Co., Ltd. in April 2020. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. Kuroda Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of KM2, L.P.

The company also manufactures and sells frozen food under the OSAKA OHSHO brand; and sells products for co-op and mass retailers through wholesalers, as well as through e-commerce business goods sales sites. It operates through directly managed and franchised restaurants. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

It also provides frozen food, such as kakiage, pancakes, red bean rice, fried oysters, fried chicken, and fried chicken tender cutlets; and vegetables. In addition, the company; imports, sells, and maintains commercial kitchen equipment; and sells vegetable ingredients. Yoshimura Food Holdings K.K. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2892.business_summary: Nihon Shokuhin Kako Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of processed corn products and related secondary processed products in Japan. The company offers starch, modified, and pregelatinized starch; glucose, isomerized liquid sugar, starch syrup, maltose syrup, maltooligosaccharide, powdered maltooligosaccharide, isomaltooligosaccharide, glucooligosaccharides, nigerooligosaccharide, dietary fiber, and edible processed material. It also provides cyclodextrin, glucose, and maltose hydrate products; and by products, such as corn salad oil, corn steep liquor, gluten meal, and gluten feed. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Nihon Shokuhin Kako Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsubishi Corporation.

2894.name: ISHII FOOD CO LTD
2894.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
2894.business_summary: Ishii Food Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and selling of food products in Japan. The company provides processed meat food, prepared dishes, new year dishes, emergency food, and health-conscious food, as well as considerate meals. It offers its products to retailers and consumers through and mail-order sales services. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Funabashi, Japan.

The company's products include instant noodles, bag-type and cup-type noodles, chilled foods, frozen foods, cup-type rice, confectionery, snack, and beverages. It offers its products under Chicken Ramen, Cup Noodle, Cup Noodles Chicken, Demae Iccho, Hé wèi dào, Nissin Premium Bag Korean Hot Chili Chicken, Cup Noodles Mazedaar Masala, and Soba brand names. The company offers barley and burdock tea, other health drinks and beverages, and beef jerky. It also provides services to medical, welfare, and nursing care institutions, and sells cosmetics and related products. The company was formerly known as Ishigaki Foods Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Wel-Dish.Incorporated in June 2024. It offers bento boxes, rice balls, sushi, sandwiches, and side dishes; and vegetable salads, pasta, deli, and chilled food products, as well as frozen bento boxes, deli, and osechi.
