The company offers frozen cooked fish cakes, frozen deep fried fish cakes, jumbo crab sticks, seafood sea urchins, sea salads, marine sticks, and naruto and chikuwa products. It also provides prepared side dishes, including goma dofu; snack food, such as sardine chips; maitake mushrooms; and freight transportation and warehousing services. The company sells its products to supermarkets, drug stores, and other retailers. It exports its products. 2971.business_summary: ESCON JAPAN REIT Investment Corporation with ES-CON ASSET MANAGEMENT Ltd. As the organizer, based on the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended hereinafter the Investment Trust Act), and listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market of Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (hereinafter the Tokyo Stock Exchange) on February 13, 2019. Afterwards ESCON REIT believes that, as population decline and concentration of population in major metropolitan areas continues, the demand to live in highly convenient major cities or areas with easy access to large cities will remain stable. Also, ESCON REIT believes that in order to support affluent lifestyles for people living in these areas, ESCON REIT requires commercial facility, residence and Assets aimed at creating a sustainable society, which is expected to solve diverse social issues in everyday life that affect local communities, such as declining birth rates, aging populations, environmental and energy issues, labor and education issues, and problems wrought by natural disasters. ESCON REIT defines these assets as lifestyle-focused assets and invests in lifestyle-focused assets located mainly in the five major metropolitan areas. Based on the above investment policy, ESCON REIT will seek to maximize unitholder value by aiming for more steady growth of assets under management. ESCON REIT now owns 38 properties with a total acquisition price of 71,518 million yen as of the end of the current fiscal period. ESCON JAPAN REIT Investment Corporation was established on August 26, 2016 and incorporated in Japan.

3053.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3053.business_summary: Pepper Food Service Co., Ltd. operates restaurants in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Product Sales, Ikinari! Steak, and Restaurant segments. It also franchises and operates restaurants, such as Sumiyaki Steak Kuni, Kodawari Tonkatsu Katsuki-tei, Sukihana, Kairi, Gyutan Sendai Natori, and Katsukitei restaurants. In addition, the company sells food products at restaurants and wholesale, such as dressings, steak sauce, tonkatsu sauce, ikinari steak sets, and other food items. Further, it sells its products through online shops, including frozen hamburg steaks, frozen ikinari!, garlic rice, and ikinari! stew. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in Sumida, Japan.

3054.name: HYPER INC
3054.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3054.business_summary: HYPER Inc. engaged in the IT services and computer business in Japan. The company supplies a range of office PC and provides implementation plan and support, equipment procurement, operational support, and collect services. It also designs, installs, and configures various servers, installs and configures client PC, builds network, and performs kitting works; and provides IT infrastructure installation and configuration services and other construction work. The company sells, installs, and maintains communication, office, and office automation equipment; plans, develops, and sells software; and provides information processing services. In addition, the company is involved in the planning and production of websites; content management system development; designs and produces company brochures, pamphlets, posters, business cards, and various promotional tools; internet mail ordering business; and network construction, system maintenance, and digital content production services. The company operates Sasumaru that provides an ordering and contract management platform for SaaS products, mainly Microsoft 365 and ZOOM; HYPER FACTORY, an online store that handles business-use products, including printers, multifunction devices, and uninterruptible power supplies; a security platform under the Securitya brand; and media outlets, such as HYPER Voice that provides information on corporate IT trends and solutions to problems, and Cloud Infobox for work style reform and cloud services information that are useful for management, as well as operates the Askul Agent business, a mail-order business platform. In addition, it offers maintenance and IT consulting services, as well as specialized services comprising software development, maintenance, implementation, and operation. Further, the company sells office supplies, office furniture, etc. HYPER Inc. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

3058.name: SANYODO HOLDINGS INC
3058.name_from_universe: 三洋堂ホールディングス
3058.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3058.business_summary: Sanyodo Holdings Inc. engages in the sales of books and magazines, stationery and miscellaneous goods, video and music software, game software, and trading cards in Japan. The company is also involved in used hobby, fitness, education, buffet, and real estate leasing businesses, as well as rental of DVD/Blu-ray videos, and CDs and comics. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

3059.name: HIRAKI CO.LTD
3059.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3059.business_summary: Hiraki Co.,Ltd. engages in the mail-order, store sales, and wholesale businesses in Japan. The company offers sales of clothing and daily necessities, which include shoes, footwear, clothing, food, daily goods, daily miscellaneous goods, etc., primarily through catalogs and the internet. It also operates discount and specialty stores for shoes. In addition, the company wholesales its products to retailers and mass retailers. Hiraki Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

305A.name: DOUBLE TREE INC
305A.business_summary: Double Tree Inc. operates stores to sale light vehicles in Japan. The company provides vehicle inspection, maintenance, and bodywork painting services, as well as insurance agency services and sells parts and accessories. It is also involved in the cafe, fitness, laundry, and tourism businesses; and sale of donuts. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Kurashiki, Japan.

3063.name: J GROUP HOLDINGS CORP
3063.name_from_universe: ジェイグループホールディングス
3063.business_summary: j-Group Holdings Corp., together with its subsidiaries, operates restaurants in Japan. It operates through Food and Beverage Business, Real Estate Business, and Others segments. The company operates izakayas, food courts, driver's corners, and cafes; and shopping corners that sell souvenirs. It also provides development, operation, rental, and management services for real estate properties. In addition, the company engages in bridal; wholesale of food products; and personnel dispatching and temporary staffing activities. The company was formerly known as j-Project Corp. and changed its name to j-Group Holdings Corp. in September 2012. j-Group Holdings Corp. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

3064.name: MONOTARO CO.LTD
3064.business_summary: MonotaRO Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates an online MRO products store for factories in Japan and internationally. It offers safety protective equipment, work clothes, and safety shoes; logistics, storage, and packing supplies; tapes; safety, disaster prevention, and crime prevention products; safety signs; office supplies; office furniture/lighting/cleaning supplies; cutting tools and abrasives; measurement and surveying equipment; work tools/electric and pneumatic tools; sprays, oils, greases, and paints; adhesives and repair materials; welding supplies; and plumbing, plumbing members, pumps, pneumatics, hydraulic equipment, and hoses. It also provides mechanical parts; control equipment; soldering/static countermeasure products; building hardware and materials; painting and interior supplies; air conditioning and electrical equipment; electrical materials; screws, bolts, nails, and materials; automotive, truck, motorcycle, and bicycle supplies; scientific research and development supplies; clean room supplies; kitchen equipment and store supplies; agricultural materials and gardening supplies; and medical and nursing care supplies. The company was formerly known as Sumisho Grainger Co., Ltd. and changed its name to MonotaRO Co., Ltd. in February 2006. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan. MonotaRO Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Grainger Global Holdings, Inc.

3065.name: LIFE FOOD CO. LTD
3065.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3065.business_summary: Life Foods Co., Ltd. operates a chain of Japanese-style restaurants in Japan. The company's restaurants include cafeteria-style restaurants under The Meshiya and Meshiya Shokudo names, a set-meal restaurant under the Street Corner Shop name, and an udon noodle restaurant under the Sanuki Noodles name. It operates in Kansai and Chubu districts. The company was formerly known as El Foods Co., Ltd and changed its name to Life Foods Co., Ltd. in 1991. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan. Life Foods Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Seven & i Holdings Co., Ltd.

3067.name: TOKYO ICHIBAN FOODS CO.LTD
3067.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3067.business_summary: Tokyo Ichiban Foods Co., Ltd. engages in the operation of restaurant chains in Japan and the United States. The company operates a chain of swimming tiger blowfish specialty restaurants under the Tora-fugu Tei brand name; sushi and live fishes restaurant under the Sakana-no-manma brand name; and tiger blowfish restaurant under the Fuguyoshi Souhonten brand name, as well as Japanese cuisine restaurant under the Wokuni brand name. It is also involved in the farming of blowfish, tuna, and yellowtail; processing, distribution, and sale of aquacultured fish; and rental of real estate properties. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Toshima, Japan.

3068.name: WDI CORPORATION
3068.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3068.business_summary: WDI Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, owns and manages restaurants in Japan, North America, Micronesia, Asia, and internationally. It is also involved in bridal planning and operation activities. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

3069.name: JFLA HLDGS INC
3069.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3069.business_summary: JFLA Holdings Inc. operates, manages, and franchises restaurants in Japan. It also engages in the manufacture, processing, wholesale, and retail of soy sauce, Japanese seasoning, miso, pickles, sake, alcoholic beverages, soft drinks, and food products; import, wholesale, and retail of food materials, confectionery materials, and wine; and wholesale of various food products for business use. In addition, the company offers milk and dairy products; and engages in the breeding of calves and cultivation of grass fodder. Further, it is involved in importing, exporting, and retailing foods or drinks. The company was formerly known as Walnut Street Group Holding Limited and changed its name to JFLA Holdings Inc. in 2018. JFLA Holdings Inc. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3070.name: JELLY BEANS GROUP CO LTD
3070.name_from_universe: ジェリービーンズグループ
3070.business_summary: Jelly Beans Group Co., Ltd. plans, develops, wholesales, and retails non-leather women's footwear in Japan. The company offers its products primarily under the JELLY BEANS brand. It also imports and exports women's shoes. In addition, the company provides designing consulting, supply chain, and after-sales services. It sells its products to department stores and shopping malls. Further, it engages in the distribution of food products. Additionally, it engages in the freight forwarding; warehousing and warehouse management; rail transport; marine transport; air transport; and logistics consulting business. The company also operates online shops. The company was formerly known as Amagasa Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JELLY BEANS GROUP Co., Ltd. in September 2024. Jelly Beans Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3071.name: STREAM CO.LTD.
3071.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3071.business_summary: Stream Co.,Ltd. engages in the Internet shopping management business in Japan. It is involved in internet mail order, rental, beauty and healthcare, 3PL, and various sales support businesses. Stream Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

3075.name: CHOUSHIMARU CO.LTD.
3075.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3075.business_summary: Choushimaru Co.,Ltd. operates gourmet carousel sushi restaurants in Japan and internationally. The company was formerly known as All Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Choushimaru Co.,Ltd. in April 2005. Choushimaru Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Chiba, Japan.

3076.name: AI HOLDINGS CORPORATION
3076.name_from_universe: あい　ホールディングス
3076.business_summary: Ai Holdings Corporation provides security and peripheral computer equipment, measuring equipment, business communication systems, and card and other office equipment. The company offers surveillance cameras and recorders for banks, governmental facilities, shopping districts, retail shops, and other facilities, as well as installation and after-sales services; card issuing system and specialized CAD software for steel structures; and systems for medical institutions to general-purpose systems, such as magnetic card readers, ID cards, and cards with embedded IC chips. The company also provides cutting plotters for professional and home use; measuring instruments for voltage, current, temperature, humidity, pulse, and data captures; cloud storage products; and office-oriented business phones for general corporate offices, nursing care facilities, medical facilities, factory plants, mass retailers, and commercial facilities, as well as an optimal communications system for small-to-large-scale business establishments. In addition, it develops, manufactures, and sells the Ai-Glies demand control and energy conservation systems, which reduce electric power consumption and power usage fees for air conditioners; and offers architectural design and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering services, as well as engages in the IoT promotion business, such as IoT, high-speed communications (5G/6G), digital transformations (DX), and AI-based automation. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3077.name: HORIIFOODSERVICE CO.LTD.
3077.name_from_universe: ホリイフードサービス
3077.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3077.business_summary: Horiifoodservice Co., Ltd. operates a dining restaurant business in Japanese. It operates restaurants under the HITACHINOKUNI, KAKURE, GOCHISOHONPO, AKA-KARA, GYUTAN, Meat sushi, Boiled offal in a large pot Goemon, Yakiniku and Sundudu Chego!!, Ramen Fujita, Buon giorno Shokudo, Hakata motsu nabe Marumo, Ibaraki Marugoto Shioya brand names. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Mito, Japan. As of August 29, 2024, Horiifoodservice Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of City Creation Holdings, Inc.

3079.name: DVX INC.
3079.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3079.business_summary: DVx Inc. engages in the research and development, design, purchasing/selling, import/export, repair, maintenance and inspection, and rental of medical devices and related peripheral devices in Japan. The company offers arrhythmia-related products, such as cardiac pacemakers, implantable cardioverter defibrillators, electrode catheters, and ablation catheters; ischemia-related products, that includes RAQUOS and resolution/resolution SD; and EPS Trainer, an intracardiac electrograms simulator; and wonder belt products. The company also engages in the design, manufacture, and purchasing/selling of medical computers; manufacture, purchasing/selling, repair, maintenance and inspection, rental, leasing, and import/export of medicines, quasi drugs, cosmetics, health foods, daily goods, nursing care products, and nursing care equipment; provision of internal and external medical and medical device-related general consulting and services, as well as medical publishing and market research services; and sale and purchase of second hand goods. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

307A.name: HOUSING STAFF INC
307A.name_from_universe: ハウジング・スタッフ
307A.business_summary: Housing staff Inc. engages in the newly detached house business in Japan. The company also provides renovation and maintenance services; and real estate consultancy and vacation rental services. It operates under the Cleverley Home, TD Home, Tochisuma Shop, ZERO×STYLE, Rakuten STAY HOUSE, +Renovation House, R+house, and VARY'S brands. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Matsue, Japan.

3080.name: JASON CO LTD (JP)
3080.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3080.business_summary: Jason Co., Ltd. develops and operates discount and variety stores in Japan. The company offers clothing and accessories, including interior men's clothing, children's clothing, women's clothing, underwear, socks, shoes, bags, umbrellas, belts, bedding and interior decorations; daily necessities and household goods, such as home appliances, household cooking utensils, watches and glasses, cameras, toys and hobbies, stationery; car supplies, sports and leisure goods, bicycles, diy supplies, gardening, kitchen supplies; cosmetics, detergents, cleaning supplies, pet supplies, and baby supplies. The company also offers foodstuffs, which includes general foodstuffs, processed meats; alcoholic beverages; and other operating income, such as royalties, logistics fees received, and tenant rent. It operates directly managed stores and shared delivery centers. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Kashiwa, Japan.

3082.name: KICHIRI HOLDINGS & CO LTD
3082.name_from_universe: きちりホールディングス
3082.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3082.business_summary: KICHIRI HOLDINGS & Co.,Ltd., a food service company, operates and manages restaurants and related operations in Japan. It is also involved in franchising and licensing business. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3083.name: STAR SEEDS CO LTD
3083.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3083.business_summary: Star seeds Co.,Ltd. operates fashion apparel retail stores in Japan. It also engages in the metaverse fashion business, as well as offers consulting services. It sells its products under TORNADO MART, HIGH STREET, FACETASM, AND TITICACA brand name. The company was formerly known as C'sMEN Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Star seeds Co.,Ltd. in November 2024. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

3086.name: J FRONT RETAILING CO LTD
3086.name_from_universe: Ｊ．フロント　リテイリング
3086.business_summary: J. Front Retailing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates department stores. The company operates through Department Store Business, Shopping Center (SC) Business, Developer Business, and Payment and Finance Business segments. The Department Store Business segment operates Daimaru and Matsuzakaya stores, as well as sells clothing, miscellaneous goods, household goods, food, etc. The SC Business segment develops, manages, and operates shopping centers. The Developer Business segment develops, manages, and operates interior decorating work of real estate. The Payment and Finance Business segment issues and operates credit cards. The company also engages in the product testing and quality control services; parking lot business; outsourcing of administrative processing and leasing business; information services; prepaid specific trading business; and e-sports team management services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

3087.name: DOUTOR NICHIRES HOLDINGS CO LTD
3087.name_from_universe: ドトール・日レスホールディングス
3087.business_summary: DOUTOR NICHIRES Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates and manages coffee shops and restaurants in Japan. It manufactures and sells breads and pastries; roasts, processes and sells coffee; and imports, exports, purchases, and sells food products, as well as recruits and guides restaurant franchisees through a franchise chain system. The company is also involved in the manufacture and wholesale of confectionery products; management of bakery shops; wholesale of coffee machines, etc.; purchase and wholesale of fruits and vegetables; purchase, processing, and wholesale of meat products; manufacture of hams, sausages, and bacons; manufacture and wholesale of sauces and dressing products; and import of coffee beans and tea. In addition, it designs, constructs, maintains, and cleans stores; and operates natural food stores; manufactures and sells tofu; produces hydroponic vegetables; distributes processed food; and engages in the logistic business, as well as offers online mail orders and home delivery services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

3088.name: MATSUKIYOCOCOKARA & CO
3088.name_from_universe: マツキヨココカラ＆カンパニー
3088.business_summary: MatsukiyoCocokara & Co. operates and manages chain stores, drug stores, and insurance dispensing pharmacies in Japan. The company is involved in the franchise business development and product supply to franchisees. It offers its products under the nake and RECiPEO brand names. MatsukiyoCocokara & Co. was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3089.name: TECHNO ALPHA CO LTD
3089.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3089.business_summary: Techno Alpha Co., Ltd. operates as a trading company in Japan and internationally. The company imports semiconductor manufacturing equipment, as well as supplies equipment, such as wedge wire bonder, bond tester, vacuum reflow soldering, VPS reflow, bonding tool, the microfocus x-ray system, plasma cleaner, die bonder, flip chip bonder products. The company also sells marine machinery and filtration products, including marine cranes, life boats, and boat davits; equipment for food and chemistry to be separated and concentrated with vibrating membrane systems; and solar cell analytical instruments and X-ray inspection systems. In addition, it operates as a system integrator; supplies measurement and inspection systems; develops and produces biochemistry instruments, which include nanoLC pumps and DiNa Series products that are used in the proteomics field; and imports and exports various biochemistry devices. Further, the company provides surface mount technology equipment/materials; LabVIEW solutions; organic photo-detector, image sensor, PDV system ferroelectric material, and Silber nano ink products; automatic shoe sole cleaners, cyclone suction mats, automatic caster cleaners, and all touchless multi-biometric access systems; injection plunger tip and material packaging tear tape products; filtration products; and educational services. Additionally, it offers electronic circuit printer, topological material, cutter, EMI tester, real-time AMC monitoring system, adhesive glue, and polarizer products; chemical science products; and temperature monitoring and fiber optic photometer products, and temperature monitoring systems. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

308A.name: POSTMATE HOLDINGS INC
308A.name_from_universe: ぽすとめいとホールディングス
308A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
308A.business_summary: Postmate Holdings,Inc. provides childcare services in Japan. It also engages in the operation of nursery schools, contracted nursery schools, and other facilities, as well as babysitting and event childcare services. The company offers building maintenance services, including renovation, apartment move-out repairs, and regular cleaning services to the real estate businesses, daycare centers, private apartments, welfare facilities, etc.; and consulting services related to nursery schools. It also engages in the rental and management of real estate such as nursery school facilities and apartments, and company housing properties for nursery school staff. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Okayama, Japan.

3091.name: BRONCO BILLY CO LTD
3091.business_summary: BRONCO BILLY Co.,LTD. engages in the restaurant business in Japan. Its restaurant is involved in the production of steaks, hamburgers, sauces, dressings, cakes, and gelato, as well as seasonings and side dishes. The company also offers pork cutlets, tonkatsu, alcohol, meat, and Obanzai. BRONCO BILLY Co.,LTD. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

3092.name: ZOZO INC
3092.business_summary: ZOZO, Inc. operates online shopping Websites in Japan and internationally. It operates ZOZOTOWN a fashion online shopping website; WEAR, an outfit-sharing app; Multi-Size platform, a new way of shopping for clothes where users select their height and weight to purchase their ideal size; ZOZOUSED, a website for secondhand/vintage apparel; ZOZOFIT, a body management service; ZOZOGLASS, a skin tone capturing device that solves customers' challenge of cosmetic product color selection; ZOZOMAT, a 3D feet measuring tool; ZOZOSUIT, a 3D measurement bodysuit; and PayPay mall. In addition, it engages in the advertisement business. The company was formerly known as Start Today Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ZOZO, Inc. in October 2018. ZOZO, Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan. ZOZO, Inc. is a subsidiary of Z Intermediate Holdings Co.,Ltd.

3093.name: TREASURE FACTORY CO LTD
3093.name_from_universe: トレジャー・ファクトリー
3093.business_summary: Treasure Factory Co.,LTD., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and operation of reuse stores in Japan. The company's reuse products include unused items and items that have been disposed of by manufacturers, such as clothing, home appliances, furniture, household goods, branded goods, sports and outdoor equipment, musical instruments, and hobby products. It also purchases and sells reuse items through online. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3096.name: OCEAN SYSTEM CORPORATION
3096.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3096.business_summary: Ocean System Corporation engages in the supermarket, food delivery, lunch service, contract food service, deli food, inn, and restaurant businesses in Japan. The company operates food supermarkets under the Challenger and Gyomu Super brands; home delivery of dinner ingredient sets and other items under the Yoshikei brand; food delivery and mail-order items under the Takuhai brand; and manufactures, sells, and delivers lunch boxes under Fresh Lunch 39 and Gurumeshi brands. It is also involved in the contract manufacturing of prepared foods through employee cafeterias, welfare meals, and school meals under the Komedoron brand; operation of Japanese-style inn under the Kaifutei Teradomari Nihonkai brand; restaurant under the Yakiniku Kuroshin brand; and OM Channel, an e-commerce service for ordering food online. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Sanjo, Japan.

3097.name: MONOGATARI CORPORATION
3097.name_from_universe: 物語コーポレーション
3097.business_summary: The Monogatari Corporation operates a chain of restaurants in Japan. It also involved in the management of franchise chain development business. The company offers its products under Yakiniku, Ramen, Sushi, and Shabu-shabu brand names. The Monogatari Corporation was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Toyohashi, Japan.

3099.name: ISETAN MITSUKOSHI HOLDINGS LTD
3099.name_from_universe: 三越伊勢丹ホールディングス
3099.business_summary: Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd. engages in the department store business in Japan and internationally. It operates through Department Store Business; Credit & Finance Business/Customer Organization Management Business; and Real Estate Business segments. The company sells apparel, accessories, household and sundry goods, and foods. It is also involved in the money lending, non-life insurance brokerage and solicitation, life insurance agency, and organization management businesses, as well as provision of credit cards; and real estate leasing, tenant management and building interior decorating activities. In addition, the company provides travel and personnel services, and information systems, as well as engages in corporate venture capital, supermarket, cosmetics retail, and media businesses. Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

309A.name: COSMOS CHOUZAI PHARMACY CO  LTD
309A.business_summary: COSMOS CHOUZAI Pharmacy Co.,Ltd. engages in the pharmacy management business in Japan. It sells medicines through stores, as well as the smartphone app, kakari; and delivers medications to patients' homes and elderly care facilities. The company also solves management issues of small and medium-sized dispensing pharmacies through M&A; and engages in the generic drug wholesale business. In addition, it manages vocational school specialized in the national examination for pharmacists. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. Cosmos Chouzai Pharmacy Co. Ltd. is a subsidiary of Meihoku Co.,Ltd.

3101.name: TOYOBO CO
3101.business_summary: Toyobo Co., Ltd. provides films and functional polymers, industrial materials, and healthcare and textile products worldwide. The company operates through the following segments: Films, Life Science, Environmental and Functional Materials, Functional Textiles, and Trading and Real Estate. The Films segment manufactures and sells packaging films, including PET, polyolefin, and nylon for food packaging, as well as heat-resistant PET films; industrial films, such as PET films for liquid crystal displays, optical uses, and other industrial applications, as well as synthetic papers and other products. The Life Science segment manufactures and sells bio-products, such as enzymes for diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, medical membranes, medical devices, and other products, as well as artificial kidney hollow fibers and seawater desalination membranes. The Environmental and Functional Materials segment manufactures and sells engineering plastics, industrial adhesives, photo-functional materials, water treatment membranes, functional filters, high-performance fibers, nonwoven fabrics, and other products. The Functional Textiles and Trading segment manufactures and sells airbag fabrics, functional textiles, apparel products, apparel textiles, apparel fibers, and other products. The Real Estate segment leases and manages real estate properties and others. Toyobo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

3103.name: UNITIKA LTD
3103.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3103.business_summary: Unitika Ltd. manufactures and sells polymers, performance materials, industrial fibers and textiles, and others in Japan and internationally. The company offers polymers, such as nylon and polyester films; nylon, polyester, and polyarylate plastic products; polyester, nylon spunbonded, and cotton spunlace nonwoven fabrics; and biodegradable plastic materials. It also provides performance materials, such as activated carbon fibers, glass fabrics, glass beads, and porous plates, as well as biomass-based materials. In addition, the company offers fibers and textiles, such as garments, lifestyle materials, and bedding products, as well as terramac fibers. Unitika Ltd. was incorporated in 1889 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

3104.name: FUJIBO HOLDINGS INC
3104.name_from_universe: 富士紡ホールディングス
3104.business_summary: Fujibo Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells polishing pads, industrial chemical products, and apparel products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three Abrasives Business, Chemical Industrial Products Business, and Life Clothing Business segments. It provides POLYPAS polishing pads for precision polishing of silicon wafers, as well as for various types of semiconductor materials, metals, and glasses; and functional non-woven fabrics, functional films, non-woven polyester fabrics and artificial leathers. The company offers organic synthesis intermediates to produce raw materials for medicines, agricultural chemicals, electronic materials, and functional chemicals; and functional fibers, spun yarns, and knitted fabrics. In addition, it is involved in the business of injection molding of digital cameras, medical equipment, and automobile parts. Fujibo Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1896 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3105.name: NISSHINBO HOLDINGS INC
3105.name_from_universe: 日清紡ホールディングス
3105.business_summary: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in wireless communication, microdevice, automobile brakes, mechatronics, chemicals, textiles, and real estate businesses in China and internationally. It offers disaster prevention, monitoring, video, automotive radar, and broadcasting systems; wireless communication equipment for ships; communication and sensor equipment for transportation infrastructure; bridge system for merchant shipping; close-proximity wireless solutions; ultrasonic-related devices; and equipment for the ministry of defense. The company also provides analog, small, low-power power, and single processing semiconductors, power management IC, RF and opto-semiconductor devices, and microwave electron tubes transmitter/receiver for satellite communications products; friction materials for automobile brakes; and fans for air conditioning equipment, peripheral products for automobile headlamps, and precision parts for electronically controlled brake systems. In addition, it provides insulation materials, resin modifiers, carbon separators for fuel cells, and molding and EBS valve block products; carbon products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, airlite foam, carbodilite resin additive, bipolar plates for fuel cells, and amorphous carbon; and wrinkle-resistant shirts and uniforms, spandex, Oikos non-woven fabrics, and elastomer-related products. Further, it sells and leases real estates, including shopping centers, sport and leisure facilities, offices, housing, and housing exhibition sites. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

3106.name: KURABO INDUSTRIES
3106.business_summary: Kurabo Industries Ltd. engages in textile, chemical, technology, food and service, and real estate businesses in Japan and internationally. It manufactures and sells threads and sewn products, including yarns, fabrics; flame-retardant material and anti-static fabric; insulated clothing and bedding; yarn materials for towels/socks/underwear; work environment support tools, including on-site risk management system and assistive suit; and other products. The company manufactures, processes, and sells polyurethane foam, functional resin products, housing insulation and construction materials, nonwoven fabrics, semiconductor-related products, reinforcing fabrics, and functional materials. In addition, the company manufactures, sells, and maintains electronics-related products; designs, manufactures, constructs, and sells environmental and energy-related plants; generates biomass power using biomass power plants and livestock waste treatment system; and manufactures and sells biomedical and machine tools. Additionally, it manufactures and sells freeze-dried food; engages in the management of hotel, driving school, etc.; and engages in real estate development, management, and leases real estate properties. Kurabo Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1888 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

3107.name: DAIWABO HOLDINGS CO LTD
3107.name_from_universe: ダイワボウホールディングス
3107.business_summary: Daiwabo Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an IT infrastructure distributor in Japan. The company operates through IT Infrastructure Distribution Business and Industrial Machinery Business. It distributes computer appliances and peripheral devices; and provides logistics and technical services and support. In addition, the company manufactures and sells machine tools, such as vertical lathes, grinding machines, and specialized machines; and cartoning machines, automatic packaging machines, film, cardboard casers, and other automatic machinery. Further, it manufactures and sells machine parts for production equipment and casting parts. The company was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

3109.name: SHIKIBO LTD
3109.business_summary: Shikibo Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, and markets textile products in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Textiles; Industrial Materials; and Real Estate and Services. The company offers various yarns, fabrics, textiles, knits, and secondary products used for general clothing, sportswear, casual wear, and uniform, as well as bed and bedding. It also provides chemical industry products, including industrial adhesive for electronic boards production and food additives; industrial materials, such as dryer canvas used for paper, cardboard, and food production, as well as filter clothes; and composite materials comprising fiber reinforced materials, glass fiber reinforced plastics, carbon fiber reinforced plastics, and others. In addition, the company is involved in the transaction, leasing, and management of real estate, as well as rental of commercial buildings, apartments, and mixed bathing facilities; operation of Shikibo Hall; supply of linen to hotels and home cleaning; logistics and distribution businesses; and engages in solar power generation. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1892 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

310A.name: THIRTY FOUR CO LTD
310A.business_summary: Thirty-Four Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan. It is also involved in the design, construction, and sale of new detached house business; custom-built housing business; vacant house renovation business; commercial real estate; apartment and other construction contracting business; and real estate rental management business, as well as restaurant management; and taxi business. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.

3110.name: NITTO BOSEKI CO
3110.business_summary: Nitto Boseki Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and sells glass fiber products, chemical and pharmaceutical products, and textile products in Japan. It operates through six segments: Electronic Materials Business, Medical Business, Composite Materials Business, Materials Solution Business, Insulation Materials Business, and Other Businesses. The company engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of glass fiber products for electronic materials; in vitro diagnostic reagents; glass fiber products for reinforced plastic and industrial materials; chemical products; interlining products, functional materials, and dishcloths; and glass wool products for thermal insulation, heat retention, and sound absorption. It is also involved in the design, manufacture, sale, installation, maintenance, and servicing of industrial machinery. The company was founded in 1898 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3111.name: OMIKENSHI CO LTD
3111.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3111.business_summary: Omikenshi Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, processing, and sale of rayon steple fiber and spinning yarn in Japan. The company also offers rayon cotton, spun yarn, knitted fabrics; various towels and sleeping products; and various foods and beverages. In addition, it is involved in the software development, as well as in the sale of basic cosmetics. The company was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

3113.name: UNIVA OAK HOLDINGS LTD
3113.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3113.business_summary: UNIVA Oak Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides management support services to various businesses in Japan. It operates through nine segments: Growth Support Business; Beauty and Healthcare Business; Renewable Energy Business; Digital Marketing Business; Media Business; Sports Business; Resort Business; Restaurant Revitalization Business; and Shared Service Business. The company offers equity finance underwriting, merger and acquisition support, consulting, and corporate management issues resolution services; designs and sells beauty and health products; and installs and sells solar power generation equipment; and provides Gyro-n, a website improvement tool for digital marketing. It also broadcasts radio programs, organizes events, and produces various content; manages Royal Basketball League, an urban sports professional league for 3x3 basketball; operates Makani Golf Club, a golf course; engages in the renovation of restaurants; and undertakes back-end operations, including general affairs, human resources, accounting, and finance of companies. The company was formerly known as Oak Capital Corporation and changed its name to UNIVA Oak Holdings Limited in October 2023. UNIVA Oak Holdings Limited was founded in 1868 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

3116.name: TOYOTA BOSHOKU CORP
3116.business_summary: Toyota Boshoku Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells automotive interior systems in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company engages in manufacturing and sale of automotive filters and powertrain components, and other automotive components, as well as fabric products. It also provides automobile, aircraft, and railway seats, such as executive lounge and sports seats including seat frames, round recliners, and long slide rails. In addition, the company offers interior and exterior products, which includes door trims, headliners, floor carpets, and luggage and exterior components comprising bumpers, fender liners, and engine undercovers. Further, it provides filter products including air, oil, and cabin air filters; air induction systems and cleaners, intake manifolds, cylinder headcovers, oil mist separator, and timing chain covers; and electric powertrain related products, such as motor core constitute and fuel cell parts, separators, and ion exchangers, as well as anti-droplet partitions and weets. Additionally, the company offers curtain-shield airbags, straps and seatbelt webbings, and seat fabrics. Additionally, the company provides transportation services; and contracting of design work. Toyota Boshoku Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Kariya, Japan.

311A.name: NPT CO  LTD
311A.business_summary: NPT Co.,Ltd. engages in clinical development of new drugs and treatments for personalized medicines. It provides treatment suited to everyone based mainly on the patient's genomic information. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Koto, Japan.

It is also involved in the provision of digital advertising distribution services, as well as real estate sales, brokerage, rental, and management services; and block chain business. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

3123.name: SAIBO CO LTD
3123.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3123.business_summary: Saibo Co., Ltd. primarily manufactures and sells textile products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Textile business, Real estate utilization business, and Golf Driving Range business segments. It offers apparel products, such as corporate office uniforms, working wear, service wear, jackets, and suits; and novelty and sports-related products. The company also provides textile materials, including rayon filament yarn, polyester yarn, blended yarn, synthetic cotton, and polyester and linen fabrics, as well as embroidery lace materials. In addition, it involved in the rental of commercial facilities and real estate properties, building maintenance services, as well as golf driving range management activities. Further, the company engages in the provision of repairing services for automobile sheet metal paint products; interior construction and renovation business for general housing, condominiums, factories, and stores.; and sale of new and used vehicles; and insurance and communication equipment. Saibo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Kawaguchi, Japan.

312A.name: SHINKO HOLDINGS CORPORATION
312A.name_from_universe: シンコーホールディングス
312A.business_summary: Shinko Holdings Corporation engages in the construction equipment business. It engages in the construction and construction management of building equipment, such as air conditioning, heating and cooling works, and water supply and drainage sanitary facilities; design and manufacture of plumbing and other equipment; water facility construction; and piping and other equipment design and manufacturing. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

3131.name: SHINDEN HIGHTEX CORPORATION
3131.name_from_universe: シンデン・ハイテックス
3131.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

It also provides CF cards and SSD products; e-mail security software; directional speakers; defense against pirate, bird deterrent devices, industrial warning surveillance, tunnel safety, and pedestrian safety products; Gateways, modules for LoRa, LTE-M1, 5G/LTE, LPWA, WiFi, bluetooth, GNSS, UWB, gateways, and private LTE; cellular communication and V2X modules for automotive industries; server equipment and data centers; and Li-ion batteries. In addition, the company offers semiconductor components, such as memory products; accelerated processing units and GPUs; LCD controllers, MCUs for remote controllers, power supply MCUs, ARM CPU-based 32bit MCUs, and segment driver ICs; ARM core SoC; ASICs; CMOS image sensor and display driver products; LEDs, wireless modules, touch windows, and PCBs; foundry products and services; semiconductor packaging and test solutions; bumping services; memory controllers; and speakers/receivers/vibration motors/actuators for automobile. Further, it provides display interface ICs for personal computers, portable media players, and smartphones. Shinden Hightex Corporation was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3132.name: MACNICA HOLDINGS INC
3132.name_from_universe: マクニカホールディングス
3132.business_summary: Macnica Holdings, Inc. imports, sells, and exports electronic components in Japan. The company was formerly known as Macnica Fuji Electronics Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Macnica Holdings, Inc. in August 2022. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

3133.name: KAIHAN CO LTD

3134.name: HAMEE CORP
3134.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3134.business_summary: Hamee Corp. engages in the e-commerce and platform businesses for mobile accessories in Japan, rest of Asia, North America, and internationally. The company is involved in the manufacture, purchase, wholesale, and sale of gaming accessories related products and services; development of cosmetic products and gaming monitors; and development and provision of Next Engine, a cloud-based back-end solution for e-commerce businesses. It also engages in the consultation and agency businesses, as well as retail of home appliances. The company was formerly known as Macrowill Company. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Odawara, Japan.

3135.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3135.business_summary: MarketEnterprise Co.,Ltd engages in the online reuse business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Commercial Business, Media Business, and Mobile Communications Business. The company purchases and sells reused items over the internet; operates a marketplace specializing in used agricultural machinery, as well as an online media, which provides information on hobbies, communications, buying and selling, and repairs. It also offers bulk appraisal services; and Kashimo WiMAX, a wireless internet connection service. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

3137.name: FUNDELY CO LTD
3137.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3137.business_summary: Fundely Co., Ltd. engages in the medical food delivery business in Japan. The company is involved in cooking immediately delivery business. It also offers marketing support; and health appliance and pharmaceutical manufacturing services. In addition, it operates Meal Time, an online mail order website for health food; and Shun wo Sugu, an online mail order website for meal delivery business. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3138.name: FUJISAN MAGAZINE SERVICE CO LTD

Fujisan Magazine Service Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

3139.name: LACTO JAPAN CO.LTD
3139.business_summary: Lacto Japan Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, trades in agricultural and livestock products, processed products, food additives, food processing machinery, pharmaceuticals, quasi-pharmaceuticals, liquor and other beverages, and food products in Japan and internationally. The company offers whole milk powder, skimmed milk powder, butter, ice cream, whey powder, whey protein concentrate, casein, caseinate, powdered milk mixtures, prepared butter mixtures, cocoa preparations, other milk preparations, lactose, condensed milk, processed egg products, natural cheese, processed cheese, processed meat products, fresh meat, processed food, and functional food ingredients. It also provides agency and brokerage services. The company serves food manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers; and sports nutrition, and beauty and health industries. Lacto Japan Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

The company also plans and creates concepts and designs related to products; and provides brand tie-ups, original design development, and product name engraving services. It sells its products through stores under the Bruno, Travel Style Milesto, Milesto, Good Gift Go, and Outlet brand names; and online under the Bruno, Milesto, and MeTime brand names. 3143.name: O WILL CORPORATION

It also offers pasteurized milk, concentrated milk, powdered milk, cream, fermented milk, butter, cheese, and other dairy products; and fruit and vegetable juices, puree, fresh fruits and vegetables, canned foods, frozen fruits and vegetables, powders, extracts, and other fruit and vegetable products, as well as imports fish eggs, sushi toppings, and other processed marine products from overseas. In addition, the company provides green, matcha green, oolong, black, rooibos, blended, cocoa, herb, and other tea products, as well as other beverages. Further, it offers wastewater treatment systems, smart ceiling fans, and nozzle type steam traps. O'will Corporation was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3148.name: CREATE SD HOLDINGS CO LTD
3148.name_from_universe: クリエイトＳＤホールディングス
3148.business_summary: Create SD Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the drug store, dispensing pharmacy, nursing care, and related businesses in Japan. It also engages in the operation and management of nursing care homes for the elderly and functional training day service centers; and the provision of visiting medication counseling at nursing homes and homes. In addition, the company offers cleaning work for shops and administrative support for stores, etc. Create SD Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

3153.name: YASHIMA DENKI CO LTD

It also operates public/facilities business, which includes social and public systems, air conditioning solutions, data center solutions, and office environment solutions; and transportation business, such as vehicle, power substation, information and communications, and machinery and equipment. The company was formerly known as Yashima Denki Shokai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yashima Denki Co., Ltd. in February 1960. Yashima Denki Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3154.name: MEDIUS HLDG CO LTD

It is also involved in the sale and rental of nursing care and welfare equipment to hospitals, nursing care facilities, and general individuals. In addition, the company provides the solution tools necessary for medical institutions, such as SURGELANE, STORE, SPD, ASOURCE DATABASE, and meccul. The company was formerly known as Kyowa Medical Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Medius Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2010. Medius Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

3156.name: RESTAR CORPORATION
3156.business_summary: Restar Corporation engages in the sale of semiconductors, electronic components, image sensors, cameras, peripheral equipment, and related products in Japan, China, South Korea, Vietnam, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through Devices Business Unit, System Business Unit, and IT&SIer Business Unit segments. The company also offers system proposals with various line card combinations; high-value-added solutions and technical support for liquid crystal systems and overseas suppliers; LSI design, development, and support; contracted reliability test services; supply chain management for electronics; and electronics manufacturing services for mounting of electronic components, modules, and other electronic devices. In addition, it engages in the proposal, design, construction, and maintenance engineering for video, audio, communications, and measurement; development and manufacture of cashless payment terminals and individual number card authentication-related devices; and operation and management services for the introduction and diffusion of renewable energy through solar power generation. Further, the company produces and sells vegetables; and provides power and system consulting services. Additionally, it is involved in software and application development; design and manufacture of industrial PCS; development and maintenance of in-house solutions; semiconductor design and testing; and other information service businesses. The company was formerly known as Restar Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Restar Corporation in January 2024. Restar Corporation was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

3157.name: GEOLIVE GROUP CORPORATION

The company was formerly known as JUTEC Holdings Corporation and changed its name to GEOLIVE Group Corporation in September 2023. GEOLIVE Group Corporation was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3159.name: MARUZEN CHI HOLDINGS CO LTD

It also engages in the design, supervision, and construction works; publishing books, magazines, etc.; museum management operations and designated manager system; import and sale of books and other publications; production and sale of academic books; buying selling of antiques; management consulting services related to school education business. In addition, the company creates bibliographic information database; and sells office supplies, clothing, and other goods, as well as provides information services using communication networks, etc.; and library management services. Maruzen CHI Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Maruzen CHI Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Dai Nippon Printing Co., Ltd.

3160.name: OOMITSU CO.LTD

3160.business_summary: Oomitsu Co., Ltd. operates as a general food trading company in Japan. It engages in the wholesale business to a range of food service businesses, including restaurant chains, hotels, restaurants, and business cafeterias; cash-and-carry retail business that sells to small-scale food service operators and general consumers; and wholesale business of seafood and shellfish to food manufacturers and wholesalers. 3161.name: AZEARTH CORPORATION
3161.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

In addition, it offers garment materials, such as inner linings, interlining clothes, pocket clothes, and quarter lining belts; and other textile materials. AZEARTH Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

3166.name: OCHI HLDG CO LTD
3166.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3166.business_summary: Ochi Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in building materials business in Japan. It wholesales and sells building materials and housing equipment, such as wood building materials, plywood, and eco-friendly products; air conditioning, heating, cooling, and refrigeration equipment; and household and textile products, etc. The company also processes and sells pre-cut lumber panels for wooden houses. In addition, it undertakes construction, civil engineering work, and structure inspection activities; and sale of industrial materials, as well as worker dispatching business. The company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

3167.name: TOKAI HLDGS CORP
3167.business_summary: TOKAI Holdings Corporation engages in energy, information and communications, and related businesses in Japan and internationally. The company supplies liquefied petroleum gas for individuals, automotive, and corporations; solar power, and other high-pressure gases; and provides electricity to individuals and corporations, Internet services under the @T COM and TOKAI Network Club names, optical internet connection services, and mobile phone communications services, as well as operates mobile shops. It offers outsourcing services, such as co-location, mailing system, back-up, and cloud platforms; system development services, including consulting, construction, operation, and maintenance to food service industry, healthcare, public utilities, accounting, and personnel systems; and corporate communication services. In addition, the company provides CATV services; bottled water delivery services under the Ulunom brands; security services ranging from monitoring services for senior citizens to surveillance services for factories, stores, and offices; residential construction, condominium sales, real estate development, home security, and insurance; and nursing care, ship repair, and bridal services. Further, it operates wedding venues, banquet halls, and restaurants, as well as involved in construction of residential buildings, real estate development and sale, leasing, sale of construction materials and equipment for residential facilities, construction work for ancillary facilities and equipment, renovation, civil engineering, and electrical work. 3168.name: MERF INC
3168.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3168.business_summary: MERF Inc. engages in the collection, processing, manufacture, and sale of various metals in Japan, South Korea, China rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Nonferrous Metals and Arts and Crafts. It recycles and sells industrial materials and metal scraps, as well as produces base metals that are used as raw materials to manufacture electrical wires and semiconductor base plates. The company also recycle, manufactures, and sells copper alloy ingots, which are used in ship propellers, faucets, valves, and various industrial machinery components; and casts and sells works of fine arts, Buddhist statues, ritual articles, and large metal structures. In addition, it is involved in the sale of non-ferrous metals and copper and copper alloy fabricated products, as well as manufacture and sale of aluminum alloys ingots. The company was formerly known as Kurotani Corporation and changed its name to MERF Inc. in January 2025. MERF Inc. was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Imizu, Japan.

3169.name: MISAWA & CO LTD
3169.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
3169.business_summary: Misawa & Co., Ltd. engages in the management of lifestyle shops in Japan. It operates in Unico Business and Food Business segments. The company plans and sells furniture, curtains, rugs, fabrics, and interior and miscellaneous goods under the unico and unico loom brand names through stores and online. It is also involved in the operation of restaurants; provision of coordinating model rooms for condominiums and detached houses; and sale of interior design items. The company was formerly known as Misawa Seiki Seisakusho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Misawa & Co., Ltd. in February 1988. Misawa & Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

3172.name: TEA LIFE CO LTD
