The Other Operations segment offers industrial waste treatment and environmental processing facilities; physiochemical analysis, measurement, testing, and inspection services; and transportation and warehousing, and medical services. The company was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4025.name: TAKI CHEMICAL CO
4025.business_summary: Taki Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the chemicals, water treatment, and functional materials businesses in Japan. The company operates through Agriculture, Chemicals, Building Materials, Oil, Real estate, and Transportation segments. It provides water treatment chemicals, including polyaluminum chloride for drinking and industrial water treatment, urban sewage treatment, effluent treatment from civil engineering works, industrial wastewater treatment, coagulation in production process, and organic sludge filtration and dehydration. The company also offers functional chemical materials, such as water-soluble aluminum compounds, including takiceram, aluminum phosphate-based binders, and takibine; hydrated silica; and high-purity metal oxide consist of high-purity tantalum and niobium pentaoxide. In addition, it develops high-purity biodegradable polymers for medical applications; and colloidal materials that make use of the unique properties of nano-size particles for photocatalysts, ultraviolet absorbing agents, and electroconductive materials. The company serves customers in various fields, including agriculture, chemicals, functional materials, and biotechnology. The company was formerly known as Taki Fertilizer Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Taki Chemical Co., Ltd. in 1974. Taki Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Kakogawa, Japan.

4026.name: KONOSHIMA CHEMICAL CO
4026.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4026.business_summary: Konoshima Chemical Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells building materials, chemicals, and ceramics in Japan, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company offers residential and non-residential ceramic siding, eaves, gable boards, and fireproof panels; and non-combustible building materials for residential and non-residential buildings. It also provides chemicals, such as magnesium oxide, flame retardant magnesium hydroxide, and magnesium carbonate; synthetic magnesite, taichite, analcime, and boehmite; calcium carbonate; and thermally conductive filler. In addition, the company develops, manufactures, and sells functional ceramics. Konoshima Chemical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

4027.name: TAYCA CORP
4027.business_summary: Tayca Corporation manufactures and sells various industrial chemical products in Japan. The company offers general purpose products, including titanium dioxide, surfactants, and sulfuric acid; and specialty products, such as micro titanium dioxide, micro zinc oxide, surface treatment products, photocatalytic titanium dioxide, infrared-refracting titanium dioxide, and aluminum triphosphate. It also provides electronic industry materials and other products comprising electroconductive polymers and piezoelectric materials. The company was formerly known as Teikoku Kako Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tayca Corporation in August 1989. Tayca Corporation was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

4028.name: ISHIHARA SANGYO KAISHA
4028.business_summary: Ishihara Sangyo Kaisha,Ltd. manufactures and sells organic and inorganic chemicals in Japan, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It offers titanium dioxide (TiO2) products under the TIPAQUE trade name, which includes white pigments for applications in paints, inks, plastics, cosmetics, and other products; yellow pigments; and functional materials, such as ultrafine TiO2, ultrafine ZnO, electro-conductive materials, photocatalytic TiO2, high purity TiO2, titanium tetrachride, TiO2 for catalytic use, and acicular type TiO2. The company also offers matting agents; heat shield materials; and environmental products, such as gypsum-based neutral soil adjustment agents, heavy metal absorbers and insolubilizers, iron oxide-based VOCs decomposers, and related combined solutions. In addition, the company provides agrochemicals, including herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, and nematicides; animal healthcare products comprising fuzapladib sodium hydrate, an anti-pancreatitis drug for dogs; and organic intermediates, such as CF3-pyridine compounds offered as pharmaceutical raw materials. Ishihara Sangyo Kaisha,Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

402A.name: AXELSPACE HOLDINGS
402A.name_from_universe: アクセルスペースホールディングス
402A.business_summary: Axelspace Holdings Corporation designs, manufactures, operates, and sells micro-satellites and related components in Japan and internationally. It offers AxelGlobe, an Earth observation platform that offers business insights for various applications, including agriculture, disaster monitoring, news reporting, and environmental management; and AxelLiner, a one-stop service for satellite projects to conduct space missions including observations, communications, experiments, and in-orbit demonstrations. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

4031.name: KATAKURA & CO-OP AGRI CORPORATI
4031.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4031.business_summary: Katakura & Co-op Agri Corporation engages in the fertilizer, cosmetic, chemical, feed, real estate, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers a range of agricultural materials, including chemical fertilizers and compound fertilizers, raising seedling soil, liquid, mixed, soil making, simple, molded mixed, pesticide, paste, simple, and silica fertilizers, as well as microbial material and seedling culture soil. It also supplies ammonia, industrial phosphoric acid, phosphoric acid for food and fertilizers, and sulfuric acid, as well as tank rental business. In addition, the company provides calcium carbonate for feed additives for a wide range of applications, such as poultry farming, pig farming, dairy cattle, beef cattle, and other marine products; manufactures, sells, and designs and develops synthetic clay minerals; provides physicochemical analysis, biologic analysis, quality analysis of agricultural products and crop cultivation tests, etc. Further, it develops, manufactures, and sells cosmetic raw materials for skin care, hair care, and make-up; and management, operation, and sale of real estate properties. The company was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

403A.name: HOJYOGUMI CO LTD
403A.business_summary: Hojyogumi.Co.Ltd engages in the designing and construction of civil engineering and construction works in Japan. It provides pier and bridge repair, land preparation, erosion control, road construction, embankment and revetment construction, water and sewerage construction, slope construction, and other construction works. The company also constructs private homes and public works, as well as housing projects. In addition, it is involved in production, collection, and sale of gravel, sand, and crushed stones; rental of real estate business; and automobile maintenance business, as well as roofing sheet and metal work business. The company was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Nagano, Japan.

4040.name: NANKAI CHEMICAL COMPANY LIMITED
4040.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4040.business_summary: Nankai Chemical Company,Limited manufacturers and sells chemical in Japan and internationally. The company offers inorganic industrial chemicals, water treatment disinfectants, water treatment agents, healthy foods, organic fine chemicals, and pesticides, as well as salt. It is also involved in the sulfuric acid recycling business; collection, transportation, and intermediate treatment of industrial waste; distribution and recovery of precious metals, and non-ferrous metals; distribution and construction of air conditioning equipment; distribution of precision machinery, textile machinery, plating equipment, paint equipment, and building material; parking lot, and real estate management and warehousing; and research, development, production, and sale of agricultural, livestock, and marine products; freight transport and handling; power generation and operation; and non-life insurance business. The company was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

4041.name: NIPPON SODA CO LTD
4041.business_summary: Nippon Soda Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides agri-business, pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals, eco chemicals, and chlor-alkali products in Japan and internationally. The company offers agrichemicals, such as fungicides, insecticides, acaricides, and herbicides; pharmaceutical excipients, including hydroxypropyl cellulose, sodium stearyl fumarate, and diaminomaleonitrile; specialty chemicals, such as organic titanate, magnesium ethylate, liquid-1, 2-polybutadiene, o-tolidine diisocyanate, adhesive agents for film lamination, photoresist base resins, epoxy catalyst, permethyl polysilane, and crown ethers; water treatment chemicals comprising calcium hypochlorite, uroliths remover, chelating agent for heavy metal, photo catalyst, bactericides, algaecides, termiticide, and treatment systems for PCBs; and chlor-alkali chemicals, including caustic soda, hydrochloric acid, chlorine, sodium hypochlorite, sodium metal, sodium alcoholates, sodium cyanide, potassium cyanide, phosphorus trichloride, and phosphorus oxychloride. It provides molded synthetic resin products, oxygen absorbers, dehumidifying agents, and household sundries; fumigant; non-ferrous metals and industrial chemicals; industrial equipment and devices; construction-related products; feed additives; and veterinary drugs. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of warehousing, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, insurance agency, and leasing; cargo auto transport and freight forwarding; integrated planning and design, management, construction, sales, and consulting for industrial and other capital investments, machinery, piping, and civil engineering; civil engineering design, construction, land preparation, and soil and stone mining; information research; information collection and services; operation of test plots; and manufactures concrete products. The company was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4042.name: TOSOH CORP
4042.business_summary: Tosoh Corporation manufactures and sells basic chemicals, petrochemicals, specialty products, and fine chemicals. The company provides advance materials, including battery materials, fabricated quartzware, silica glass, thin film depositions, and zeolites for catalysts and molecular sieves; and zirconia injection mold components and compounds, grinding and dispersion media, and fine beads and powders. It also offers chromatographic columns, and media and diagnostic systems; clinical diagnostic systems; Portland cement and blast-furnace slag cement; and caustic soda, vinyl chloride monomer, calcium hypochlorite, and sodium bicarbonate. In addition, the company provides ethylene, propylene, C4 fraction, cumene, and aromatic compounds; and ethyleneamines, bromine, hydrobromic acids, flame retardants, non-aqueous solvents, chelating agents, ethylene dichloride, and sodium styrenesulfonate. Further, it offers polymers, such as ethylene vinyl-acetate copolymers, adhesive polymers, low and high-density polyethylene products, synthetic rubbers, functional polymers, and polyvinyl chloride pastes; and polyurethanes (PU), including methylene diphenyl diisocyanate, hexamethylene diisocyanate, adhesives, coating resins, elastomers, polyisocyanates for PU paints, and polyols. It serves agriculture, automotive, building and construction, bulk commodities, communications, consumer goods, diagnostics, eco-business, electrical and electronics, food, medical, packaging, personal care, pharmaceuticals, photovoltaics, semiconductor, textiles and clothing, and transportation markets. The company was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

4043.name: TOKUYAMA CORP
4043.business_summary: Tokuyama Corporation produces and sells various chemical products in Japan. It operates through Chemicals, Cement, Advanced Electronic Materials, Life Science, Environmental Business, and Others segments. The Chemicals segment offers caustic soda, soda ash, calcium chloride, sodium silicate cullet, sodium bicarbonate, purifeed, vinyl chloride monomer, polyvinyl chloride resin, propylene oxide, methylene chloride, polyrotaxanes, and chloroform. Its Cement segment provides cement, ready-mixed concrete as well as engages in the recycling and environment business. The Advanced Electronic Materials segment provides polycrystalline silicon; fumed silica and tetrachlorosilane; aluminum nitride; high-purity chemicals for electronics manufacturing and photoresist developer; and isopropyl alcohol. Its Life Science segment provides medical diagnosis systems, dental materials and photochromic materials, advanced pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates, health foods, plastic lens-related materials for glasses, and microporous film. The Environment Business segment offers plastic window sashes, ion exchange membranes, as well as engages in waste gypsum board recycling activity. The company was formerly known as Tokuyama Soda Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tokuyama Corporation in April 1994. Tokuyama Corporation was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4044.name: CENTRAL GLASS CO
4044.business_summary: Central Glass Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the chemical and glass businesses in Japan, Asia, Europe, and internationally. It offers glassware and automotive products, electronic materials, semiconductor, pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals, housing and industrial facilities, fluorine products, heat insulation materials, batteries, fertilizers, and other products. The company was formerly known as Ube Soda Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Central Glass Co., Ltd. in 1963. Central Glass Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1936 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

4045.name: TOAGOSEI CO LTD
4045.business_summary: Toagosei Co., Ltd. Manufactures and sells chemical products. The company operates through Core Chemicals Business, Polymer/Oligomer Business, Adhesive Materials Business, High-performance Materials Business, Resin Processed Products Business, and Other segments. It provides commodity chemicals, such as liquid caustic soda, liquid chlorine, synthetic hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, caustic potash, super potash, iron perchloride solution, and Aron Zia Clean 200 hypochlorous acid solution; acrylic acid, acrylic esters, acrylamide tertiary butyl sulfonic acid, and ethylene carbonate; and oxygen, nitrogen, and argon industrial gases. The company also provides dispersants, thickeners, scale inhibitors, pressure sensitive adhesives, binders, paint vehicles, gelling agents, graft polymers, ARUFON, and macromonomers acrylic polymer products, as well as polymer flocculant; and adhesive materials, including instant glue, Aron Alpha, light-curable adhesives, high functional reactive adhesives, hot melt adhesives, film adhesives, silsesquioxane derivative, and powder paints. In addition, it offers high-purity inorganic chemicals, inorganic functional materials, and cellulose nano fiber performance chemicals; construction and civil engineering products comprising acrylic rubber protective coatings and waterproofing materials. The company operates in Japan, the United States, China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Korea, and internationally. Toagosei Co., Ltd. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

4046.name: OSAKA SODA CO LTD
4046.business_summary: Osaka Soda Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells basic and functional chemicals products in Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. It offers caustic soda, hydrochloric acid, liquid chlorine, chlorine gas, sodium hypochlorite, sodium chlorite, sodium chlorate, caustic potash, hydrogen gas, epichlorohydrin, allyl chloride, etc. The company also provides Allyl Ethers; EPICHLOMER, an epichlorohydrin rubber; RACRESTER acrylic rubber; DAISO DAP, a diallyl phthalates; RADPAR, a non-phthalate allyl resin; CABRUS, polysulfide silane coupling agent; and electrodes, etc. In addition, it offers silica gel for HPLC DAISOGEL; analytical equipment; CAPCELL PAK, HPLC column; active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates; and optically active substances etc. Further, the company is involved in the sale, transportation, and storage of chemical products, consumer products, building materials, materials recycling etc. Osaka Soda Co., Ltd. was formerly known as DAISO Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Osaka Soda Co., Ltd. in October 2015. The company was incorporated in 1915 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

4047.name: KANTO DENKA KOGYO CO
4047.business_summary: Kanto Denka Kogyo Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells various chemical products in Japan, rest of Asia, Europe, and America. It operates in five segments: Fundamental Chemicals; Fine Chemicals; Ferrochemicals Division; Commercial Business; and Facilities. The company offers fluorochemicals products, including carbon and silicon tetrafluoride; monofluoromethane; difluoromethane; trifluoromethane; hexafluoroethane; octafluoropropane; octafluorocyclobutane; hexafluro-1, 3-butadiene; sulfur and tungsten hexafluoride; nitrogen and chlorine trifluoride; carbonyl sulfide; and fluorochemical mix gases for semiconductors, liquid crystal and LCDs, optical fibers, and high-capacity transformers. It also provides lithium hexafluorophosphate and tetrafluoroborate for battery materials; and ferrochemicals, such as reprographic carriers and magnetite for printers and environmentally friendly carriers. In addition, the company offers inorganic products comprising liquid caustic soda, hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, and aluminum chloride; and organic products, which include trichloroethylene, perchloroethylene, vinylidene chloride, and cyclohexanol for paper and pulp, water treatment, cleaning of metal parts, and hydrofluorocarbon applications. Further, it engages in the provision of container maintenance and insurance agency services; manufacture, processing, and repair of chemical industrial equipment; and facility-related construction works. Kanto Denka Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

404A.name: GLOBAL X JAPAN CO LTD GLOBAL X
404A.name_from_universe: グローバルＸ　チャイナテック・トップ１０　ＥＴＦ

4051.name: GMO FINANCIAL GATE INC
4051.name_from_universe: ＧＭＯフィナンシャルゲート
4051.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4051.business_summary: GMO Financial Gate, Inc. provides cashless payment infrastructure in Japan. It offers multi payment terminals, embedded payment terminals, and processing center solutions. It also offers passing card/QR code payment solutions, credit card payments, electronic money payments. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan. GMO Financial Gate, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of GMO Payment Gateway, Inc.

4052.name: FICHA INC
4052.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4052.business_summary: Ficha Inc. develops and sells image recognition software for car cameras in Japan. The company provides object detection software for the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS); the Driver Monitoring System (DMS), a system for monitoring the driver's driving condition with an in-vehicle camera to prevent dangerous driving and accidents; and Occupant Monitoring System (OMS), a system monitors the condition of passengers using in-vehicle cameras, detects dangerous postures, dispenses airbags, and prevents children from being left behind. It also offers AI-OCR, a software that detects character areas from texts on various forms, as well as recognizes printed and handwritten characters; and various solutions for traffic monitoring, infrastructure control, people flow analysis, etc. Ficha Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Toshima, Japan.

4053.name: SUN INC
4053.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4053.business_summary: Sun* Inc. engages in the digital creative studio business in Japan. The company offers creative and engineering services, including support for business design, prototype development, full development, and growth. It also provides talent platform services to support new business development and digital transformation. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4054.name: JAPAN PROPTECH CO LTD
4054.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4054.business_summary: Japan PropTech Co.,Ltd. develops and sells real estate operations support services in Japan. It provides inter-agent property distribution services, including RearPro BB Management that manages information on managed properties and RearPro BB Brokerage, which allows users to view published property information. The company also offers brokerage operation support services, such as Lead Management System, Web advertising management service, property data linkage, IT emphasis, real estate sales support system, property search engine API, rental sales support system, Kurasapo real estate search site, and electronic payment services, as well as WebManagerPro3, a real estate website production software. In addition, it provides administrative support services comprising contract signing, entry/exit management, rent payment management, owner remittance, and building repair management; consumer support services; and construction estimate system. The company was formerly known as Nihon Jyoho Create Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Japan PropTech Co.,Ltd. in September 2023. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Miyakonojo, Japan.

4055.name: T&S GROUP INC
4055.name_from_universe: ティアンドエスグループ
4055.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4055.business_summary: T&S Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides system development and operation/maintenance services in Japan. It offers artificial intelligence (AI) software development solutions comprising software solutions for Hailo Edge AI processors, Generative AI-assisted software development support, AI algorithm research and development support, and AI software development services; system development solutions, including business and cloud applications, and medical and embedded systems development, as well as software acceleration solutions; and information technology (IT) infrastructure construction solutions, such as server and network design and construction services. The company also provides system maintenance and operation solutions comprising migration support, version up, and maintenance and operation services; software engineering services, including IT support, infrastructure maintenance, and operation services, as well as information security services; and system verification solutions, such as on-premises and cloud applications verification, embedded system verification, and performance testing and test automation tools. The company was formerly known as T&S inc. and changed its name to T&S Group Inc. in June 2024. T&S Group Inc. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

4056.name: NEURAL GROUP INC
4056.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4056.business_summary: Neural Group Inc. offers AI and media services. The company provides DigiFlow for creation of smart city solutions for people, goods and security, mobility and moving vehicles, and infrastructure and facilities; and DigiPark, which provides parking lot operators, logistics facilities, real estate developers, commercial facilities, tourist facilities, SA/PA, and public parking lots with safety monitoring and guidance services. It also provides SIGN DIGI that provides AI signage services to commercial facilities, office buildings, and smart cities; RemoDesk, a service that ensures business security in a remote environment; and AI MD, an AI-driven fashion trend analysis service that offers information on fashion trends to analyze data from SNS sites, shopping sites, and other services. In addition, the company provides KizunaNavi, 1-on-1 support service; FOCUS CHANNEL, a signage media platform; NeuralVision, an end-to-end service for AI-powered LED vision displays; and Generative Web to edit web pages. Neural Group Inc. was formerly known as Neural Pocket Inc. and changed its name to Neural Group Inc. in June 2023. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4057.name: INTERFACTORY INC
4057.name_from_universe: インターファクトリー
4057.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4057.business_summary: Interfactory, Inc. engages in the cloud commerce platform business in Japan. It operates through Cloud Commerce Platform, E-commerce business growth support project, and Data Utilization Platform Business segments. The company offers EBISUMART a cloud commerce platform system that allows users to build an e-commerce (EC) site; EBISUMART BtoB, a cloud commerce platform that systemizes order processing in business-to-business transactions; EBISUMART Lite, a cloud commerce platform that allows users to build EC sites for small starts; EBISUMART Enterprise, a commerce platform for large-scale EC sites; and EBISU GROWTH, a service that provides support for the growth of EC business. It also provides EBISU PIM, a product data integration platform that integrates the wide variety of product data held by companies. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

4058.name: TOYOKUMO INC
4058.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4058.business_summary: Toyokumo, Inc. develops and provides cloud services in Japan. It offers Safety Confirmation Service II, a safety confirmation system that enables discussions and instructions in an emergency; NotePM, a service that allows for centralized management of knowledge and know-how; Toyokumo Scheduler, a group scheduler that enables coordination of schedules with external partners; FormBridge, an input to kintone from a web form; and kViewer to create a web page to publish kintone data. The company also provides kMailer, which sends emails to addresses registered in kintone; PrintCreator for output kintone data as a document; DataCollect to aggregate kintone data; and kBackup to back up kintone data. The company was formerly known as Cybozu Startups, Inc. and changed its name to Toyokumo, Inc. in July 2019. Toyokumo, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

4059.name: MAGMAG INC
4059.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4059.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4059.business_summary: Magmag, Inc. engages in the development and operation of content distribution platform in Japan. It operates through Platform, Media Advertising, and Others segments. The company operates MagMag!, an email newsletter distribution platform; MagOne, a fan site platform; MAG2NEWS, which provides news analysis and column articles in the fields of politics, economics, business, entertainment, science, and others; MONEY VOICE, an economic media site that provides information for investors on stocks, foreign exchange, bonds, futures, real estate, and others; TRIP EDITOR, a travel web media outlet; and by them, a love web media service, as well as MagMag Reader App, which allows users to view email newsletter content through an app. It is also involved in the planning, development, and operation of Internet media; operation and sale of advertising space to be placed in web media and email newsletters; and event planning and management activities. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan. Magmag, Inc. is a subsidiary of AirTrip Corp.

405A.name: KOYAMA MIRAIE CO LTD
405A.business_summary: Koyama Miraie Co.,Ltd engages in the purchase and sale of used cars. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Fuji, Japan.

4060.name: RAKUMO INC
4060.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4060.business_summary: rakumo Inc. develops and markets cloud extension tools in Japan. The company offers products, including rakumo for Google Workspace, a cloud-based business platform tool for calendar and address book sharing, electronic approval system, electronic bulletin board, expense settlement system, and time attendance management system. It also provides rakumo for Salesforce that synchronizes and link with Salesforce calendar, as well as connect with client and sales data; and aloopj and gamba!, an in-house SNS-type daily report app for daily reports, labor productivity, and internal communication. In addition, it offers SmartVisionIR for video production and distribution activities. Further, it sells information and communication devices, and software products; and provides support services. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4061.name: DENKA COMPANY LIMITED
4061.business_summary: Denka Company Limited manufactures and sells organic and inorganic, electronic material, pharmaceutical, and resin-related products in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through Electronic & Innovative Products; Life Innovation; Elastomers & Infrastructure Solutions; Polymer Solutions; and Other Business segments. The Electronic & Innovative Products segment manufactures and sells electronic packaging materials, fine and functional ceramics, fused silica, acetylene black, electronic circuit substrates, industrial tapes, functional films, spherical alumina, electrical constructional materials, adhesives, adhesive and electrical tapes, monosilane gas, and semiconductor processing materials. Its Life Innovation segment develops influenza vaccines, antigen testing kits, diagnostic reagents, and oncolytic virus agents. The Elastomers & Infrastructure Solutions segment produces functional elastomers, such as chloroprene rubber; cement; special cement additives; fire resistant and environmental materials; construction chemicals; alumina fibers; fused phosphate fertilizers, as well as humic acid magnesium and liquid fertilizers; calcium carbide; and polyethylene corrugated pipes. Its Polymer Solutions segment consisting of styrene monomers, polystyrene and ABS resins, transparent and heat-resistant resins, resins for shrink labels, food packaging sheets and films, synthetic fibers for wigs, POVAL, and CLEAREN. The Other Business segment engages in plant engineering and trading businesses. The company was formerly known as Denki Kagaku Kogyo Kabushiki Kaisha and changed its name to Denka Company Limited in October 2015. Denka Company Limited was incorporated in 1915 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

4062.name: IBIDEN CO LTD
4062.business_summary: Ibiden Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells electronic and ceramics products in Japan, Asia, North America, and internationally. The company offers printed circuit boards; plastic packaging; and integrated circuit package substrates used as microprocessor units for personal computers and data centers, as well as graphic processing units for AI and vehicles. It also provides diesel particulate filter substrates for passenger cars mounted with diesel engines, buses, and tracks; substrate holding mats for automobiles, construction machinery, and agricultural equipment; high temperature insulating wools for heat processing devices in energy industrial facilities, molten metal casting apparatuses, fuel cells, and high-heat part insulating materials for combustion devices; graphite specialty for single crystal pulling apparatuses for silicon and SiC, auto and aviation electric discharge machining electrode, and industrial materials for continuous casting and industrial furnaces; and special carbon products, fine ceramic products, and ceramic fines. In addition, the company is involved in construction; production of building materials, including decorative interior laminates, as well as bars and food; synthetic resin processing; agricultural and livestock products; maintenance service; marine product processing; sale of petroleum products; information services; environmental engineering technology; medical software package development; sale of information and communication terminals; sale of welfare vehicles; LP gas; styrol automotive components; and electrode for high-precision electric discharge machining. The company was formerly known as Ibigawa Electric Power Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ibiden Co.,Ltd. in November 1982. Ibiden Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1912 and is headquartered in Ogaki, Japan.

4063.name: SHIN-ETSU CHEMICAL CO
4063.business_summary: Shin-Etsu Chemical Co., Ltd. provides infrastructure, electronics, and functional materials in Japan. The company operates through Infrastructure Materials, Functional Materials, Electronics Materials, and Processing & Specialized Services segments. It offers polyvinyl chloride resin, caustic soda, methanol, chloromethanes, and polyvinyl alcohol; and semiconductor silicon, rare earth magnets, semiconductor encapsulating materials, LED packaging materials, photoresists, photomask blanks, and synthetic quartz products. The company also sells silicones, cellulose derivatives, silicon metal, synthetic pheromones, vinyl chloride-vinyl acetate copolymer, liquid fluoroelastomers, pellicles, and silicon anode material for lithium-ion batteries. In addition, it is involved in the processed plastics; export of technologies and plants; export and import of products; and engineering activities. The company was formerly known as Shin-Etsu Nitrogen Fertilizer Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shin-Etsu Chemical Co., Ltd. in 1940. Shin-Etsu Chemical Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4064.name: NIPPON CARBIDE INDUSTRIES CO IN
4064.business_summary: Nippon Carbide Industries Co., Inc. engages in the electronic and functional products, and films and sheetings business in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers functional chemicals, such as electronic materials, coating materials, agrochemicals, metal surface treatment agents, pharmaceutical products, and biochemistry; and functional polymers, including thickening and adhesive agents, resin for dyes and coating materials, and melamine resin for tableware, as well as treating fibers, paper, etc. It also provides semiconductor mold cleaners and conditioners; and ceramic substrates, such as alumina substrates, thick-film printing substrates, and green sheetings. In addition, it offers marking films, laser markable labels, and packaging materials; graphic and 3D-emblem stickers; retroreflective sheetings, aluminum connected sign substrates, and aerial display reflectors. Nippon Carbide Industries Co., Inc. was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4068.name: BASIS CORPORATION
4068.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4068.business_summary: Basis Corporation, an infrastructure technology company, offers IoT engineering services. It provides services, such as design, construction, operation, and maintenance for communications infrastructure, as well as various project support services to telecommunications, electricity, gas, and other infrastructure providers. The company also offers mobile engineering services for a chain of communication infrastructure construction, which includes mobile phone infrastructure, network construction, operation monitoring, and maintenance; and area design, station placement, and construction. In addition, it provides IoT engineering services, such as installation, replacement, operation and monitoring, and network construction of IoT devices. In addition, it provides IT engineering services for networks, servers, and cloud computing. The company serves telecommunications carriers, telecommunications equipment manufacturers, electric power companies, and gas companies. Basis Corporation was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

4069.name: BLUEMEME INC
4069.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4069.business_summary: BlueMeme Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the DX business in Japan. The company offers Outsystems, a low-code development platform, including rich grid component, SVF cloud connector, Omnext, and document generations services; MarkLogic, a multi-model database; Workato, an integration platform that automates various workflows that require collaboration between multiple applications with low code; Creatio, a no-code BPM platform for business applications that automates and visualizes business processes; and mabl, an AI-based test automation platform that enables low-code automatic testing of workflows, visuals, APIs, browser compatibility, and others. It also provides consulting services, including low-code implementation assessment services, business analysis and requirements definition services, remote technical support for business application development, and proposal for the development of AGILE-DX; contract development services, such as low-code contract development, source code migration services, and BlueMeme digital agent services; seminars and training of low code engineers; and sale and support of software products. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

406A.name: KANKYOU NO MIKATA HLDGS INC
406A.name_from_universe: 環境のミカタホールディングス
406A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
406A.business_summary: KANKYOU NO MIKATA Holdings Inc. engages in the environmental coordination business. The company is involved in waste management, and general and industrial waste recycling business; and waste and resource logistics, public-sector services, digital device reuse, and other businesses, including fuel sales, roll services, eco-power, and real estate leasing, future energy supply, administrative contract, EC site sale, and town production businesses. It serves manufacturers in beverages, foods, seafood processing, electrical equipment, pharmaceutical, and hygiene industries, as well as individual restaurants. KANKYOU NO MIKATA Holdings Inc. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Fujieda, Japan.

4071.name: PLUS ALPHA CONSULTING CO LTD
4071.name_from_universe: プラスアルファ・コンサルティング
4071.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4071.business_summary: Plus Alpha Consulting Co.,Ltd. provides marketing and HR solutions in japan. The company develops and operates Visualization Engine, a customer experience feedback system; ALPHA SCOPE, a FAQ solution; CustomerRings, a customer relationship management/MA system; Talent Palette, a talent management system; Kimisuka, a new graduate direct recruiting service platform. It also engages in recruitment consulting and consulting business; and provision of work shift creation and management system for the retail and service industry. In addition, the company offers solutions, including Mieruka Engine, Yorisoar, Hlcare Wellness, Sales Square, and Talensfer. Plus Alpha Consulting Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4072.name: DENSAN SYSTEM HLDGS CO LTD
4072.name_from_universe: 電算システムホールディングス
4072.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4072.business_summary: Densan System Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides information and collection agency services in Japan. It offers solutions for data processing, systems integration, and software development, including integrated payment, payment acceptance, and settlement services, as well as information technology services. The company also provides cloud services; data entry works; digital and credit guarantee type payment services; payment processing system; computer system development, maintenance, operation, and quality inspection; information system planning, design, management, operation, and consulting; sales of computer-related equipment and peripherals; and worker dispatch business related to information processing. In addition, it is involved in the planning, development, operation, and sale of ASP systems for the oil sales industry; IT consulting; website design and construction; system design and construction; internet service management; internet information provision; import and sale of cybersecurity products; cybersecurity business consulting; and optical fiber, multimedia, data transfer systems. The company was formerly known as Densan System Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Densan System Holdings Co., Ltd. in July 2021. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Gifu, Japan.

4073.name: GLOBAL COMMUNICATION PLANNING C
4073.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4073.business_summary: Global Communication Planning Co.,Ltd. offers cashless payment services. The company provides CARD CREW PLUS, a cashless payment system; payment terminals; and contract development services. It also provides payment ASP and operation services, as well as payment terminal subscription services. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Sakura, Japan.

4074.name: LAKEEL INC
4074.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4074.business_summary: LaKeel, Inc. provides product, consulting, and professional services in Japan. The company offers LaKeel DX, a cloud platform that digitizes the enterprise and effectuates strategic IT; LaKeel BI, a self-service business intelligence (BI) tool; and LaKeel Data Insight, an enterprise data management solution. It also provides LaKeel HR, a human resources software; LaKeel online media services for video distribution; LaKeel messenger, a messaging tool; LaKeel eDocument, an electronic books preservation software; LaKeel workflow, a system that allow to build an electronic application and approval system; LaKeel passport, an ID management platform; and LaKeel commerce provides e-commerce solutions. In addition, the company offers LaKeel My Number, an own number for employees and their family members in lump sum; LaKeel Stress Check, a stress check tool for enterprise; LaKeel Survey, an employee survey tools; and LaKeel Process Manager, a business process management platform. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4075.name: BRAINS TECHNOLOGY INC
4075.name_from_universe: ブレインズテクノロジー
4075.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4075.business_summary: Brains Technology, Inc., an enterprise AI software company, develops and provides data search and data analysis products and services using AI and machine learning. It offers Impulse, an anomaly detection solution; and Neuron ES, an enterprise search engine. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4076.name: CNS CO LTD
4076.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
4076.business_summary: CNS Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides system engineering services in Japan. It offers system integration services, including cloud environment construction, infrastructure environment construction, application development, modernization, data utilization/analysis, SAS introduction support, and ServiceNow implementation support; U-Way oracle cloud infrastructure, U-Way oracle cloud VMware solution, and U-Way Lite OCI base model services; and DX, technology, and business consulting services. The company also provides system infrastructure, big data analysis, and digital innovation promotion services; and DX literacy education and human resource development accompaniment support services. CNS Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4078.name: SAKAI CHEMICAL INDUSTRY CO
4078.business_summary: Sakai Chemical Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells various chemical products in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, the Middle East, and internationally. It operates through Electronic Materials; Cosmetic Materials; Organic Chemicals; Sanitary Materials; Contract Processing; Titanium Oxide and Zinc Products; Resin Additives; Catalyst; Inorganic Material; Medical Business; and Others. The company offers titanium dioxide used in a range of applications, including paints, printer inks, paper manufacturing, plastics, chemical fibers, rubber, porcelain enamel, optical glass, and capacitors; barium and strontium salt products; and zinc oxide for electronic materials, cosmetics, and heat-dissipation. It also provides plastic additives, such as metallic soap, hydrotalcite, and flame retardants, as well as calcium/zinc-based composite stabilizers; catalysts comprising De-NOx/De-DXN, hydrogenation, titanium catalysts for polyester polymerization, titanium dioxide for catalyst carriers, and catalysts for raw materials of synthetic fibers; and electronic materials, which includes dielectric and piezoelectric ceramics, spherical silica, and secondary batteries and electrode materials. In addition, the company offers cosmetic raw materials, such as titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, barium, calcium, water repellent pigments, and cosmetic inorganic fluorescent materials; pharmaceuticals, comprising prescription and OTC drugs, health foods, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and pharmaceutical intermediates. Further, it provides organic chemical products containing sulfur and phosphorus for electronics, resin materials, healthcare, lubricants, and water treatment materials sectors; and road marking materials for compartment lines, road markings, expressways, and braille sheets. The company exports its products. Sakai Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

407A.name: UNICON HOLDINGS CO. LTD.
407A.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
407A.business_summary: Unicon Holdings Co., Ltd. provides construction and related business services. It engages in the civil engineering and building construction activities. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in Sendai, Japan.

4082.name: DAIICHI KIGENSO KAGAKU-KOGYO CO
4082.business_summary: Daiichi Kigenso Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells zirconium compounds and other inorganic compounds in Japan and internationally. The company provides zirconium oxide, electro-melting stabilized zirconium oxide, complex oxide, cesium compounds, cesium flux wires, rings, rare earth compounds, zirconium silicate, various sol, and non-oxide zirconium products, as well as various metal sulfides; and zirconia for advanced ceramics and solid oxide fuel cells. It also provides warehousing and general cargo trucking services. The company's products are used in automobile and industrial catalysts; fuel cells and oxygen sensors; structural, dental, electronic, refractories and brakes, aluminum brazing, and coatings and metal surface treatment materials. Daiichi Kigenso Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1929 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

4088.name: AIR WATER INC
4088.business_summary: Air Water Inc. engages in manufacturing selling products and services related to industrial gas, chemical, medical, energy, agriculture and food products, logistics, seawater, and other businesses in Japan. It operates through the Digital & Industry, Energy Solutions, Health & Safety, Agriculture & Foods, and Other Business segments. The Digital & Industry segment manufactures and sells industrial gases including oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide, and hydrogen, and electronic and functional materials. Its Energy Solutions segment is involved in the sale of LP gas and kerosene, as well as the manufacture and sale of liquid nitrogen gas-related equipment. The Health & Safety segment offers oxygen and other medical gases, dental and hygiene materials, hypodermic needles, and aerosol products, as well as hospital facility construction, hospital services, and home medical care services. Its Agriculture & Foods segment is involved in the process and distribution of vegetables and fruits; manufacture and sale of frozen food and processed meat products; and operation of contract manufacture of soft drinks. The Other Business segment consists of logistics services for general cargo, food, medical supplies, and environmental products; manufacture and sale of commercial use salt; supply of high-output uninterruptible power sources; and a woody biomass power generation business. It also engages in the operation and maintenance of high-pressure gas production plants; metal surface hardening treatment services; and design and manufacture of robot systems, jigs, and tools. It also manufactures and sells industrial rubber products and resin products; precision polishing pads and artificial leather; magnesium oxide, fused magnesia, magnesium hydroxide, and ceramic products; electrothermal magnesia; and rubber molded products. The company also designs, manufactures, and sells dental care products. The company was incorporated in 1929 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

408A.name: BLACKROCK JAPAN CO LTD ISHARES
408A.name_from_universe: ｉシェアーズ　ＡＩ　グローバル・イノベーション　アクティブ　ＥＴＦ

4091.name: NIPPON SANSO HOLDINGS CORPORATI
4091.name_from_universe: 日本酸素ホールディングス
4091.business_summary: Nippon Sanso Holdings Corporation engages in the gas business in Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia, and Oceania. It operates through five segments: Japan, United States, Europe, Asia and Oceania, and Thermos. The company offers oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide, helium, hydrogen, acetylene; gas-related equipment; and specialty gases, such as electronic material gases, pure gases, etc. It also provides installation, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, fusing equipment, welding materials, plants and machinery, liquefied petroleum gas, and related equipment, as well as medical gases, medical equipment, and stable isotopes. In addition, it offers housewares and consumer goods, such as stainless-steel vacuum bottles. The company was formerly known as Taiyo Nippon Sanso Corporation and changed its name to Nippon Sanso Holdings Corporation in October 2020. Nippon Sanso Holdings Corporation was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Nippon Sanso Holdings Corporation is a subsidiary of Mitsubishi Chemical Group Corporation.

4092.name: NIPPON CHEMICAL INDUSTRIAL CO
4092.business_summary: Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various chemical products in Japan. The company provides inorganic chemical products, including chromium compounds, phosphorus compounds, silicates and silica products, and other inorganic chemicals, such as lithium chloride solution N, sodium sulfate, sodium bisulfate, potassium permanganate, and cuprous oxides. It also offers specialty chemicals, such as electronic ceramic materials, barium compounds, circuit materials, battery materials, organic phosphorus compounds, pharmaceutical intermediates and agrochemicals, semiconductor materials, as well as other specialty products comprising thiourea; and custom manufacturing. In addition, the company manufactures and sells phosphine derivatives, agricultural chemicals, battery materials, electronic ceramic materials, circuit materials, and high-purity electronic materials. Additionally, it engages in leasing land and buildings to hospitals and retail businesses. Further, the company exports its products to Southeast Asia and other countries. The company was formerly known as Nippon Seiren Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. in March 1944. Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1893 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4093.name: TOHO ACETYLENE CO
4093.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4093.business_summary: Toho Acetylene Co., Ltd. provides gas and equipment related products in Japan. The company offers high pressure gases, including acetylene, oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide, hydrogen, mixed gas, and other gases; frozen deburring device for rubber and die-cast products; low temperature reaction control system; biogas related equipment; and steel and machinery related products. It also provides LP gas and related equipment, and oil and gas related products; petroleum related fuels, such as heating oil and industrial fuel oil; life related equipment comprising kitchen equipment, hot water supply bathroom related equipment, and LP gas supply and safety equipment; and eco energy related products, such as solar power generation systems, household fuel cells, and solar power LED streetlights. In addition, the company offers industrial machinery products comprising acetylene, seamless, and ultra-low temperature liquefied gas containers; welding materials; welding fusion equipment consisting of welding machines, welding robots, laser processing machines, and safety protection equipment; cleaning equipment and agents; and gas cutters, burners, high-pressure gas pressure regulators, gas hoses, cap tires, anti-spatter agents, etc. Further, it provides medical gases, such as oxygen, nitrogen, laughing, carbon dioxide, sterilized gas, and liquid helium; medical equipment; home treatment-related services; medical related services; and food additives, nitrous oxide, barber gas, and functional ingredients, as well as operates Ecolab. Toho Acetylene Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tagajo, Japan.

4094.name: NIHON KAGAKU SANGYO CO
4094.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4094.business_summary: Nihon Kagaku Sangyo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial chemicals and building materials in Japan and internationally. It offers various inorganic metal products, including copper, tin, nickel, cobalt, bismuth, chromium, manganese, antimony, zinc, iron, and lithium compounds; organic metal compounds, such as metal acetylacetonate, metallic soaps, PUCAT, and PA series products; surface treatment agents, including anodized aluminum treatment, electro plating, electro plating brightener/additives, electroless plating, etchant agent, and rust prevention; and other compounds. The company's chemical products are used in various industries, such as optical/precision instruments, electronics, ceramics, petrochemical catalysis, healthcare, and battery materials. It also develops fireproof, waterproof, and ventilation building materials; and heat exchangers, as well as offers stainless-steel handrails and mailboxes; fabricated metal products for industrial use; and materials used in eaves, as well as pipe space/blindfold covers and exterior products. The company was incorporated in 1924 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4095.name: NIHON PARKERIZING CO
4095.name_from_universe: 日本パーカライジング
4095.business_summary: Nihon Parkerizing Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and supply of surface treatment chemicals in Japan and internationally. It supplies surface treatment chemicals for cleaning substrates, adding corrosion resistance, creating a base for painting, and providing lubrications; emulsion type rolling oil for rolling steel and cooling applications; heat exchangers, as well as offers technical support services. The company also provides rust prevention, heat treatment, and rust stabilizing treatment services. In addition, it offers conversion coating, rubricant for deformation, lubricant for deformation, solid lubricant and rustproof coatings, salt-bath nitriding and carburizing, austemper treatment, composite plating, and plasma electrolytic oxidation services, as well as provides WEATHERCOAT, a surface treatment technology to develop rust layer on weathering steel. Further, the company provides rust preventive oils, paints, industrial cleaners, and electroless nickel plating liquids; manufactures and sells metal surface treatment and coating equipment; and offers building maintenance services. Additionally, the company is involved in solar power generation. Nihon Parkerizing Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1928 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4097.name: KOATSU GAS KOGYO CO
4097.business_summary: Koatsu Gas Kogyo Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the gas and chemical products businesses in Japan. It provides dissolved acetylene gas for welding, cutting, heating, removing glass and copper wire from molds, pharmaceutical synthesis, and carbon raw materials applications; laser gas and mixed gas for various applications, such as laser processing, welding, sterilization, biotechnology, and food products; separated gas used analytical instruments for measuring the concentration of various air pollutants, automobile exhaust gas and flue gas, and calibration of gas detectors; LP gas/LNG for cutting/heating and fuel applications; agricultural carbon dioxide; gas cylinders; and safety systems. The company also offers chemical products, such as adhesives, PEGAR, a synthetic resin emulsion, and CYANON, an adhesive made from a cyanoacrylate monomer. Further, it offers RF tag related devices and their application systems, which used for railway equipment management and recognition of production lines; GNSS receiver modules; and LSI card and reader writers. Koatsu Gas Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

4098.name: TITAN KOGYO K.K.
4098.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4098.business_summary: Titan Kogyo, Ltd. engages in the production and sale of industrial chemicals primarily in Japan. The company offers titanium oxide, ultrafine titanium oxide, and titanium oxide for cosmetics; conductive inorganic oxide; titanium oxide lithium; synthetic iron oxide; iron oxide pearl pigments; and iron sulfate. The company was incorporated in 1936 and is headquartered in Ube, Japan.

4099.name: SHIKOKU KASEI HOLDINGS CORPORAT
4099.name_from_universe: 四国化成ホールディングス
4099.business_summary: Shikoku Kasei Holdings Corporation engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of chemical products and housing materials in Japan and internationally. It offers carbon disulfide and hydrogen sulfide, sodium sulfate and carbonate, insoluble sulfur, and chlorinated isocyanurates; organic solderability preservative; chemical adhesion process; microetching solution; imidazole type and adduct type latent curing agents; adhesion and heat resistance improver; isocyanuric acid derivatives; glycoluril derivatives; cationic curing materials; and THEIC materials. The company provides automatic chlorine feeders, bacteria enzymes, and urinary calculus removers; and industrial chemicals, pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, fertilizers, and agricultural chemicals. In addition, it offers housing materials comprising interior finishing and paving materials, and residential and landscape exterior products. Further, the company is involved in the design, production, development, and installation of shutters and other retail outlet fixtures, as well as provides technical services; development and sale of computer software; management of computer systems; operation of the Mosburger chain of hamburger shops; sale of giftware and daily use products; design, installation, and maintenance management of water treatment for sewage and septic tanks; construction of drainage pipe connection; inspection and cleaning of water storage tanks; collection and transportation of general and industrial waste materials; provision of information services; damage-insurance and life-insurance agency; packaging and transportation; and housing renovation and solar photovoltaic generation activities. Additionally, it offers environmental measurement authentication, and quality testing of drinking water services; construction materials; and design and construction of related facilities. Shikoku Kasei Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Marugame, Japan.

409A.name: ORION BREWERIES LTD
409A.business_summary: ORION BREWERIES, LTD. manufactures and sells alcohol and soft drinks. The company also engages in the operation of hotels and facilities. The company was formerly known as Okinawa Breweries, Ltd. and changed its name to ORION BREWERIES, LTD. In January 1959. The company was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Tomigusuku, Japan.

4100.name: TODA KOGYO CORP
4100.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4100.business_summary: TODA KOGYO CORP. manufactures and sells functional pigments and electronic materials in Japan and internationally. It offers electronic printing materials, including toner materials for printers and copying machines, carriers for color printers and copying machines, and magnetic materials for printers and copying machines, as well as high-chroma pigments for use in cosmetics. The company also provides metal-compatible IC/NFC tags, flexible ferrite sheets, complex noise suppression sheets, multi-functional compounds, noise suppression compound for electric wires and cables, wireless power charger coils for wearable devices, and ultra-thin flexible ferrite sheets; and flexible ferrite sheets for RFID, WPC, digitizers, noise suppression, and NFC antennas. In addition, it offers lithium cobaltate, lithium-nickel oxide, and lithium manganate battery materials for personal computers, mobile phones, hybrid cars, and industrial applications; and electronic materials for inductors and capacitors, magnetic recording materials for magnetic cards, and magnetic materials for general purpose and advanced applications. Further, the company provides environmentally functional and raw materials for lead-free vinyl chloride stabilizers; anion catchers for various resins; dioxin reduction and functional compounds for crow-repellent garbage bags, etc.; ligneous biomass hydrogen production systems; and CO2 reduction systems. Additionally, it offers pigments for colored pavements, reflective pigments to combat the heat island phenomenon, non-lead pigments for center lines, and pigments for coatings and resins; magnetic recording materials for digital recording media used with computers and video tapes for broadcasting; and electromagnetic wave shielding materials for displays and catalysts for fuel cells. TODA KOGYO CORP. was founded in 1823 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

4102.name: MARUO CALCIUM CO
4102.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4102.business_summary: Maruo Calcium Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various calcium carbonate and other industrial raw materials in Japan. Its products include various type of colloidal calcium carbonates; light calcium carbonates; ground calcium carbonates; food-additive calcium carbonates; animal feeds; hydrated and quick lime; wet silica products; and minerals, including talc, clay, and silica powder. The company also imports and distributes wet silica products. Its products are used in sealants/adhesives/plastisols, films, plastics, paints, inks, rubber, food additives, and other applications. The company was formerly known as Maruo Seifun Goshi Company and changed its name to Maruo Calcium Co., Ltd. in August 1963. Maruo Calcium Co., Ltd. was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Akashi, Japan.

4107.name: ISE CHEMICALS CORP
4107.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4107.business_summary: ISE Chemicals Corporation engages in the iodine and natural gas, and metallic compound businesses in Japan. It offers iodine products, such as ISEFLO, a prilled iodine; crude iodine; potassium, sodium, and cuprous iodide, as well as hydroiodic acid. The company also provides metallic compounds, including nickel chloride, cobalt chloride, cobalt hydroxide, and tricobalt tetraoxide; and extracts and supplies natural gas to gas companies and factories. Its products are used in medical, feed additives, disinfectants, and electronic component industries. The company was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan. ISE Chemicals Corporation is a subsidiary of AGC Inc.

4109.name: STELLA CHEMIFA
4109.business_summary: Stella Chemifa Corporation manufactures and sells high-purity chemical products in Japan and internationally. It offers hydrofluoric acid, buffered hydrofluoric acid, and etching solutions used in semiconductors and liquid crystal products; calcium, aluminum, lithium, strontium, barium, magnesium, lead fluoride and fluoride nanoparticles used in optical materials; and lithium hexafluorophosphate and fluoride nanoparticles for batteries. The company also provides boron trifluoride, boron trifluoride diethyl ether, boron trifluoride dimethyl ether, boron trifluoride n-butyl ether, boron trifluoride tetrahydrofuran, boron trifluoride phenol, boron trifluoride monoethyl amine, boron trifluoride piperidine, and triethylamine 3HF used in reactive catalysts; and hydrofluoric acid, ammonium fluoride, ammonium hydrogenfluoride, and borofluoride used in surface treatment and alternatives for CFCs. In addition, it offers potassium fluoroborate and boric acid for nuclear energy applications; tin fluoride (II) USP used in GMP-compliant products; and other products, such as potassium fluoride, calcium fluoride, potassium hexafluorozirconate, potassium hexafluorotitanate, sodium fluoride, potassium fluorosilicate, sodium hexafluorosilicate, magnesium hexafluorosilicate, fluoroboric acid, zinc fluoroborate, potassium fluorosilicate, tin fluoroborate, copper fluoroborate, sodium fluoroborate, lead fluoroborate, ammonium hydrogenfluoride, and potassium hexafluorophosphate. Further, the company transportation business, including shipping, custom brokerage, warehousing, and container services. Additionally, it develops Boron Neutron Capture therapy for the treatment of cancer. The company was formerly known as Hashimoto Chemical Corporation and changed its name to Stella Chemifa Corporation in 1997. Stella Chemifa Corporation was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

410A.name: GMO COMMERCE INC
410A.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
410A.business_summary: GMO Commerce, Inc. provides marketing support for e-commerce and brick-and-mortar stores. It also develops and provides marketing platforms that support the improvement of store CX and the promotion of DX. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Tokyo, Japan with an additional office in Miyazaki, Japan. GMO Commerce, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of GMO internet group, Inc.

4112.name: HODOGAYA CHEMICAL CO
4112.business_summary: Hodogaya Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sale of organic industrial chemicals in Japan. The company operates through five segments: Functional Colorants, Specialty Polymers, Basic Chemicals, Agro-Science, and Logistics. The Functional Colorants segment offers emitting, transport, capping layer, bio, imaging, and semiconductor materials, as well as dyes for color filters; and aluminum coloring, stationery, and natural dyes, as well as dyes for hair color treatment. The Specialty Polymers segment provides urethane materials, such as PTG, BIO-PTG, PTG- SOFTENA, etc.; intermediates for pharmaceutical, functional polymers, and electronics; and adhesives and release agents. The segment also offers urethane-based waterproof materials for civil engineering and construction; and provides waterproofing and leak-plugging work services. The Basic Chemicals segment offers hydrogen peroxide; sodium percarbonate used for paper pulp bleaching and industrial chemicals; peracetic acid, such as disinfectant agents and food additives; and industrial chemicals. The Agro-Science segment provides herbicides, pesticides, fungicides, and agricultural materials, such as oxygen supply materials used in various fields, including controlling weeds, insect pest management, and environmental conservation for cropland, living environments, railways, forests, and golf courses. The Logistics segment offers warehousing services for general goods as well as hazardous substances and chemicals; consigned freight forwarding; and ISO tank container storage services. The company was formerly known as Hodogaya Soda Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hodogaya Chemical Co., Ltd. in 1939. Hodogaya Chemical Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1916 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

4113.name: TAOKA CHEMICAL CO
4113.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
4113.business_summary: Taoka Chemical Company, Limited manufactures and sells chemicals, functional materials, and resin additives in Japan and internationally. The company provides raw material for resists; one-component epoxy-based adhesives; cyanoacrylate-instant adhesives; and materials for electronic parts, as well as amide and ester imide, nylon, polyester, and polyimide varnishes. It also manufactures paper chemicals and water-soluble polymers; raw materials for drugs and diagnostic agents; and intermediates for agricultural chemicals. In addition, the company offers plasticizer for food product packaging and toys films, lubricants, floor materials, shoes, hoses, inks, rubber gloves, and food containers; methyl ester use in industrial detergents, shell mold applications, fine chemical intermediates, and base materials; dyes for fiber, paper, leather, and plastic; and functional pigments used in polarizing films, stationery, etc., as well as rubber additives, such as resin cross linking agents, tackifiers, and kneading type vulcanizing adhesives. Further, it develops and produces bisphenol derivatives; TBIS, an epoxy derivative; TBIS, an acid dianhydride; episulfide derivatives; and indole derivatives for various compounds for medical and agricultural chemical applications. The company was formerly known as Taoka Dystuffs Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Taoka Chemical Company, Limited in 1972. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Taoka Chemical Company, Limited operates as a subsidiary of Sumitomo Chemical Company, Limited.

4114.name: NIPPON SHOKUBAI CO
4114.business_summary: Nippon Shokubai Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of chemical products in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments: Materials Business and Solutions Business. The Materials Business segment manufactures and sells acrylic acids, acrylates, superabsorbent polymers, ethylene oxides, ethylene glycols, ethanolamine, maleic anhydride, process catalysts, MMA monomers and polymers, and other chemicals. The Solutions Business segment manufactures and sells polymers for concrete admixtures, glycol ether, secondary alcohol ethoxylates, water soluble polymers, intermediates for pharmaceuticals, electronic information materials, iodine compounds, resins for adhesives/paints, ethyleneimine derivatives, processed adhesive products, and automotive catalysts, as well as De-NOx catalysts, dioxins decomposition catalysts, equipment for waste gas treatment, wet air oxidation catalysts, and materials for batteries. It also provides acrylic esters, maleimides, cyclic amides, initiators; water-based, solvent based and soluble polymers; inorganic and organic composite fine particles; and liquefied gas and fuel cell materials. In addition, the company produces and markets industrial materials, civil engineering and construction materials made of synthetic rubber latex or acrylic emulsion as base; and acrylic emulsion and fine products.
