In addition, it offers filter materials for purified water, as well as designs/constructs filter systems; and develops, manufactures, and sells photocatalyst materials for environmental purification. Further, the company develops and sells measurement software systems and automatic measuring systems, as well as transportation of industrial waste, industrial chemicals, scraps, and other waste. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Koriyama, Japan.

5726.name: OSAKA TITANIUM TECHNOLOGIES
5726.name_from_universe: 大阪チタニウムテクノロジーズ
5726.business_summary: OSAKA Titanium technologies Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells titanium products in Japan, the United States of America, China, and internationally. The company offers titanium sponges, titanium ingots, titanium tetrachloride, titanium tetrachloride aqueous solutions, and ferro-titanium products; and high-performance materials, including titanium powder, high-purity titanium, silicon monoxide, as well as gas-atomized titanium powder. Its products are used in aircraft and automobiles, LNG plants, seawater desalination plants, semiconductors, digital home appliances, and leisure and sporting goods industries. The company was formerly known as Sumitomo Titanium Corporation and changed its name to OSAKA Titanium technologies Co.,Ltd. in 2007. OSAKA Titanium technologies Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

5727.name: TOHO TITANIUM CO
5727.business_summary: Toho Titanium Company, Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of titanium metals, catalysts for propylene polymerization, and electronic materials in Japan. It operates through three segments: Titanium Metal Business, Catalyst Business, and Chemicals Business. The company offers titanium metals, such as titanium sponge, titanium ingots, high-purity titanium, titanium powder, and fabricated titanium products. It also provides propylene polymerization catalysts. In addition, the company offers ultra-fine nickel powder, high-purity titanium oxide, titanium tetrachloride, and titanium tetrachloride aqueous solution. Further, the company provides lithium ion-conductive solid-state electrolyte; and WEBTi, a porous titanium sheet for use in filter and electrode materials. Toho Titanium Company, Limited was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan. Toho Titanium Company, Limited is a subsidiary of JX Advanced Metals Corporation.

5729.name: NIHON SEIKO CO LTD
5729.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5729.business_summary: Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells antimony products and metal powders in Japan. It offers antimony trioxide, which is used as a flame-retardant additive for various plastics and rubbers, polyester polymerization catalysts, and solid lubricant in brake pads. The company also provides antimony metal for use in raw materials for semiconductors, film for optical memory disks, thermo-electron converters, storage batteries, bearing metals, hard lead castings, cable sheathing, typemetals, and sheet and pipe alloys; antimony metal powder for glass fining agents and alloys; antimony metal shots for alloys; and copper and antimony metal powder for electric detonators. In addition, it offers special treatment antimony trioxide; sodium antimonate for use in engineering plastics, and decolorization and fining of glasses; antimony trisulfide for use in friction materials, match box flints, fireworks, glass fining agents, powder for toys, and flash mixtures; and antimony pentasulfide for surface treatment of decorative trims and building materials. Further, the company provides antimony trichloride and antimony pentachloride for use as catalysts in fluorination, chlorination, and bromination of organic compounds, pigments, and semiconductor materials; and STEM series products that are mixtures of flame retardants for use in polyolefin plastics, such as PP and PE. Additionally, it manufactures and sells atomized metal powders of copper, tin, bronze, brass, silver, platinum, gold, stainless steel, nickel, nickel alloy, etc. The company was formerly known as Nakase Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. in 1936. Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5741.name: UACJ CORPORATION
5741.business_summary: UACJ Corporation manufactures and sells aluminum products in Japan and internationally. The company offers flat rolled products, including aluminum alloy sheets for beverage containers, closures, automotive panels, railway rolling stocks, and structures; lithographic sheets; foil stocks; aluminum brazing sheets; high-thermal-conductivity heat exchanger CC Al-Fe-Ni alloy fin stocks; coated aluminum sheets; aluminum alloy quenched sheets for aircraft; aluminum alloy plates for moss LNG tank; aluminum alloys for lithium-ion battery housing cases and sealing materials; aluminum alloy thick plates; bright aluminum alloy sheets; aluminum checkered plates; aluminum alloy sheets with high-thermal conductivity; and material substitution products. It also provides MS Drum uncut high-precision drawn aluminum pipes for photoconductor drums; MF Tube ultraprecision extruded aluminum tubes; continuously drawn aluminum pipes; aluminum alloy extrusions; free-cutting aluminum alloys; precision extruded materials for pneumatic equipment; aluminum alloy pipe and rods; lead-free free-machining aluminum alloys; aluminum extruded and micro shapes; and aluminum alloys for forging, as well as extruded shapes, pipes, and bars. In addition, it offers printed and coated foils, and bonded foils; compressor wheel casting, forged products for vacuum device chamber walls, aluminum forged products for aerospace applications, axle bearing housing for bullet trains, and friction-resistant products for compressors; automotive parts, heat exchangers, plant equipment, and other parts and materials for the industrial sector; and sunroof guide rails, aluminum bumper assemblies, battery materials, crush boxes, and other automotive parts. Further, the company engages in aerospace and defense materials, and extrusion and metal component business. The company was formerly known as Furukawa-Sky Aluminum Corp. UACJ Corporation was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5742.name: NIC AUTOTEC INC
5742.name_from_universe: エヌアイシ・オートテック
5742.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5742.business_summary: NIC Autotec, Inc. manufacture and sells aluminum frame and FA equipment in Japan and internationally. It offers alpha frame system; alpha clean system; aluminum stand for small robots; alpha guard safety fence; alpha kit, aquarium stands, and server racks; and cup-type washing machine/blow machine. The company also provides FA equipment, including washing machines for batch type and individual cleaning; conveyors comprising automatic cartoners, palletizing stackers, free-flow conveyors, and other various conveyors; screening inspection equipment for dimensions, tap failure, running torque, etc.; and cleanroom products. It serves FA equipment for use in machining factories, semi-conductor and electronic parts factories, and pharmaceutical and food factories. The company was formerly known as Nishikawa Seiki Inc. and changed its name to NIC Autotec, Inc. in April 1985. NIC Autotec, Inc. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Toyama, Japan.

5753.name: NIPPON SHINDO CO
5753.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5753.business_summary: Nippon Shindo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of copper and brass rods, forgings, and other products. The company offers brass rods and wires, as well as brass alloys. Its products are used in gas equipment, plumbing products, and air conditioners in the housing industry; screws, bolts, and nuts in the auto industry; and connectors for personal computers and audio equipment in the electronics industry. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

5757.name: CK SAN-ETSU CO LTD
5757.business_summary: CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of brass rod and wire products in Japan, China, and Taiwan. It also offers precision parts through forging and machining activities; plumbing equipment under the CK brand; and hot-dip galvanized metal products. The company was formerly known as SAN-ETSU METALS Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. in October 2011. CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is based in Takaoka, Japan.

5801.name: FURUKAWA ELECTRIC CO
5801.business_summary: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells communications, energy, automotive and batteries products, and electronic components worldwide. It operates through Infrastructure, Electrical and Electronic, Functional Products, and Services and Developments segments. The company offers telecommunications products, such as broadband systems, routers/network equipment, industrial infrastructure systems, and wireless products; and optical fiber cables and identifiers, optical closures/termination boxes, optical connectors/cords, fusion splicers/optical connecting tools, optical fiber line monitoring/management systems, optical active component, and metal communication cables, as well as wiring materials. It also offers energy products, including power cables, cable-related equipment/connection and terminal products, industrial machine-related equipment, fire-prevention products, electrical conductors, power distribution products, and cable conduit materials; and automobile products comprising wire harnesses, connectors, functional products and materials, and interior finishing materials. In addition, the company provides electronics parts materials, fluorescent lamps, LED reflectors, and tapes, as well as healthcare products, such as shape memory/super-elastic alloys; construction products, including water distribution piping and fluid transport piping products, heat insulators, and cable-related equipment/connection and terminal products, as well as power distribution and fire-prevention products; superconducting cables; detection solutions for internal medical devices; and maintenance/inspection support solutions for roadside equipment. Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd. was founded in 1884 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

5802.name: SUMITOMO ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES
5802.business_summary: Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd. manufactures and sells various materials in Japan and internationally. The company operates in Environment and Energy, Infocommunications, Automotive, Electronics, and Industrial Materials segments. It offers vanadium redox flow battery, high voltage cable, sEMSA, industrial electric wires and cables, traveling cable, railway and transport machinery products, aluminum materials, heat shrink tubing and heat-resistant tubing/tapes, thermal control devices, and water treatment membrane; and fiber optic, fusion splicer and accessories, data center solutions, remote monitoring of FTTx distribution line, NanoPlug, CATV systems, set top box, optical and wireless devices, AirMT, non-contact multi-fiber interconnect, and low profile fiber-array. The company also provides electric wires and cables for automobiles, components for wiring harnesses, electronics, HVs and EVs, pedestrian radar, steel cords for tire reinforcement, steel wires for springs, abrasion-resistant parts, magnet wires, sintered ZnS lenses, wiring materials/electronics, sintered components, copper-diamond/molybdenum/ tungsten, chemical vapor deposition-diamond, sumicrystal, magnesium-silicon carbide, diamond/CBN cutting tool, dies wire drawing tool, and dresser, sintered aluminum-silicon carbide, and aluminum nitride. In addition, it offers electronic wires, flexible printed circuit, nickel alloy/cladded/plated wire, metal foam/electroplated wire, POREFLON PTFE membrane, the cross linked fluorine resin FEX, spiral shielded wires, coaxial cables, flat components, thunderbolt and USB4 cables, plated and alloy wires, and RGB laser modules; and PC steel wires, drills/endmills, CBN/PCD, milling and turning tools, and laser optics. The company was formerly known as Sumitomo Electric Wire & Cable Works and changed its name to Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd. in January 1939. Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd. was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

5803.name: FUJIKURA
5803.business_summary: Fujikura Ltd. engages in telecommunication and power systems, electronic, and automotive products businesses in Japan, the rest of Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company operates in five segments: Telecommunication Systems Business Division, Electronics Business Division, Automotive Products Business Division, Power Systems Business Division, and Real Estate Business Division. The Telecommunication Systems Business Division segment offers optical fibers, optical fiber cables, telecommunication components, optical components, fiber optic equipment, and network equipment, as well as related installation services. The Electronics Business Division segment provides flexible printed circuits, electronic wiring, HDD components, and various connectors. The Automotive Products Business Division segment offers automotive wire harnesses, and accessories, as well as related installation services. The Power Systems Business Division segment provides power cables, telecommunication cables, aluminum wires, and enameled wires. The Real Estate Business Division segment engages in the rental of real estate properties. Fujikura Ltd. was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5805.name: SWCC CORPORATION
5805.business_summary: SWCC Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells energy, infrastructure, and communication components in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Energy & Infrastructure Business, Communication & Components Business, and Others. It offers electric wires, electric power cables, electric power equipment, engineering products, electric power accessories, and vibration dampers/isolators; and communication cables, optical parts and fiber cables, electric power accessories, wire harnesses, precision devices, magnet wires, bare wires, oxygen-free copper, copper alloy wires, automotive electric wires; and rollers for information processing equipment, as well as engages in the business of networking solutions and logistics. The company was formerly known as SWCC Showa Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SWCC Corporation in April 2023. SWCC Corporation was incorporated in 1936 and is headquartered in Kawasaki, Japan.

5816.name: ONAMBA CO LTD
5816.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5816.business_summary: Onamba Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells general-purpose wires, communication cables, consumer electronic equipment, information office equipment, and industrial electronic equipment in Japan, rest of Asia, Europe, and America. It offers wires and cables for machine internal; coaxial cables; cables for solar power generation, fixed, and moving applications; environmentally friendly cables; and harnesses for automobile, industrial equipment, and consumer products. The company also provides renewable energy resources products, including PVU-Finder, a solar power generation intelligent monitoring and control system; and E&E-Solution, a self-consumption integrated system. In addition, it offers junction boxes and cables for solar power generation systems, as well as branch boxes/extension and crossing cables; connectors for automobiles; and harness processing equipment and machinery. Onamba Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

5817.name: JMACS JAPAN CO LTD
5817.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5817.business_summary: JMACS Japan Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells instrumentation cables, control cables, communication cables, disaster prevention cables, optical fiber cables products in Japan. It offers fieldbus cable, high-strength optical cable, offshore wind power generation cables, traffic signal and control cables, and eco-material products. JMACS Japan Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Nihon Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JMACS Japan Co., Ltd. in September 2015. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Kato, Japan.

5819.name: CANARE ELECTRIC CO
5819.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5819.business_summary: Canare Electric Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells broadcasting and communication cables, harnesses, connectors, equipment, and related accessories in Japan, the United States, South Korea, China, Taiwan, Singapore, India, Europe, the Middle East, and internationally. It offers optical transmission systems, connectors, cables, connection cables, patch and connector panels, multi-cable systems, cable reels, tools, other transmission devices, open price items, and high-power optical fiber related products, as well as AV and console solutions and digital network products. The company exports its products. It sells its products to broadcasting stations, communication companies, equipment construction companies, broadcasting and communication equipment manufacturers, and others. Canare Electric Co., Ltd. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Nisshin, Japan.

5820.name: MITSUBOSHI CO
5820.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5820.business_summary: Mitsuboshi Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electric wires and synthetic resin products in Japan. The company offers electric wires, such as rubber flexible cables, welding cables, vinyl flexible cables, Star MIC cable series, flexible cords, and high-performance tubes, including thermoflon, blacktrack, rumflon series, transformer master series, popurex series tubes that are applied in physical and chemical equipment, analytical equipment, semiconductor processing, chemical industry, electronic industry, general industry, and other applications; and heating wires used in home appliances, industrial and food furnaces, fittings, industrial equipment, and automotive applications. The company was formerly known as Mitsuboshi Trading Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsuboshi Co., Ltd. in 1971. Mitsuboshi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

5821.name: HIRAKAWA HEWTECH CORP
5821.business_summary: Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. manufactures and sells cable and assemblies, electric and electronic equipment, and medical equipment and parts in Japan and internationally. The company offers semi-flexible coaxial cords and semi-rigid coaxial cords for internal wiring and connection of high-frequency equipment; high speed cables; super-fine coaxial cables for medical precision equipment; interface cables for digital signals, including industry-certified products; factory automation cables; broadcast cables and optical fibercables; insulated wires and shield insulated wires for internal wiring of various electrical and electronic devices; power cords and power supply components; tubes; harness for internal wiring materials for multimedia-related industrial equipment and connection wires between equipment; and other products. It also provides optical converters, network equipment, optical camera modules, and AC normal charger for EV/PHEV. In addition, the company engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of special medical tubing, as well as related processed goods used in medical, analysis equipment, and other special industrial fields; design, execution, and management and contract work of electrical and telecommunications work; and leasing and management of real estate. Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. was formerly known as Hirakawa Electric Wire Corporation and changed its name to Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. in October 1990. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5830.name: IYOGIN HOLDINGS INC
5830.name_from_universe: いよぎんホールディングス
5830.business_summary: Iyogin Holdings,Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking and financial services. The company operates through Commercial Banking and Leasing segments. It offers deposit services, lending services, securities investment services, and exchange services; and business support services, credit guarantee services, credit card services, securities trading services, and fund management services. The company also provides software development, information processing, securities business, and other services. Iyogin Holdings,Inc. was founded in 1878 and is headquartered in Matsuyama, Japan.

5831.name: SHIZUOKA FINANCIAL GROUP INC.
5831.name_from_universe: しずおかフィナンシャルグループ
5831.business_summary: Shizuoka Financial Group,Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services. It operates through Banking Operations and Leasing Operations segments. The company engages in the banking business centered on deposits, loans, investment securities, and exchange transactions. It is also involved in the lease transactions centered on finance leases. In addition, the company provides corporate and financial management advisory, and bill collection services; computer system development and operation, fee-based job placement, and general administration services. Further, the company engages in the guarantee of housing loans and consumer loans, etc.; purchase of monetary receivables; appraisal of real estate for loan collateral; operation of centers for loans, remittance, and bill collection; and making, printing, and binding of various documents. Additionally, it offers credit and prepaid cards; public-offering assistance support services for corporate rehabilitation; part-time employee management services; and finance and securities-related services. The company was formerly known as The Shizuoka Bank, Ltd. Shizuoka Financial Group,Inc. was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.

5832.name: CHUGIN FINANCIAL GROUP INC
5832.name_from_universe: ちゅうぎんフィナンシャルグループ
5832.business_summary: Chugin Financial Group,Inc., through its subsidiary The Chugoku Bank, Limited, provides various financial services to corporate and individual customers in Japan. It operates through Banking, Leasing, and Securities segments. The Banking segment offers financial services, such as deposit taking and lending services. The Leasing segment engages in leasing services, and installment sales of properties and goods. The Securities segment offers brokerage services for financial instruments. The company also provides loans; exchanges; direct debits; public money services; and business processing, and document management of investment trusts. In addition, it is involved in credit guarantee, credit card, asset management, securities, regional trading, fund operation and management, regional energy and decarbonization, fee-charging employment placement, and consulting businesses. Chugin Financial Group,Inc. was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

5834.name: SBI LEASING SERVICES CO. LTD
5834.business_summary: SBI Leasing Services Co., Ltd. engages in the arrangement and selling of investment funds in the operating lease business primarily focused on aircraft and ships. It operates through three segments: Aircraft Business, General Aviation Business, and Principal Investment Business. It engages in financial services, investment, asset management, crypto-assets, and next gen business. The company offers securities, banking, and insurance; asset management; fund management in multiple areas, including venture capital, leveraged buyout, and business succession; exchange and trading relating to digital assets; and business activities relating to biotechnology, healthcare and medical informatics, web 3, and new overseas markets. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Minato, Japan. SBI Leasing Services Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of SBI Holdings, Inc.

5838.name: RAKUTEN BANK LTD
5838.business_summary: Rakuten Bank, Ltd. provides internet banking products and services to individual, corporate, and sole proprietor customers in Japan. Its deposit products include fixed-term, foreign currency, and yen deposits; securities; and investment trusts. The company also offers card loans, securities-backed loans, real estate secured loans, reverse mortgages, educational loans, mortgages, and insurance products. In addition, it provides deposit, withdrawal, payment, transfer and remittance, and receive services; debit, credit, and cash cards; overseas remittance services; and account and ID management, cashless, and partner services. Rakuten Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5840.name: NIPPON SOUKEN CO LTD
5840.business_summary: Nippon Souken Co., Ltd. provides insurance brokerage services in Japan. The company undertakes non-life insurance, life insurance, and short-term insurance contracts. Nippon Souken Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Takamatsu, Japan.

5842.name: INTEGRAL CORPORATION
5842.business_summary: Integral Corporation is a private equity firm which specializes in management buyouts, turnaround, leveraged buyouts, mezzanine, and other minority investments. The firm seeks to invest in both listed and unlisted mid-cap companies based in Japan. It does not have a specific list of industries to which it prefers to invest in. The firm is also into management and financial consulting related to equity investment activities. Integral Corporation was established on September 1, 2007 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

5843.name: NIPPON INSURE CO LTD
5843.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5843.business_summary: Nippon Insure Co., Ltd. provides rent guarantee for rental housing services in Japan. The company operates through the Guarantee Business and Other segments. It also offers rent guarantee services for rental stores and offices, as well as expense guarantee for nursing care and hospitalization expenses. In addition, the company operates coin laundry stores under the WASH House brand and fitness centers for women under the Curves brand. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan. Nippon Insure Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Miyoshi Real Estate Co., Ltd.

5844.name: KYOTO FINANCIAL GROUP INC
5844.name_from_universe: 京都フィナンシャルグループ
5844.business_summary: Kyoto Financial Group,Inc., through its subsidiary, provides various banking products and services in Japan. It accepts current, ordinary, savings, time, and other deposits, as well as deposits at notice and negotiable certificates of deposit; and offers loans and overdrafts. The company also engages in trading of commodity securities, securities investment, domestic foreign exchange, and foreign exchange, as well as securities services, credit guarantees, leasing, and credit cards. The company was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

5845.name: ZENHOREN CO. LTD
5845.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5845.business_summary: Zenhoren Co.,Ltd. provides rent liability guarantee services in Japan. It offers rent guarantee services for residential buildings, stores and offices, parking lots, warehouses and trunk rooms, and fire insurance and real estate companies, as well as tuition fee guarantee services. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Naha, Japan. As of April 3, 2025, Zenhoren Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsubishi UFJ NICOS Co.,Ltd.

5851.name: RYOBI LTD
5851.business_summary: Ryobi Limited operates as a die casting manufacturer in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. It operates through Die Castings Business, Housing Equipment Business, and Printing Equipment Business segments. The company offers die-cast auto parts, including cylinder blocks, transmission cases, subframes and other chassis parts, and electric car parts; and builder hardware products, including door closers, floor hinges, hardware products, and automatic door operators. It also provides printing equipment, such as offset printing presses and automated printing operations via smart assist printing. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

5852.name: AHRESTY CORPORATION
5852.business_summary: Ahresty Corporation engages in the aluminum die casting and alloy ingots in Japan. The company offers engine blocks and transmission cases; pedestal heads/caps; metal mold casting products; free access floor panels; and peripheral equipment for die cast machine. It also provides products for electric vehicles and fuel cell vehicles. The company was formerly known as Fuso Light Alloys Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ahresty Corporation in 1988. Ahresty Corporation was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5856.name: LIFE INTELLIGENT ENT HLDGS CO L
5856.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5856.business_summary: Life Intelligent Enterprise Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the alcoholic beverage, education, food, and other businesses in Japan. The company is involved in the retail discount of commercial food products; engages in the wholesale of meat; real estate business; renovation-related business; and employment support and other welfare services, as well as operates a nickel business. It also manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages, such as shochu under the Enma; ENMA; Kojiya Denbei; Sansui; and Rien brand name; and provides tests and teaching materials, videos, and video lessons for junior high schools. In addition, it provides individuals and group travel; and non-life and life insurance agency businesses. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5857.name: ARE HOLDINGS INC
5857.business_summary: ARE Holdings, Inc. engages in refining, manufacturing, and trading of precious metals and rare metals in Japan, Asia, and North America. The company operates in two segments, Precious Metals and Environmental Preservation. It recycles and sells various metals, including gold, silver, palladium, platinum, and rhodium that are used in a range of industry fields, such as E-scrap, dentistry, jewelry, plating treatment, precision cleaning, and catalysts. The company also engages in the collection, transportation, and intermediate processing of industrial waste, as well as provides digital platform to streamline operations for industrial waste management companies. In addition, it is involved in refining and processing of gold and silver. The company was formerly known as Asahi Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to ARE Holdings, Inc. in June 2023. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

5858.name: STG CO LTD
5858.business_summary: STG Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture of magnesium and aluminum die casting products in Japan and internationally. It also offers magnesium molded product finishing equipment. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Yao, Japan.

5866.name: WIZBIZ INC.
5866.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
5866.business_summary: WizBiz Inc. engages in the business matching, advertising, government, and other businesses in Japan. It operates WizBiz for business matching service; BizOn!, a business matching app; and Bid Navi, a bidding solution, as well as offers online cross-industry exchange meeting, and WizBiz document download and management seminar services. The company also provides seminar customer attraction and lead acquisition agency services; and publishes a booklet under the List of government procurement companies name. In addition, it offers online manager exchange meeting services; Management Notes, a management information media specializing in interviews with executives; Ask the President! in WizBiz podcast services; seminar customer attraction lab services that reveals tips for attracting business owners to seminars; WizBiz President's school, which provides information to know before starting a business and information for president; president fortune services; management consultation services; and business card creation services. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5867.name: ES NETWORKS CO LTD
5867.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
5867.business_summary: es Networks Co., Ltd. provides consulting services in Vietnam, Japan, and internationally. The company offers support services for establishing a corporation and obtaining licenses; expatriate procedural services; market research and field surveys services; accounting and taxation services; labor and personnel services; legal services; merger and acquisition services, such as sourcing and strategy review, implementation support, purchase order integration, and management improvement support; and other services, including accounting, tax, legal and labor advisory services. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5868.name: ROCOCO CO LTD
5868.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5868.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
5868.business_summary: Rococo Co. Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various information technology solutions in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments, ITO & BPO Business and Cloud Solution Business. The company offers ServiceNow, a business application that integrates internal process; IT outsourcing services, including operation/maintenance support, PC-LCM, device set-up services, building IT infrastructure, and cloud IT asset management; and business process outsourcing services, such as help desk and customer center. It also provides facial recognition systems comprising AUTH thru, a facial recognition access control system; AUTH thru KEY, a facial recognition access control system and electric lock; AUTH BrAC, a facial recognition alcohol check; and Work-Reco, a facial recognition worker record. In addition, the company offers ticketing and management support services, which includes tike-uke, a ticketing system; tike-loto, a ticket lottery/seating system; ticket data management; Re-tass LIVE for one-to-one streaming services; and METAWORKS, an automatic typesetting software. Further, it provides Microsoft power platform and system/application development services; and employee attendance mamagement services, such as RocoTime, an employee attendance management system and RocoTimexAUTH, a facial recognition system for clocking in and out. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

5869.name: WASEDA GAKUSHUKENKYUKAI CO LTD
5869.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5869.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
5869.business_summary: Waseda Gakushukenkyukai Co.,Ltd. mainly engaged in the management of the cram school business for elementary, junior high, and high school students in Japan. The company also offers elementary, junior high, high school, and junior and senior high school integrated passing courses. Waseda Gakushukenkyukai Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5870.name: NALNET COMMUNICATIONS INC.
5870.name_from_universe: ナルネットコミュニケーションズ
5870.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
5870.business_summary: Nalnet Communications Inc. engages in the automotive-related business process outsourcing (BPO) business focusing on contracted maintenance of leased vehicles. The company provides maintenance management services, such as inspections, vehicle inspections, and repairs for vehicle management by corporate leasing service providers and general corporations, as well as offers maintenance management services for leased vehicles to individual leasing service providers. It also provides data management services for maintenance costs, tire storage services, and tax payment management services. In addition, the company offers used car sales, warranties, maintenance packages, auto leases, etc. Nalnet Communications Inc. was founded in 1978 and is based in Kasugai, Japan.

5871.name: SOLIZE HOLDINGS CORPORATION
5871.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5871.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
5871.business_summary: SOLIZE Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides digital engineering services in Japan, North America, China, India, Thailand, Europe, and internationally. It operates through the Engineering and Manufacturing, and Consulting and Engineering segments. The company engages in digital engineering development support services, including 3D digital tools, styling, design, analysis, XR, and AI; 3D printer parts manufacturing, such as online 3D printing, 3D printer prototype and final product production, and research and development support; 3D printer sales and maintenance; and transformation consulting services for car, energy infrastructure, construction/general contractor, and LCA. It also provides AI comprising SpectA KY-tool, RFQ guide view, and DKM, as well as mathematics and data scientist-type generative AI agent development services; SDV, which includes MBD/MBSE, autonomous driving, and thermal management; cybersecurity and digital forensics; software development services for embedded control and business systems; educational services, such as private after-school care management, after-school care management consulting, after-school care staff training, and human resource development; and business solutions/DX support. SOLIZE Holdings Corporation was formerly known as SOLIZE Corporation and changed its name to SOLIZE Holdings Corporation in July 2025. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

5884.name: KURADASHI CO LTD
5884.business_summary: KURADASHI.Co.,Ltd. engages in the management of social good market under the Kuradashi brand in Japan. The company sells products online, as well as through stores and pop-up shops. KURADASHI.Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

5885.name: GDEP ADVANCE INC
5885.name_from_universe: ジーデップ・アドバンス
5885.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5885.business_summary: GDEP ADVANCE,Inc. engages in the system incubation business in Japan. The company distributes accelerator products, including NVIDIA graphics and computing boards, and XILINX FPGA boards; AI and GPU workstation products; Infiniband network products; servers, such as PCIe GPU, NVIDIA HGX and DGX, ARM-based GPU, and AMD INSTINCT servers; high-end storage products comprising NetApp unified data storage and DDN A3I solution; and file server and NAS QNAP storage products. It also sells software tools comprising Weights & Biases, an experimental management tool for model research; Altair Grid Engine, a distributed resource management system that provides job scheduling, resource management, and other functions; and Altair PBS Professional, a job scheduling software. In addition, the company offers NVIDIA AI Enterprise and NVIDIA Omniverse solutions; cloud rental services; and DX, subscription, implementation and operation support, hardware maintenance, continuous development environment update, support inquiries, maintenance parts stock, dispatch maintenance, performance benchmarks, and private lecture services. Further, it provides AI solutions; visualization solutions for XR and metaverse; storage solutions for big data; and construction and operation system based on customer requests. GDEP ADVANCE,Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

5888.name: DAIWA CYCLE CO LTD
5888.business_summary: Daiwa Cycle Co.,Ltd. sells bicycles, and bicycles parts and accessories primarily in Japan. The company offers city, electric assist, children's, girls, boys, kids, and mini cycles; sport and training bikes; and electric scooters. It also provides maintenance and repair services for bicycles. Daiwa Cycle Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan.

5889.name: JAPAN EYEWEAR HOLDINGS CO LTD
5889.business_summary: Japan Eyewear Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the designing, manufacturing, and selling eyeglasses in Japan. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Sabae, Japan.

5891.name: KAIRIKIYA CO LTD
5891.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5891.business_summary: Kairikiya Co., Ltd. engages in the restaurant management business in Japan. The company also provides store management and franchise chain development services. Kairikiya Co., Ltd. was Incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

5892.name: YUTORI  INC
5892.business_summary: yutori, Inc. engages in the planning, retail, and wholesale of clothing and miscellaneous goods in Japan and internationally. The company sells its products under 9090, centimeter, MySugarBabe, YoungerSong, PAMM, BALLSY.BROTHERS, BADWAY, WudgeBoy, nemne, HTH, BrokenBase, BLESSU, Camphorwood, F-LAGSTUF-F, GULL, GOAT ESSENCE, HIROKI TSUZUKI, MARITHE +, codegraphy, shesame, minum, Herlipto, HerliptoBEAUTY, ROSIER by Herlipto and overprint brand names primarily through e-commerce sites. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

5900.name: DAIKEN CO LTD
5900.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5900.business_summary: Daiken Co.,Ltd. manufactures and supplies various metal products primarily in Japan. It offers various building materials, including RS visor, clipped type louver, bolted type louver, grating, s-mat; door hardware/hanger rail, slidex, interior door hanger, and door hanger; hatch, including ceiling, floor, wall, and home floor; outdoor shed; and other products, bike rack, multi stocker, curtain rail, and HACCP. The company also exports products related to houses and buildings. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

5901.name: TOYO SEIKAN GROUP HOLDINGS LIMI
5901.name_from_universe: 東洋製罐グループホールディングス
5901.business_summary: Toyo Seikan Group Holdings, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells packaging containers in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through Packaging; Engineering, Filling and Logistics; Steel Plate Related; Functional Materials Related; Real Estate Related; and Other Businesses segments. The company offers various packaging containers, including metal cans and caps; PET and plastic bottles, plastic films and pouches, and plastic trays and caps; paper cups and corrugated cardboard products; and glass bottles and tableware. It also provides steel plate related products, such as materials for metal cans, electrical and electronic components, automotive and industrial machinery parts, construction materials, and consumer electronics; and functional materials comprising magnetic disk aluminum substrates, optical functional films, pigments, enamelware glazes, gel coats, and micro-element fertilizers, as well as tin and thin plates, surface-treated steel sheets, steel bands, automatic binders, synthetic resins, and frit products. In addition, the company offers can and can end making machinery and beverage filling equipment; contract filling and sale of beverages, aerosol, and general liquid-filled products; trucking, warehousing, real estate rental management, and tourism services; and office buildings and commercial properties leasing services. Further, it is involved in the manufacturing and sale of automotive press dies, machinery and appliances, hard alloys, and agricultural-use materials; sale of petroleum products; and non-life insurance agency business. The company was formerly known as Toyo Seikan Kaisha, Ltd. and changed its name to Toyo Seikan Group Holdings, Ltd. in March 2013. Toyo Seikan Group Holdings, Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

5902.name: HOKKAN HOLDINGS LIMITED
5902.name_from_universe: ホッカンホールディングス
5902.business_summary: Hokkan Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the container, filling, and machinery production, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells various types of unfilled cans, containers, tinplate processed products, and die pressing product, as well as PET plastic bottles, containers and bag-in-box, food cans, beverage cans, 18-liter cans, and decorative cans; printing/painting and painting of tin sheets; and molds and processes synthetic resins. It is also involved in the toll manufacturing and sales of soft drinks and alcoholic beverages, various types of other beverages, dairy products and confectionaries, retort pouch food, and agricultural products; and sales of packaging materials. In addition, the company produces, installs, and sales of various types of machinery and equipment; designing, contracted construction, repairs, and maintenance of various types of machinery and equipment; designing and contracted work related to civil engineering, construction, and steel structure work; and construction assistance and civil engineering work services. Further, it engages in consulting business; management, sales, and purchase of securities, money loans, and guarantees of liabilities; development, sales, lease, and outsourcing services of various information appliances, information processing, information services, and software; investment in and financing, and transportation and warehousing activities; acquisition, maintenance, management, usage consent, and transfer of intellectual property rights; forwarding business; farmland cultivation and researching bottling livestock products; and scrap sales business. Additionally, the company manufactures and sells processed food; generate, management, administration, supply, and sale of electricity; and offers soup pouches, ready-to-eat food products, and snacks. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5903.name: SHINPO CO LTD
5903.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5903.business_summary: Shinpo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells smokeless roasters in Japan and internationally. The company offers round type, square type, and hot plate smokeless roaster; upper, upper-drawer slim, and upper-drawer hood; yakitori maker; tabletop, built-in, and built-in gas stove unit; cooking cart; and energy-saving air conditioning systems. It also provides accessories, such as super net/flat net, shinpotong, grill cleaning machines, roasters, grills, and ceramic charcoal parts. In addition, the company provides interior construction; system design and installation of smokeless roaster; maintenance; duct cleaning services. Shinpo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

5905.name: NIHON SEIKAN K.K.
5905.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5905.business_summary: Nihon Seikan k.k., together with its subsidiary, manufactures and sells metal cans in Japan. It offers adhesive, round, and other cans. The company also engages in the real estate leasing business. Nihon Seikan k.k. was incorporated in 1925 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

5906.name: MK SEIKO CO LTD
5906.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5906.business_summary: MK Seiko Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells automotive service and information equipment, and household products. It offers car washing machines, car tire air filling machines, automatic car cleaning machines, car mat washers, fluid and oil related equipment, air conditioner related equipment, kerosene delivery lorries, pumps, and coolant cleaning machines, as well as LED display for gas stations, stores, construction, public demand information boards, digital signages, and LLC related equipment. The company also provides cooking appliances; agricultural materials; storage items; and audio equipment, as well as electric fuel pumps. MK Seiko Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Chikuma, Japan.

5909.name: CORONA CORPORATION
5909.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5909.business_summary: Corona Corporation manufactures and sells kerosene heating appliances in Japan. It offers kerosene fan and portable kerosene heaters, as well as household electrical appliances, such as dehumidifiers. The company was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Sanjo, Japan.

5911.name: YOKOGAWA BRIDGE HOLDINGS CORP
5911.name_from_universe: 横河ブリッジホールディングス
5911.business_summary: Yokogawa Bridge Holdings Corp. engages in the design, fabrication, and construction of steel structures in Japan and internationally. It operates through Bridge Business, Engineering Business, Precision Equipment Business and Real Estate Business segments. The company designs, fabricates, and erects steel bridge projects; and maintains, repairs, and retrofits existing structures. It is also involved in the supply of structural steel buildings for factories, storehouses, shops, and sports facilities; fabrication of port and offshore structures; and construction of high-rise buildings and dome-type sports stadiums, as well as provision of machinery for the infrastructure sector, such as water gate, shiplift facility, and sewage treatment. In addition, the company supplies metal frames for use in the production of semiconductors and flat panel displays; and provides software for the total design system for steel bridges and simulation systems for the erection of steel structures, etc. Yokogawa Bridge Holdings Corp. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

5915.name: KOMAIHALTEC INC
5915.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5915.business_summary: Komaihaltec Inc. designs and constructs steel bridges, steel frameworks, and wind energy generating systems. The company also manufactures and installs construction machinery. It develops, constructs, and installs wind turbine systems, as well as develops solar systems. Komaihaltec Inc. was founded in 1883 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5918.name: TAKIGAMI STEEL CONSTRUCTION CO
5918.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5918.business_summary: The Takigami Steel Construction Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and constructs bridges, steel frames, steel towers, and other steel structures primarily in Japan. It is also involved in construction work, as well as repair and reinforcement work. The Takigami Steel Construction Co., Ltd. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Handa, Japan.

5921.name: KAWAGISHI BRIDGE WORKS CO LTD
5921.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5921.business_summary: Kawagishi Bridge Works Co., Ltd. engages in the production and construction of steel frames in Japan. It manufactures and sells precast concrete products for construction works. The company's products are used in the construction of high-rise buildings, skyscrapers, and large space structures. Kawagishi Bridge Works Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5922.name: NASU DENKI-TEKKO CO
5922.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5922.business_summary: Nasu Denki-Tekko Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells electricity, communications, and transportation infrastructure materials in Japan. The company offers steel towers and structures, including transmission, telecommunications, and lighting towers, as well as steel frames, and equipment racks; overhead line materials, such as overhead wiring hardware, insulators, resin covers, NTT and CATV materials, wire rods, and antenna support poles for information and communications; and underground wire materials comprising cable support materials for tunnels and utility conduits, prefabricated manholes, concrete handhole products, iron covers, pipe materials, and utility pole removal materials. It also provides toll booth and transportation system materials, which include road information boards, signs, soundproof wall supports, electronic toll collection gantries, lighting and ventilation equipment, and railway overhead wire fittings; steel pipe, composite, and fabricated steel pipe columns; and assembled steel pipe poles for power generation, communications, and for disaster prevention. In addition, the company offers surface treatment solutions, such as highly corrosion-resistant plating, hot-dip zinc-aluminum alloy plating, hot-dip galvanization, low-gloss treatment, zinc phosphate treatment, and various types of painting; and air-heated hydrogen storage alloy system and hydrogen storage alloy tank. Further, it offers construction works comprising telecommunication tower, underground line facility, and road facility installation works, and deterioration diagnosis, as well as recycling of galvanized products. The company serves electric power, telecommunication, construction, expressway, and railway companies, as well as government agencies and ministry of land, infrastructure, transport, tourism, internal affairs and communications, and defense. Nasu Denki-Tekko Co., Ltd. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

5923.name: TAKADA KIKO STEEL CONSTRUCTION
5923.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5923.business_summary: TAKADAKIKO (Steel Construction) CO.,LTD. engages in the design, manufacture, and on-site construction of bridges, steel frames, and other steel structures in Japan. It is also involved in the design of new steel bridges; fabrication and on-site installation; design of existing bridge maintenance and repair works; fabrication and on-site installation; and design of bridge-related steel structures. In addition, the company manufactures and constructs steel frames for super-high rise buildings and large spatial structures. Additionally, it manufactures vibration control components; and civil engineering and marine-related steel structures. TAKADAKIKO (Steel Construction) CO.,LTD. was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

5928.name: ALMETAX MANUFACTURING CO
5928.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5928.business_summary: Almetax Manufacturing Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells aluminum building materials, electrical materials, and civil engineering products in Japan. The company engages in the development, design, production, and construction of various industrial materials, such as ceramic, glass, etc., as well as environmental and landscape materials, etc.; and development research, construction, and sale of new materials, new technologies, recycling, etc. It also offers aluminum building materials, decorative windows, functional windows, bay windows, screen doors, skylights, entrances, back doors, and bathroom doors; openings, such as lattices; and exteriors, such as handrails, balconies, terraces, carports, etc. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

5929.name: SANWA HOLDINGS CORP
5929.name_from_universe: 三和ホールディングス
5929.business_summary: Sanwa Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells construction materials for commercial and residential buildings in Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. The company offers residential lightweight shutters, condominium doors, window shutters, and exterior products; and garage door, operators, and hinge doors. It also provides non-residential heavy-duty shutter, steel doors, partitions, stainless steel products, overhead doors, automatic doors, truck/trailer doors, industrial doors, and dock levelers. In addition, the company engages in the installation, maintenance, and service activities. Sanwa Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5930.name: BUNKA SHUTTER CO
5930.business_summary: Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells building materials in Japan, Australia, and internationally. It operates through Shutter Business, Construction-Related Materials Business, Service Business, Refurbishment Business, and Other segments. The company offers garage, heavy-duty, lightweight, panel, high-speed sheet, and window shutters, as well as oversliding and hangar doors, vinyl curtains, and smoke prevention and disaster prevention products. It also provides sliding/folding, steel, hotel, and apartment doors; specific fire prevention equipment with heat resistant glass; stainless-steel fittings; pre wall, aluminum, steel, glass, and low partitions; sliding walls, toilet booths, wall panels, and free access floors; and indoor and outdoor steel stairs, chain gates, and handrails and cappings, as well as decks, louvers, and fences. In addition, the company offers water stop master series, heat-shielding products, solar power generation systems, and PCR testing booths; maintenance and repair services for existing shutters and building materials; alteration and extension services for houses; and replacement and repair of household equipment. Further, it engages in the water-sealing, solar power system, real estate leasing, insurance, and architecture design businesses. The company was formerly known as Japan Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. in April 1970. Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

5932.name: SANKYO TATEYAMA INC
5932.business_summary: Sankyo Tateyama,Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of building, housing, and exterior construction materials in Japan. It also manufactures and sells fabricated products made of rolled aluminum and other metals. In addition, the company is involved in the casting, extrusion, fabrication, and sale of aluminum and magnesium; sale of commercial and general-purpose display fixtures; manufacture and sale of standard signboards and other signage products; and maintenance of stores related equipment. Sankyo Tateyama,Inc. was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Takaoka, Japan.

5933.name: ALINCO INC
5933.business_summary: Alinco Incorporated develops, manufactures, and sells scaffolding equipment in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Retail Business, Rental Related Business, Household Equipment Related Business, and Electronic Equipment Related Business. It offers scaffolding materials and logistics storage equipment; steel hardwear; home equipment, such as ladders, stepladders, stationary elevating workbenches, surveying and laser equipment, aluminum bridges, fitness equipment, and various type of carts and folding handcarts; and wireless communication devices. The company is also involved in the sale and rental of scaffolding materials for low-rise and medium to high-rise buildings, and temporary bleachers and oct systems. In addition, it undertakes assembly processing of electronic equipment; develops, manufactures, and sells do-it-yourself products, aluminium mold, electronic devices, printed and multi-layer printed wiring boards, metal and related products, and health care and beauty equipment; and develops and manages real estate properties. Further, it manufactures and sells steel racks for logistics warehouses, and steel floor materials. Alinco Incorporated was formerly known as Inoue Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Alinco Incorporated in March 1983. The company was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

5936.name: TOYO SHUTTER CO
5936.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5936.business_summary: Toyo Shutter Co., Ltd. manufactures, installs, purchases, imports, sells, and exports various shutters, doors, hardware, and building fixtures, materials, and consumables in Japan. The company offers heavy-duty, lightweight, aluminum, and high-speed sheet shutters; overdoor; hangar door; disaster prevention products; building materials; butterfly stop; and other products. It also provides steel, front, and special doors; residential overdoors; locks, hardware, cylinder type, and cutaway view products. In addition, the company offers architectural hardware, marine equipment/decorative hardware, and furniture and kitchen equipment, as well as disaster, crime, and flood prevention equipment. Additionally, it engages in the design, supervision, contracting, and execution of architecture and facility construction; design and construction of electrical equipment work; development of computer software; sale of computer equipment; sale, installation, and repair of machinery, equipment, and materials for various types of electric transportation and electrical equipment; and buying, selling, leasing, brokerage, and management of real estate. Further, the company is involved in outdoor advertising; maintenance work; acquisition, rental, and sale of industrial property rights, copyrights and other intangible property rights, know-how, system engineering, and other software; non-life insurance agency business; automobile liability insurance agency business; and business related to solicitation of life insurance. Toyo Shutter Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

5938.name: LIXIL CORPORATION
5938.business_summary: LIXIL Corporation, through its subsidiaries, operates water technology and housing technology business in Japan and internationally. The company offers fixtures and vanities, which includes ceramic toilets, bidets, urinals, and basins, and vanities; bathing products, such as bath tubs, showers enclosures, whirlpool, and wellness solutions; and bathroom fittings, including single and two lever faucets and accessories, as well as hands and head showers, thermostats, and shower systems. It also provides shower toilets comprising integrated shower toilet system and seats; prefabricated bath and kitchen systems for houses condos, and other projects; smart water sensors and controllers; behind the wall systems and commercial fittings; kitchen fittings and sinks; and tiles. In addition, the company offers thermal efficiency and insulation windows; entrance doors; exteriors, including entrance gates, garages, terraces, and garden rooms; and wooden interior furnishing materials, as well as other products, such as fire-resistant siding materials, aluminum frames for solar photovoltaic systems, and super wall construction. Further, it provides housing solutions; and sells and manages real estate and other services. It offers its products under the INAX, GROHE, American Standard, TOSTEM, RICHELLE, SPAGE, exsior, SUPER WALL, ASAHI TOSTEM, DXV, NODEA, COBRA, and SATO brands. The company was formerly known as LIXIL Group Corporation. LIXIL Corporation was founded in 1875 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5939.name: OTANI KOGYO CO LTD
5939.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5939.business_summary: Otani Kogyo Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of overhead wire hardware for power distribution and communication lines, and public hearing and CATV in Japan. The company offers overhead wiring hardware, telecommunication line hardware, and community and hardware. It also provides transmission angle steel towers, outdoor steel structures for substations, equipment stands, communication radio towers, and solar panel mounting frames; headed and irregular shape studs; and lower and upper isolation base plates, as well as scribing displacement meters. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

5940.name: FUJISASH CO LTD
5940.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5940.business_summary: Fujisash Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells sash and curtain walls in Japan. It offers sashes and curtain walls for buildings; building renewal services to various apartments and office buildings; frontage products, such as entrances of apartments and offices, as well as aperture facades of shops and showrooms; housing construction materials, including eco shutters and eco grilles; multipurpose prefabricated house modules, storages for disaster mitigation, and high-performnace housing equipment; and LED modules. The company also provides urban waste processing systems to manufacturer and sales agents; fly ash treatment plants for urban waste incineration; and plant engineering of recycling and large-sized waste disposal facilities, as well as produces building materials, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, automotive products, home appliances, office equipment, and commodities as a supplier of light metals of aluminum. In addition, it is involved in the research and development of extrusion processing technology for lightweight magnesium alloys among industrial metals. Fujisash Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

5941.name: NAKANISHI MFG CO
5941.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5941.business_summary: Nakanishi Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells commercial kitchen equipment primarily in Japan. The company also operates in real estate rental business. It offers cooking, heating, cooling, rice cooking cleaning, disinfection and storage, hospital, and welfare equipment. The company offers its products for schools, hospitals, business establishments, fast food shops, restaurants, bakeries, etc. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

5942.name: NIPPON FILCON CO
5942.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5942.business_summary: Nippon Filcon Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides industrial equipment, components, and solutions in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, Australia, North America, and internationally. It operates through Industrial Functional Filter and Conveyor Business; Electronic Materials and Photomasks Business; Environment and Water Treatment Related Business; and Real Estate Rental Business segments. The company offers industrial filters and conveyor belts, such as mesh for pulp and paper manufacturing; and industrial wire mesh products for use in screening, filtering, and conveying processes in the manufacture of various products. It also provides electronic components and photomasks, including high-precision parts to the customers in electronics, automotive, office equipment, medical equipment, and other fields; stepper reticles and aligner masks for use in semiconductors and LCD; and solar power generation systems. In addition, the company offers swimming pools for elementary and junior high schools, and other public entities, as well as for fitness clubs, hotels, and other private businesses; and imports and sells insulating joints that prevent corrosion and gas leaks on natural gas pipelines, as well as wine. Further, it leases real estate properties, such as stores, condominiums, parking lots, and other properties. Nippon Filcon Co., Ltd. was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Inagi, Japan.

5943.name: NORITZ CORP
5943.business_summary: Noritz Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of household appliances and equipment in Japan. The company provides water heaters, and heating ventilation and air conditioning systems, such as gas water and oil water heaters; hybrid water and space heating systems; solar heating systems; waste heat recovery systems for fuel cells; hydronic floor heating systems; and gas fan heaters, as well as bathroom heating, drying, and ventilation systems. It also offers kitchen appliances, including built-in and counter-top gas cookers, gas ovens, and range hoods. In addition, the company provides after-sales and product installation services. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

5945.name: TENRYU SAW MFG CO
5945.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5945.business_summary: Tenryu Saw Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells saw blades in Japan and internationally. The company offers cutting tools, such as carbide tools for ferrous and non-ferrous metals, as well as wood applications; cutters and routers; HSS tools; and diamond saw blades, circular and band saw blades, circular knives, and miter saw blades. It also offers machines for carbide-tipped saw blades, including an ultrasonic bath for saw blades; and band saw processing machines comprising automatic band saw welders, levelers, heat-tensioning machines, hard-facing alloy tipping machines, hard-facing alloy rough grinders, side grinders, and saw sharpeners, as well as narrow band saw sharpeners. Tenryu Saw Mfg. Co., Ltd. was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Fukuroi, Japan.

5946.name: CHOFU SEISAKUSHO CO
5946.business_summary: Chofu Seisakusho Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells residential appliances under the Chofu and Sunpot brands in Japan. The company offers water heaters comprising oil water heaters, oil bath boilers, gas water heaters, gas bath boilers, electric water heaters, and EcoCute heat pump water heaters; air conditioning equipment consisting of oil stoves, gas stoves, hot water heating systems, geothermal heat pumps, and snow melting systems; and system equipment, such as system bathrooms, artificial marble bathtubs, and system kitchens. It also provides solar equipment, including solar water heaters, solar-powered hot water systems, solar underfloor ventilation fans, and solar photovoltaic and solar thermal hybrid modules; kitchen-related products; agricultural equipment; and centralized control systems. In addition, the company is involved in engineering services, such as proposing, designing, and constructing energy-efficient thermal energy supply systems; maintenance of central heating systems; installation of oil and gas equipment; maintenance of various systems; and software development and sales. It exports its products to Europe, North America, and Oceania. Chofu Seisakusho Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Shimonoseki, Japan.

5947.name: RINNAI CORP
5947.business_summary: Rinnai Corporation manufactures and sells thermal equipment in Japan, the United States, Australia, China, South Korea, and Indonesia. The company offers water heaters, including hot-water units, bath hot-water units, hot-water and heating units, and gas/solar hybrid hot-water and heating systems; kitchen appliances, such as tabletop stoves, built-in-stoves, ovens, range food, dishwashers, and rice cookers; and air conditioning appliances comprising fan heaters, fan-forced heaters, and infrared heaters. It also provides commercial-use ceramics grills, gas stoves, and rice cookers; and clothes dryers, and infrared burners and parts. The company sells its products under the Rinnai brand. The company was formerly known as Rinnai & Co. and changed its name to Rinnai Corporation in 1971. Rinnai Corporation was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

5949.name: UNIPRES CORP
5949.business_summary: Unipres Corporation engages in manufacture and sale of automotive parts in Japan. The company offers car body frame products, such as front side members, rear side members, cross members, side sills, front pillars, center pillars, side roof rails, front floor panel, steering members, fuel tanks, and filler tubes, as well as battery case. It also provides precision press technology products, including torque converters, clutch pack and drum, driven/retaining plate, piston plunger, carrier pack, carrier plate/base, end plate, oil pan, and parts for cooling EV motors. In addition, the company offers plastic press products comprising front and floor under covers, front fender protectors, and rear diffuser. Further, it engages in the manufacture and sale of electric machinery parts; metal products; and welders, dies, jigs, and tools, as well as inspection and maintenance of press machinery. Unipres Corporation was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

5950.name: JAPAN POWER FASTENING CO
5950.name_from_universe: 日本パワーファスニング
5950.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5950.business_summary: Japan Power Fastening Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial fasteners and related tools in Japan. The company provides fasteners for metal, wooden, and cement-based building materials; surface treatment; tools, machines, and equipment for fastening industrial fasteners; and industrial rivet guns and rivets. It also buys, sells, leases, and manages real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Minoh, Japan.

5951.name: DAINICHI CO LTD
5951.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5951.business_summary: Dainichi Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells heating equipment in Japan, Europe, and Asia. It provides heating equipment, including oil, gas, and electric heating equipment; environmental equipment, such as humidifiers, air purifiers, and fuel cells; and knitwear and other products comprising parts and coffee equipment. It also provides smoke machines, commercial oil heater, ceramic fan heaters, and household food waste dryers. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.

5952.name: AMATEI INCORPORATED
5952.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5952.business_summary: Amatei Incorporated manufactures and sells nails, screws, nailing machines, and construction materials in Japan. It offers ordinary and special nails, as well as various connecting nails. The company also trades in steel. Amatei Incorporated was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

5955.name: WISE HOLDINGS CO LTD
5955.name_from_universe: ワイズホールディングス
5955.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5955.business_summary: Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, manufacture, and sale of metal products in Japan, Thailand, Asia, and internationally. The company offers tapping fasteners for metals, plastic, and thin plates; aluminum alloy zipper, CFRP fasteners, anti-loosening fasteners, crimp bolts, washer assembled screws, and head shape products; and custom-made products, such as neck tight screws and small metal parts. It also provides contract test and consulting services. The company serves car, home appliances and industrial equipment, medical equipment, robot, and architecture industries. The company was formerly known as Yamashina Corporation and changed its name to Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. in October 2024. Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

5956.name: TOSO CO LTD
5956.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5956.business_summary: Toso Company, Limited engages in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of interior products worldwide. It offers decorative and functional curtain tracks, motorized curtain tracks, doors, shades, and external roll-up curtains, curtain rail, hanging bar, laundry bar, Picture rail, tassel hook, tassel, partitions, venetian, dimmable, and roller blinds, roman shades, vertical and pleated blinds, and panel tracks, screen, colt, as well as peripheral parts for motorized products. It offers walking sticks and other items through agents, home improvement centers, and nursing care specialty stores. Toso Company, Limited was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5957.name: NITTOSEIKO CO LTD
5957.business_summary: Nittoseiko Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial fasteners and tools, industrial machinery and precision equipment, measurement and control equipment, and medical equipment in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Fastener; Industrial Machinery; Control; and Medical segments. The company offers screws for plastics and metal fastening, cold forged parts, anti-loosening screws, drive recesses, heads, self-clinching stud bolts, surface treatment products, waterproof screws, products for joining of dissimilar materials, and other metal parts; and screw driving motors, handheld type screw drivers, arm drivers, single and multi-spindle screw driving machines, screw driving robots, screw feeders, anti-contamination units, screw driving units for collaborative robots, caulking machines, assembly robots, and conveyors. It also provides flow meters, receivers/converters, micro-bubble washers, products for marine and batch applications, and geokartes. Nittoseiko Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

5958.name: SANYO INDUSTRIES
5958.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5958.business_summary: Sanyo Industries, Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of metallic building materials in Japan. The company  is involved in the manufacture, sale, and contract work of metallic building materials, and internal and external materials; design and manufacture of air-conditioning and ventilation systems, and associated equipment; sale and contract work of solar energy equipment; and export and import of other related products and materials. It also offers aluminum products, including handrails, copings, louvers, and spandrail; system floors, such as multipurpose, magic, deck, and condominium floors; and natural ventilation products; and metal flame, natural lighting, system ceiling, filler, and wire and metal products. Sanyo Industries, Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

5959.name: OKABE CO LTD
5959.business_summary: Okabe Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells construction and civil engineering products in Japan, North America, and internationally. It offers temporary construction products, such as clamps, scaffolding, inserts for scaffolding, temporary pass, and safety products; concrete formwork products, including separator, cone, form tie, flat rib, overtightening restrainer, corner fastener, panel adjuster, slab jointer, bottom pipe supporting hook, and leakage cover; items for h-beam, sheet pile method, insulation , and other formwork; water stop/disposal products; insert and rooftop protection products; and chamfers. The company also provides rebar work products, which include joints, pile head, spacers, footing beam stand for foundation, and beam lowering stand for beam, as well as civil engineering products. Okabe Co., Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

5962.name: ASAKA INDUSTRIAL CO
5962.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5962.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
5962.business_summary: Asaka Industrial Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells shovels and scoops in Japan. It operates through Daily Life Products and Logistics Equipment segments. The company also offers spades; outdoor equipment, including gardening tools; construction and agricultural equipment and tools; farming tools; physical distribution system components; store fixtures; hole diggers; forks; lopper and garden shears; and wooden products. In addition, it sells electric mobile shelves, rotating racks, transport equipment, and store equipment; and heavy, medium, and light weight racks. Asaka Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1661 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

5965.name: FUJIMAK CORP
5965.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5965.business_summary: Fujimak Corporation engages in the manufacture, sale, maintenance, and repair of commercial kitchen equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers ovens, teppanyaki grills, fryer oil filters, gas ranges, induction stoves, warmers, griddles, salamander roasters, noodle boilers, rotary cooking kettle braising pans, dumpling grillers, steamers, package cookers, and reheating cabinets, as well as electric ranges, tables, and stock pot ranges; refrigerators, freezers, blast chillers, showcases, cold food carts, ice makers, and vacuum and tabletop coolers; Kitchen Link Cloud, a cloud-based temperature management system; Kitchen Link, a system that centrally manages data; I-Robo2, a stir-fry cooking robot; finibo, a system that automates the picking and sorting cleaned dishes; and island and custom-made home kitchens. It also provides dishwashers, cookware washers, sterilizer cabinets, and ultraviolet sterilizers; cleaning agents for washing machines; carts; automatic rice cookers, storage products, and silos; bakery equipment; cabinets and camshelving equipment; Pacojet, a frozen pulverizing cooker; vacuum packing machines, blenders and mixers, and cookers; gelato/ice cream service equipment, drink dispensers and machines, auxiliary cooking equipment, and water heaters; and sanitary sinks and bars, automatic hand sanitizer dispensers, air showers, electrolyzed water generators, digital probe thermometers, and water softeners and purifiers. The company sells its products online. It serves government agencies and public institutions; educational institutions and school lunch centers; medical and welfare facilities; hotels, inns, and lodging facilities; restaurants and izakayas; amusement facilities; fast food establishments; convenience stores; food processing plants and central kitchens; company cafeterias; ship kitchen facilities; and other industries. Fujimak Corporation was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

5966.name: KYOTO TOOL CO LTD
5966.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
5966.business_summary: Kyoto Tool Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive maintenance tools, medical tools and related equipment, electrical tools, and other general tools in Japan.
