In addition, the company offers imaging/measuring equipment consisting of flow meters, mass flow meters, pressure sensors/gauges, displacement and color vision sensors, ultra precision touch sensors, 3-D measuring systems, torque testers, and air/hydrogen leak testers; and environmental equipment, such as ionizers, conductive mats and tiles, regenerative thermal oxidizers, eco-power meters, atmospheric-pressure plasma cleaning equipment, hydro carbonic cleaning devices, oxygen/nitrogen gas generators, table top clean benches, and drain separators. Further, it provides logistics/transport equipment, including overhead cranes, belt/roller conveyors, conveyors for FPD, automatic guided vehicles, roll box pallets, mobile racks, air balancers, gear motors, and steel racks; and general industrial equipment, such as electric screwdrivers, handy scanners/terminals, spring balancers/cable reels, vacuum packaging machines, aluminum profile systems, laser welders/markers, compressors, air dryers, and chiller/temperature control equipment. The company was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7475.name: ALBIS CO LTD
7475.business_summary: ALBIS Co.,Ltd. engages in food retailing business in Japan. The company also manufactures prepared foods and tofu products, as well as processes meat products. In addition, it is involved in the reduction of plastic bottles and empty cans; cleaning of product transport trays and store shopping baskets, as well as other cleaning work; bread dough production; and agriculture and welfare collaboration business. ALBIS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Imizu, Japan.

7476.name: AS ONE CORPORATION
7476.business_summary: AS ONE Corporation engages in the sale of research instruments and equipment, nursing and care products, and other scientific instruments in Japan and internationally. The company offers scientific instruments comprising temperature/humidity control and measuring/surveying instruments, as well as universal products used for cooling, heating, mixing, absorption, pressurization, and conveyance; microscopes, glass slides, and tissue culture products for biotechnology; magnifying glasses indispensable for precision work, plus filters, and dispensing devices required for analysis technology; equipment indispensable for research facilities, such as experimental platforms, fume hoods, and pharmaceutical depositories, as well as storage equipment, wagons, laboratory chairs, and conveyance equipment; containers required for storage or preservation of samples, reagents, materials, and others; glass or plastic beakers, flask indispensables, hoses, tubes, and joints; tapes and labels; and timers, packaging machines, tools, office supplies, and other equipment for laboratories. It also provides industrial instruments, such as dehumidifying storage products; equipment for organization, conveyance, etc.; equipment for sterilization/disinfecting and cleaning, including ultrasonic cleaners for washing/drying, detergents, and drying tools; glasses, masks, and gloves; and tools and containers used in clean rooms, as well as dust-proof and anti-static products comprising clean room clothes and mats indispensable. In addition, the company offers hospital/nursing instruments, such as white gowns, masks, and gloves; rack systems for installing in nursing stations; various products, supplies, and equipment required for hospital nursing and care; and sterilizers and sterilization lockers, as well as care cars and beds, and bathing and sanitary products. The company was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

7477.name: MURAKI CORP
7477.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7477.business_summary: Muraki Corporation engages in the wholesale of car care, and automobile repair parts and related products in Japan. The company provides aftermarket parts, including oil and air elements, radiator valves, wiper blades, batteries, and air conditioner filters; and auto chemical products, such as window washer and brake fluids, oil and air conditioner related chemicals, body and glass coatings, and supercoolants. It also sells automotive maintenance equipment comprising engine oil changers, air conditioning gas refreshers, balancer, car wash machines, lift, and ATF and tire changers. It also offers products, such as supplies, signs and store decoration LEDs, car wash detergents, grease and fat pollution prevention cleaners, AdBlue and many promotional goods. In addition, it provides after-sales and maintenance services. The company offers its products to customers, such as service stations. Muraki Corporation was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tama, Japan.

7480.name: SUZUDEN CORP
7480.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7480.business_summary: Suzuden Corporation engages in purchasing and selling products related to electrical and electronic components in Japan. It offers FA equipment, including RFID equipment, sensors, and graphic control panels; information and communication devices, computers for industrial use, office equipment, accessories, and software; connectors, switching power supplies, and noise filters. The company provides materials for electric facilities comprising of wattmeter, terminal blocks, and electric cables. Suzuden Corporation was incorporated n 1952 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. The company is a subsidiary of Yamato Corporation.

7481.name: OIE SANGYO CO
7481.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7481.business_summary: Oie Sangyo Co., Ltd. operates as a food trading company in Japan. It primarily supplies frozen, cooked, semi-cooked, dried, and canned food products to restaurants, and other food service industries, as well as hospitals and elderly facilities. The company also provides non-food products, includes ingredients and kitchen supplies such as wraps, plastic bags, and detergents. Oie Sangyo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

7482.name: SHIMOJIMA CO LTD
7482.business_summary: Shimojima Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale and retail of paper products, plastic products and packaging materials, and in-store materials primarily in Japan. The company operates through three reporting segments: Paper Products, Chemicals & Packaging Materials, and Retail Supplies. It offers paper bags, wrapping paper, and paper containers; plastic bags, adhesive tapes, food packaging materials, strings and ribbons, and other packaging materials; and in-store display materials, stationery and office supplies, goods for in-store use, apparel-related materials, and horticulture-related materials. It also provides OPP bags, boxes, kitchen goods, tableware, hygiene and cleaning supplies, event supplies, and ceremonial goods. The company was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7483.name: DOSHISHA CO LTD
7483.business_summary: Doshisha Co.,Ltd., plans, develops, produces, and sells lifestyle-related products in Japan and Internationally. It operates through Development-oriented Business Model; and Wholesale Business Model. The company provides a wide range of products, such as food and lifestyle products home appliances, lighting, A/V, household goods, interior and storage items, fashion goods and cosmetics, gift, alcohol, and fashion clothing. It also offers watches, jewelries, and bags. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

7486.name: SANRIN CO LTD
7486.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7486.business_summary: Sanrin Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells briquette, charcoal, petroleum, LP gas, and other fuel products in Japan. It operates through Energy related business, Ice making business, Fruit and vegetable business, and Real Estate Business segments. The company offers petroleum products, including gasoline, kerosene, diesel, heavy oil, lubricating oil, and other products; LP gas for household, commercial, automobile, and industrial uses; and oxygen, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, as well as other general high-pressure gases. It also supplies LP gas/gas stove, water heater, heater, clothes dryer, rice cooker, and commercial kitchen equipment; system kitchens, unit baths, vanities, toilets, and home appliances. In addition, it provides solar power generation system and fuel cells; refrigerators, air-conditioners, fans, radiators, pump and cooling towers, warm-up machines, and other cold equipment; LP gas supply equipment, including propane containers, fuse cocks, regulators, steel pipes, and microcomputer gas meters; and household goods, such as gas leak alarms, fire alarms, anti-freeze products, and other consumer home appliances. Further, the company offers tires, car air-conditioners, batteries, and other car accessories; and high-pressure gas equipment for industrial and medical purposes, as well as operates golf practice fields. Additionally, it designs and constructs air-conditioning and hot water supply facility; housing renovations; and high-pressure gas facilities for oxygen. Sanrin Co., Ltd. was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Higashichikuma-gun, Japan.

7487.name: OZU CORP
7487.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7487.business_summary: Ozu Corporation imports, processes, sells, and exports nonwoven fabrics and disinfectants in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers electronics and clean room products, including nonwoven, aerospace, knitted and disinfecting wipers, thick paper, and sterile wet wipers, as well as clean room masks, mops, sterilant, and other products. It also provides disposable sheets, cleaning towels, examination clothes and gowns, masks, storage products, coin face mask, and point sheets. In addition, the company offers oil absorbents, radioactive cesium, and sweat wipes. Further, it provides glass wipes. Additionally, it is involved in the real estate rental business. It serves electronics, cosmetics, medical, industrial materials, and decontamination industries. The company was founded in 1653 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7490.name: NISSIN SHOJI CO
7490.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7490.business_summary: Nissin Shoji Co.,Ltd. engages in the sale of petroleum products in Japan. The company also offers biomass power generation fuel, such as palm kernel shell and empty fruit bunches pellets; energy saving solutions and marketing; and lubricating and fuel oils; service station services, including car wash and coating, vehicle inspection, repair, and insurance; car sales, leases, and rentals. In addition, it provides functional chemicals, comprising synthetic resin raw, packaging, non-woven, and reflective materials, agricultural covering material, thermal shielding coated sheet for tunnels, thermal insulation material, and reflective materials under the Teru Teru, Warmth, Round Cool, and Warif brand names; photosynthetic efficiency accelerator; CO2 application controller under the OCES-200S and Conductor brand names; agricultural houses, including steel frame, ap, and pipe houses; liquefied petroleum gas, such as propane and industrial gases; and water heaters; built-in hob; industrial boilers; disaster propane gas generator. Further, the company is involved in real estate leasing of office buildings and residences; and new construction and acquisition of properties, and tenant management. Nissin Shoji Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7494.name: KONAKA CO LTD
7494.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

It also provides suits, formal wear, easy-to-order items, coats, innerwear, jackets, bottoms, outerwear, casual wear, shirts, ties, underwear, shoes, bags, and jewelry under the Konaka, SUIT SELECT, DIFFERENCE, Futata, FUTATA THE FLAG, Samantha Thavasa, SAMANTHAVEGA, Samantha Thavasa Petit Choice, Samantha Tiara, SAMANTHA SILVA, KINGZ, Samantha Thavasa GOLF, & chouette, and FIT HOUSE brands. Further, it is involved in management of clothing repair shops; provision of manufacturing, tailoring, and cleaning services, as well as clothing repair; management of recycle shops; wholesale and sales of used clothing; and management of SUIT SELECT shop. Konaka Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

7500.name: NISHIKAWA KEISOKU CO
7500.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

In addition, it offers plant; physical and chemical; measurement; automotive and new energy solutions; optical and wireless communication solutions. Its products are used in various industries, such as water and sewerage, energy, chemicals, food, pharmaceuticals, automobiles, semiconductors, and services. Nishikawa Keisoku Co., Ltd. was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7501.name: TIEMCO LTD
7501.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

7508.name: G-7 HOLDINGS INC
7508.business_summary: G-7 Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the automobile, supermarket, and meat-related businesses in Japan. Further, it engages in the wholesale, retail, and processed meat business; automobile export business; and planning, developing, producing, and selling food products. Additionally, the company offers frozen and processed foods; operates RJ market, an outlet shop, and curves, a fitness class for women; is involved in the specialty food, agriculture, mini supermarket, and real estate leasing businesses; import/export activities; and trades in trilateral. The company serves through online channels. G-7 Holdings Inc. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

7509.name: I.A.GROUP
7509.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

7510.name: TAKEBISHI CORPORATION
7510.business_summary: Takebishi Corporation operates as a technological trading company primarily in Japan. Further, it provides information and communication equipment including sale of PCs and PC servers to the design, development, and maintenance of mission-critical systems, such as sales and production management systems; and security systems, which includes surveillance cameras and controls for entering and exiting comprising PBX. The company was formerly known as Takebishi Electric Sales Corp. and changed its name to Takebishi Corporation in September 2006. Takebishi Corporation was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

7512.name: AEON HOKKAIDO CORPORATION
7512.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan. Aeon Hokkaido Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Aeon Co., Ltd.

7513.name: KOJIMA CO LTD
7513.business_summary: Kojima Co.,Ltd. engages in the sale, repair, and installation of home appliances and electrical products in Japan. The company offers TV recorders, refrigerators and kitchen appliances, washing machines and household appliances, air conditioners, air purifiers, seasonal home appliances, computers, peripherals, printers, cameras & camcorders, audio, headphones, musical instruments, smartphone accessories, electronic dictionaries, fax machines, office equipment, ink, paper, media, light bulbs, batteries, and power strips, game, toys, beauty and health appliances, daily necessities, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals, interior, miscellaneous goods, bedding, bicycles, sports, travel, crime prevention, disaster prevention, and DIY supplies. The company was formerly known as Y.K. Tokiwa Food Center and changed its name to Maruyoshi Center Inc. in 1970. Maruyoshi Center Inc. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Takamatsu, Japan.

7516.name: KOHNAN SHOJI
7516.business_summary: Kohnan Shoji Co., Ltd. operates and manages retail stores in Japan. The company's home center stores offer home improvement products, which include lumber, building materials, tools, hardware, pain supplies, working clothes and equipment, gardening tools and equipment, plants, material handling products, housing and plumbing supplies, and remodeling and renovating products; housekeeping products, such as kitchenware and dining, furniture and decor, bedding, electronics and lighting, household supplies, electrical appliances, health and personal care, footwear, clothing, cleaning, and laundry products; and car and leisure products, which include automotive supplies and accessories, pet supplies, stationary and office supplies, cycling products, and sports and outdoor products. It also operates Home Center store, which offers daily necessities; KOHNAN PRO stores, which sell various tools, building materials, paint supplies, and equipment for professional customers; KOHNAN REFORM which offers advice to customers on newly installing or renewing home equipment and systems as well as organizing external building work; and CAMP DEPOT stores, which offers camping goods. Kohnan Shoji Co., Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

7520.name: ECO'S CO LTD
7520.business_summary: Eco's Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of food supermarkets in Japan. Eco's Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Akishima, Japan.

7521.name: MUSASHI CO LTD

The company offers media conversion services to digitalize documents and microfilms; data entry services; and information processing services, including production of microfilm images. It also engages in the consultation and sale of scanners, electronic archive systems, and electronic document systems and other information products, as well as manufacture and sale of thermal enlarger printers and thermal papers; industrial non-destructive inspection systems for buildings and manufactured products; and development and sale of image processing software. 7522.name: WATAMI CO LTD

The company was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7523.name: ART VIVANT CO LTD
7523.market: スタンダード（内国株式）

It also engages in yoga / fitness and finance business. The company provides credit products; and operates resort and fitness club, as well as Amida for lava hot yoga. 7532.name_from_universe: パン・パシフィック・インターナショナルホールディングス
7532.business_summary: Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates retail stores. The company operates discount convenience stores under the Don Quijote, general discount store under the MEGA Don Quijote and MEGA Don Quijote UNY, and Nagasakiya names; and general merchandise stores under the Apita and Piago names. It is also involved in leasing space management; tenant leasing; real estate development; general wholesale; provision of logistic services and internet services; and development and procurement of products and control of production. In addition, the company operates retail stores under the Don Quijote USA, Gelson's, Marukai, Don Don Donki, and Times names, as well as under the private brand names, including JONETZ, Style One, Prime One, and eco!on. The company was formerly known as Don Quijote Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation in February 2019. Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7537.name: MARUBUN CORP
7537.business_summary: Marubun Corporation distributes electronics products in Japan and internationally. The company offers semiconductors and electronic components, including amplifiers, clocks, wired and radio interfaces, isolation products, microcomputer processors, motor drivers, power supplies, RF and microwave, sensors, ASIC/FPGA/PLDs, memories, displays, ASSP, discrete products, protective elements, passive components, connector switches, microcomputers, analog and memory ICs, wireless solutions, circuit protection, and power control components. It also provides software products, such as cloud, enterprise software, embedded software, security, and OS/development tools; measuring equipment, tester monitoring, display/DLP, and others; inspection and analysis equipment, and other products; ICT solutions, including network and storage devices, simulator tester, server, service, security, and others; and assembly and robotics comprising assembly and mounting equipment, industrial robots, service robots, and others. In addition, the company offers laser and optical parts, such as semiconductor laser, LED/light lamp, and others; embedded computer products, including CPU board, embedded system, and others; and other devices comprising IP/license, embedded module, driving simulator, and solar/photovoltaic system. Further, it provides medical devices; and development sourcing, seminars, inspection, and maintenance services. Marubun Corporation was founded in 1844 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7538.name: DAISUI CO LTD
7538.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7538.business_summary: Daisui Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale of marine products in Japan. It also offers fresh and salted fish, and refrigeration warehousing services. The company supplies its products to supermarkets and restaurants. It also exports its products. Daisui Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1939 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

7539.name: AINAVO HOLDINGS CO LTD
7539.name_from_universe: アイナボホールディングス
7539.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7539.business_summary: AINAVO HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. engages in the single-family home and large property businesses in Japan. The company sells tiles and stones, as well as engages in the construction activities. It is also involved in construction of unit baths, system kitchens, water heaters, luxury bathtubs, ceramic tiles, air conditioning, sanitary equipment and facilities, solar power generation systems, and other hosing equipment, as well as interior and exterior tiles, floor tiles, exteriors, and other tile-related products. The company was formerly known as Avelco Co., Ltd. and changed its name to AINAVO HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. in October 2013. AINAVO HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7544.name: THREE F CO LTD
7544.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7544.business_summary: Three F Co.,Ltd. manages and operates convenience, franchise, and managed stores in Japan. The company offers yakitori, lunch boxes, sushi, side dishes, and mochiponyo through its stores. It has store operations in Tokyo, Kanagawa, Chiba, and Saitama. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

7545.name: NISHIMATSUYA CHAIN CO
7545.business_summary: Nishimatsuya Chain Co., Ltd. operates a chain of specialty stores for baby/children's living goods in Japan and Taiwan. The company offers newborn and baby clothes; children's wear; school uniforms; maternity products, nursing clothes, and mom goods; fashion goods, such as socks and legwear, shoes, hat, bags and travel pockets, fashion accessories, rain gear, cold weather accessories, swimming gear, lunch supplies, and other school and kindergarten accessories; and milk, breastfeeding, and meals, disposable diapers and toilets, bathing, laundry and baby care, strollers and baby carriers, child seat, bedding, furniture/indoor supplies, toys, memorial, pools and water activities, and water bottles. It operates various stores. The company was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Himeji, Japan.

7550.name: ZENSHO HOLDINGS CO LTD
7550.name_from_universe: ゼンショーホールディングス
7550.business_summary: Zensho Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the management of food service chain restaurants, and development of sales systems and food processing systems in Japan, the Americas, China, Europe, ASEAN, and internationally. It operates through Global Sukiya, Global Hamasushi, Global Fast Food, Restaurants, Retail, Corporate and Support, and Other segments. The company's restaurants offer gyudon, udon, and hamburger steaks, as well as provides conveyor-belt sushi restaurant, coffee shop, and dining services under the Sukiya, Nakau, Coco's, Big Boy, Victoria Station, Jolly Pasta, EI Torito, Hama-sushi, Hanaya Yohei, Denmaru, Kyubeiya, Seto Udon, Tamon'an, Moriva Coffee, Café Milano, Katsu-An, Olive Hill, and Lotteria brands. It also operates Chicken Rice Shop, as well as sells products under AFC, ZENSHI, SNOWFOX, SNOWFRUIT, Bento, YO!, Taiko, SushiTake, and Sushi Circle brands. In addition, the company operates supermarket chains under United Veggies, Maruya, Yamaguchi Supermarket, Maruei, and Very Foods Owariya brand names; and offers residential and nursing care services for the elderly under Kagayaki, Royalhouse Ishioka, Senior Life Support, NYEREG, and IMedicare brand names. The company was formerly known as Zensho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zensho Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2011. Zensho Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7551.name: WEDS CO LTD
7551.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7551.business_summary: Weds Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the automobile-related wholesale business in Japan. It operates through Automobile Related Sales Business, Logistics Business, Automotive Retail Business, and Welfare segments. The company is involved in the wholesale business, such as after-sales service of automobile parts, automobile wheels, and car accessory parts; manufactures steel wheels; sale of automobile wheel parts; manufacture and sale of high-end aluminum wheels; and logistics business, including storage and loading of wheels and other original products. It also provides warehousing services; wheels and car accessory parts retail business; welfare services for the elderly; and operates as a real estate rental company. The company was formerly known as Nippo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Weds Co., Ltd. in November 1973. Weds Co., Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7552.name: HAPPINET CORP
7552.business_summary: Happinet Corporation operates as an entertainment trading company in Japan. The company manufactures and sells toys, trading cards, playthings, and other toys, as well as audio-visual software; and plans, develops, and sells video and music, and video game software and hardware-related products. It also sells arcade game machines and amusement arcade-related products; and installs and operates toy vending machines and operates capsule toy specialty stores. The company was formerly known as Tosho Corporation and changed its name to Happinet Corporation in October 1991. Happinet Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7554.name: KOURAKUEN CORPORATION
7554.business_summary: Kourakuen Corporation operates a chain of ramen restaurant under the Korakuen name in Japan and internationally. The company was formerly known as Kourakuen Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Kourakuen Corporation in October 2024. Kourakuen Corporation was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Koriyama, Japan.

7555.name: OTA FLORICULTURE AUCTION CO
7555.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7555.business_summary: Ota Floriculture Auction Co.,Ltd. engages in the wholesale floriculture products in Japan. It offers floriculture products, such as cut flowers, potted plants, seedlings, turfs, other matting, and bonsai. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7561.name: HURXLEY CORP
7561.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7561.business_summary: Hurxley Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates Hokka Hokka Tei franchise chain stores in Japan. The company offers boxed lunches. It is also involved in storage and distribution of foodstuffs at franchisees and directly managed stores; rice milling and processing of BG rice; and processing of foodstuff. In addition, the company provides store leasing for restaurant operators; and system development, business, design work, and portal site management services. Further, it engages in the preparation and manufacture of japanese, western, chinese, sushi, and confectionery; provision of catering, and venue coordination and installation services; rental of party tableware and accessories; wholesale of tableware and kitchen equipment, as well as fruit, dry fruit, peanuts, squid dried foods, dried seafood products, salamis, and beef tansmoks; sale of dried fruit and other related products; development and production of cooked foods made mainly from meat; and manufacture and sale of peanuts, nuts, and bean confectioner. The company was formerly known as Kansai Hokka-Hokka Tei Corp. and changed its name to Hurxley Corporation in July 1993. Hurxley Corporation was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

7562.name: ANRAKUTEI CO LTD
7562.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7562.business_summary: Anrakutei Co., Ltd. operates and manages a chain of restaurants in Japan. It is also involved in the consulting activities of restaurant management, sale of raw materials related to restaurants, and operates wholesale business. Anrakutei Co., Ltd. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

7564.name: WORKMAN CO LTD
7564.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7564.business_summary: Workman Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of specialty retail stores in Japan. It offers family clothes, such as underwear, socks, military boots, hats, towels, and aprons; casual wear, including polo shirts, T-shirts, high neck shirts, blousons, and sportswear; working wear comprising work jackets, work trousers, overalls, construction worker clothing, outdoor wear; uniforms, such as white coats, office uniforms, non-woven fabrics, and women's clothing; footwear, including safety shoes, tabi socks, boots, and cloth shoes; and work supplies comprising work gloves, leather gloves, processed gloves, rainwear, helmets, belts, and camping gear through franchise retail stores and online stores. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

7565.name: MANSEI  CORP
7565.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7565.business_summary: Mansei Corporation provides electronic products in Japan. The company offers power control equipment, such as AC servos, inverters, etc.; control equipment, including sequencers, etc.; power distribution equipment comprising breakers, transformers, etc.; and rotary equipment which includes motors, industrial fans, etc. It also provides industrial robots, wire cutting machinery, NC discharge processing machinery, laser processing machinery, and CNC equipment. In addition, the company offers design through installation and follow-up servicing of equipment; semiconductors and device products; system and software development; and electronic product contract manufacturing service, as well as Multimedia and information technology. Mansei Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

7567.name: SAKAE ELECTRONICS CORP
7567.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7567.business_summary: Sakae Electronics Corporation trades in general industrial electronic components in Japan. The company offers switching power supply, connector, semiconductor sockets, printed wiring boards, optical products, sensor, fans and resistors, wirewound resistance, terminal blocks and relay parts, digital signage, fuse, accessories, FA and control equipment, motors, PCs and network equipment. It also provides inventer, led lightening power supply, ac adaptor, trance, heat sink, heat exchanger, noise filter, inlet, coils/inductors, motion control, encoder, solenoid, digital/analog panel meters, printed circuit board, ic socket, camera link connector cable, slip ring rotary connectors, trimmer potentiometer, dial, knob, switch, fire and smoke detectors, peltier heater, room pressure control equipment, speaker, cables, wires, tube, screw springs, rack, solder, adhesive, anti-static, recording and abrasive paper, battery, touch panel, motherboard, switching HUB, HDMI, card slots, memory cards, measuring instrument, remote control, cleaning machine, rom burner, lubricants, pneumatic equipment, temperature regulator, heater, crimping machine and wire processing machine, shelves and storerooms, and other ICT equipment related. Its products are used in semiconductor/FPD manufacturing, measurement/semiconductor inspection, medical/beauty, ship, food/beverage/pharmaceutical inspection, logistics/transportation/packaging, printing, and other industrial equipment, as well as railway broadcasting systems, highway display boards, tunnel construction equipment, etc. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7570.name: HASHIMOTO SOGYO HOLDINGS CO LTD
7570.name_from_universe: 橋本総業ホールディングス
7570.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7570.business_summary: Hashimoto Sogyo Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the processing, manufacture, and sale of plumbing and housing equipment in Japan. The company is involved in the sale, development, management, and maintenance of office computer products and software; worker dispatch business; management consulting business; planning and guidance for obtaining various qualifications; and rental and management of real estate. It also engages in the travel, medical, and sports related businesses. Hashimoto Sogyo Holdings Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Hashimoto Sogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hashimoto Sogyo Holdings Co.,Ltd. in April 2016. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7571.name: YAMANO HOLDING CORPORATION
7571.name_from_universe: ヤマノホールディングス
7571.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7571.business_summary: Yamano Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the retail business in Japan. The company processes and sells Japanese and western clothing; jewelry, precious metal, and watch; fur and leather; and bedding, as well as offers kimono dressing services. It also operates and manages beauty salons and nail salons; cram schools; and photo studios. In addition, the company is involved in the sale of sewing machines, health-related machines and equipment, and lifestyle-related products through door-to-door sales and exhibition sales events; and collection, purchase, and sale of used clothing. It markets its products under various brands through stores. The company was formerly known as Kanemori Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yamano Holdings Corporation in October 2001. Yamano Holdings Corporation was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

7575.name: JAPAN LIFELINE CO
7575.business_summary: Japan Lifeline Co., Ltd., a medical device company, engages in manufacturing and sale of medical device in Japan. The company's cardiac rhythm management products include cardiac pacemakers, implantable cardioverter defibrillators, subcutaneous implantable cardioverter defibrillators, cardiac resynchronization therapy defibrillators and pacemakers, automated external defibrillators, and cardiopulmonary resuscitation support devices; and electrophysiology/ablation products comprise electrophysiological and ablation catheters, irrigated tip ablation catheters, endoscopic balloon ablation systems, esophageal temperature monitoring systems, internal atrial cardioversion systems, disposable ECG recorder, and venous vascular closure system. Its cardiovascular and endografting products consist of vascular and open stent grafts, and abdominal stent-grafts, as well as embolic coil deploying systems. In addition, the company offers gastrointestinal intervention products, including cholangioscope, biliary tube stent, papillary balloon dilatation catheter, self-expandable duodenal and colonic stent, endoscopic guidewire, and radiofrequency ablation systems; structural heart disease intervention products, such as radiofrequency wires and atrial septal defect closure devices; and aspiration catheter neurovascular intervention product. Japan Lifeline Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7578.name: NICHIRYOKU CO LTD
7578.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7578.business_summary: Nichiryoku Co.,Ltd. engages in the funeral and cemetery businesses in Japan. It is involved in the construction, sale, and management of cemeteries; mining, design, manufacture, and sale of stone products and materials; planning and contracting of various rituals; and sale of funeral gifts and Buddhist altars, as well as the management of funeral operations. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7581.name: SAIZERIYA COMPANY
7581.business_summary: Saizeriya Co.,Ltd. operates restaurants in Japan, Australia, Indonesia and Asia. It operates Italian wine and cafe restaurants under the Saizeriya brand name. Saizeriya Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Yoshikawa, Japan.

7585.name: KAN-NANMARU CORPORATION
7585.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7585.business_summary: Kan-Nanmaru Corporation engages in the food and beverage business in Japan. It operates restaurants and bars under various brands, including Taishu Sushi Sakaba, Karaoke Koban-chan, Shoya, Nihon kaishoya, and Jinbee Taro, as well as VANSAN. The company was formerly known as Inshoku Kigyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kan-Nanmaru Corporation in February 1995. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

7590.name: TAKASHO CO LTD
7590.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7590.business_summary: Takasho Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of various garden supplies and materials in Japan, Europe, China, South Korea, the United States, and internationally. It is also involved in the manufacturing and processing of landscaping and exterior materials, natural bamboo, and wood products; sales of landscaping and exterior materials and construction; website planning, production and operation; publishing and sales of magazines and books; space design and sales of gardens and exteriors; manufacture and sale of lighting equipment; and video design and production. Takasho Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Kainan, Japan.

7593.name: VT HOLDINGS CO LTD
7593.business_summary: Vt Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates as an automobile dealer in Japan. It operates through Automobile Sales-Related Business and Housing-Related Business segments. The Automobile Sales-Related Business segment engages in new car dealership business; sells new and used cars; repair of cars; car import; used car export; and car rental business. The Housing-Related Business segment sells condominiums and detached houses, as well as provides construction service and other services. Vt Holdings Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Honda Verno Tokai Co., Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

7595.name: ARGO GRAPHICS
7595.name_from_universe: アルゴグラフィックス
7595.sector17: 情報通信・サービスその他
7595.business_summary: ARGO GRAPHICS Inc. provides technical solutions in Japan. The company provides PLM solutions that simulates the feasibility of all elements relating to product development; HPC solutions to process technical calculations through system design/construction; and virtualization of server/client, server/storage consolidation, and IT infrastructure. It also provides a range of services to support its clients, including consulting for improving operations; system development for process construction; system realization/construction; and training/operational support. In addition, the company offers CAE analysis, analysis tool development, engineering experimentation and measurement, 3D CAD modeling, engineer education, and customer support services; and system development, IT hardware sales and consulting, and IT services. Further, it engages in the develops and sells scientific software, DTP software, system integration solution, quality management software, and document management software, as well as implementation of information sharing system; architecture and sale of the system for scientific computation; computer cluster sale and development support; and sale and support of 2D CAD software and 3D visual environment construction. Additionally, the company is involved in the development and sale of support software for power semiconductor and liquid crystal panel development; PDM software development, sale, and construction support; and provision of development support for IT infrastructure, and manufacturing processes and related services, as well as sales and support services of CAD/CAM software. Furthermore, it engages in the sale and support of electro magnetic software engineering; mechanical designing of powertrain multi-body systems; system programming design and consulting; advanced composite material modeling; and analysis support and consulting activities services. ARGO GRAPHICS Inc. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7596.name: UORIKI CO LTD
7596.business_summary: Uoriki Co., Ltd. engages in the retail, food and beverage, and wholesale businesses in Japan. The company involved in the retail of fresh fish and sushi products; and wholesale of fresh fish and other marine products. It also operates retail, and food and drink stores, as well as restaurants. It serves food supermarkets, local consignors, restaurants, and other domestic and international trading companies. Uoriki Co., Ltd. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Tachikawa, Japan.

7599.name: IDOM INC
7599.business_summary: IDOM Inc. purchases and sells used cars in Japan and internationally. The company also operates new car dealerships in Australia. It operates through a network of approximately 460 stores under the Gulliver brand. The company was formerly known as Gulliver International Co. Ltd. and changed its name to IDOM Inc. in July 2016. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

7600.name: JAPAN MEDICAL DYNAMIC MARKETING
7600.name_from_universe: 日本エム・ディ・エム
7600.business_summary: Japan Medical Dynamic Marketing, INC. develops, manufactures, imports, and sells medical devices in Japan and the United States. The company provides trauma devices, including nails, screws, plates, and other products surgically implanted in the fracture site; joint prostheses, which replaces natural joints and restores functions damaged or lost due to disease or injury; spinal fixation devices to fix spinal instability directly through corrective surgery; and artificial bones that are used to fill gaps in bone defects caused by bone fractures or bone tumors. It offers its products to doctors and hospitals. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

7601.name: POPLAR CO LTD
7601.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7601.business_summary: Poplar Co., Ltd. operates convenience stores in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Smart Store Business and Lawson Poplar Business. The Smart Store Business segments operate under the Popura and Seikatsu Saika brands. The Lawson Poplar Business segment operates under the Lawson Poplar and Lawson brands. It operates a chain of approximately 277 stores. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

7602.name: LEDAX CO LTD
7602.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7602.business_summary: Ledax Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the purchase, sale, and distribution of automobiles in Japan, Asia, Oceania, Africa, and internationally. It operates through Automobile distribution business, and Leaseback-related business segments. The company engages in the purchase and sale of used cars through its retail stores; sale of various property and casualty insurance products comprising car insurance; wholesale and distribution of spare parts and accessories of automobiles through online shop; management of automobile aftermarket parts of online distribution; and export of used cars through internet site, PicknBuy24.com. It also offers management consulting, M&A advisory, outsourcing, and investment services. The company was formerly known as Carchs Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ledax Co.,Ltd. in September 2024. Ledax Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

7603.name: GYET CO LTD
7603.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7603.business_summary: Gyet Co., Ltd. operates chain stores for retailing clothing and other products in Japan. The company offers men's tops, such as outerwear, shirts, cut and sew, knitted for men; jeans, trousers, easy pants, and shorts for men; outerwear, shirts, cut-and-sew, knitted for women; jeans, trousers, shorts, and skirts for women; outerwear, shirts, cut and sew, knits, jeans, shorts, skirts for kids; and inner legs; clothing and miscellaneous goods, such as bags, belts, and hats. It also operates online stores. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7604.name: UMENOHANA GROUP CO LTD
7604.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7604.business_summary: Umenohana Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the restaurant business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Restaurant, Takeout, and Outside Sale. The company offers processed marine products, such as oyster products; Furuichian rolled sushi, inari sushi, oshizushi, assorted sushi, omusubi, steamed rice, etc.; take-out bento, Japanese side dishes, new year dishes, tofu and other processed soybean products, and frozen side dishes; and gift items, as well as perishables. It also provides Yuba and Tofu Shop Ume no Hana, Japanese nabedokoro sushihan hot pot dishes, sushi, rice bowls, set meals, drinks, take-out lunch boxes, seafood izakaya sakura suisan fish dishes, grilled chicken, a la carte dishes, drinks, and other food and drink products. It offers its products under the Ume-no-Hana and Furuichian brand names. The company was formerly known as UMENOHANA Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Umenohana Group Co.,Ltd. in May 2025. Umenohana Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1979 and is based in Kurume, Japan.

7606.name: UNITED ARROWS LTD
7606.name_from_universe: ユナイテッドアローズ
7606.business_summary: United Arrows Ltd. engages in the planning, buying, and sale of men's and women's apparel, accessories, and other products in Japan. The company operates under store brands, such as UNITED ARROWS, BEAUTY&YOUTH UNITED ARROWS, UNITED ARROWS green label relaxing, DRAWER, ASTRAET, UNITED ARROWS & SONS, 6, steven alan, monkey time, ODETTE E ODILE, ATTISESSION, CITEN, NICE WEATHER, California General Store, UNITED ARROWS Golf, and OSOI brands. It also offers products under LOEFF, Pheeta, AEWEN MATOPH, SOVEREIGN, EMMEL REFINES, PREEK, MARW, SY, TO, Lepidos, TABAYA, UNITED ARROWS BEAUTY, koti BEAUTY&YOUTH, and District UNITED ARROWS labels, as well as UNITED ARROWS outlets. United Arrows Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7607.name: SHINWA CO LTD (WHOLESALE)
7607.business_summary: Shinwa Co., Ltd. manufactures, sells, and maintains production equipment and materials in Japan and internationally. It also offers metal joining products, such as welding and brazing materials, and chemical products; factory automation systems; industrial machinery; joining equipment; and overlay welding, vacuum brazing, field network systems, jig design and production, coating equipment, and metrology products. In addition, the company provides maintenance, re-conditioning, and upgrading of machinery and equipment for welding techniques, as well as trading, engineering, and logistics services. It serves electrical machinery, precision equipment, electronics, petrochemicals, papermaking, rubber, resin, steel, communications equipment, aerospace, and automotive industries. The company was formerly known as Shinwa Trading Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shinwa Co., Ltd. in April 1973. Shinwa Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

7608.name: SK JAPAN CO LTD
7608.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7608.business_summary: SK Japan Co.,Ltd. plans, manufactures, and sells character stuffed toys, key chains, household goods, mobile phone accessories, sarees, electronic toys, etc in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments, Furniture Business and Customer Business. The company also sales capsule toy products to retailers. The company sells its products under HereDitail, Kigyurumi, PETTATTO OSUWARI, Mini this, Mosutomufu, and Tamashii Craft brands. It serves its products to amusement facilities. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7609.name: DAITRON CO LTD
7609.business_summary: Daitron Co., Ltd., an electronic engineering trading company, engages in electronic equipment and components, and manufacturing equipment businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures, sells, imports, and exports electronic components and assembly goods, semiconductors, embedded systems, power supply equipment, image-related equipment and components, information systems, FPD manufacturing equipment, electronic components manufacturing equipment, etc. It provides connector harnesses; optical and image processing devices; factory automation PCs for equipment control and other IT equipment; RFID, IC, and biometric identification devices; teleconferencing video system; and other electronic components. In addition, the company provides manufacturing equipment for electronic materials and devices; OPT devices; flat panel display; high-performance film; secondary battery; transportation and automation; and environment and accessory. The company was formerly known as Daito Electron Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Daitron Co., Ltd. in 2017. Daitron Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1952 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

7610.name: TAY TWO CO LTD
7610.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7610.business_summary: Tay Two Co., Ltd. operates stores that offer books, home video games, trading cards, hobbies, smartphones, CDs, DVDs, clothing, etc. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

7611.name: HIDAY HIDAKA CORP
7611.business_summary: Hiday Hidaka Corp. engages in the restaurant business in Japan. The company operates restaurants under the Hiday Hidaka, Hidakaya, and Raraiken names. The company was formerly known as Hidaka Commercial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hiday Hidaka Corp. in June 1998. Hiday Hidaka Corp. was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Saitama, Japan.

7613.name: SIIX CORP
7613.business_summary: SIIX Corporation primarily sells and distributes electronic components in Japan, China, the rest of Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The company offers automotive electronic components, such as automotive exteriors, meters, ECU, switches, quasi-millimeter wave radars, ABS, cameras, battery sensors, car multimedia, etc., as well as industrial equipment, such as engine ignition devices for power tools, battery packs, aircraft-borne electronic devices, inverters, medical devices, smart meters, industrial sewing machines, etc. It also provides home appliances, such as digital appliances, air conditioners, refrigerators, educational toys, healthcare equipment, electronic musical instruments, etc.; information devices, including office equipment, OA equipment, projectors, etc.; and automobile wire harness, motorcycles, inks, and other electronic components, etc. In addition, the company is involved in plastic molding and die manufacturing, and circuit board mounting, as well as provision of materials procurement, assembly, and processing of devices and components; and logistics services. SIIX Corporation was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

7614.name: OM2 NETWORK CO LTD
7614.name_from_universe: オーエムツーネットワーク
7614.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7614.business_summary: OM2 Network Co.,Ltd. retails meat and prepared food products in Japan. The company is involved in the meat processing activities; meat product retail; food products retail; as well as offers private label products, such as sauce, hotpot soup, and other products. It operates meat stores; various restaurants; and Japan operations management and operation guidance and store development. OM2 Network Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7615.name: KYOTO KIMONO YUZEN HOLDINGS CO
7615.name_from_universe: 京都きもの友禅ホールディングス
7615.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7615.business_summary: KYOTO KIMONO YUZEN HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of kimono and related jewelry products in Japan. The company is also involved in rental photo studio business. It sells its products through stores and online stores. The company was formerly known as YU-WA Creation Holdings Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to KYOTO KIMONO YUZEN HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in July 2024. KYOTO KIMONO YUZEN HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Chuo, Japan.

7616.name: COLOWIDE CO LTD
7616.business_summary: Colowide Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in restaurant management in Japan and internationally. It also engages in purchasing and selling various foodstuffs and processing sales, as well as tobacco and alcoholic beverages. The company also manufactures and sells confectioneries, baked goods, and chocolates, as well as sauce for commercial and consumer use; sells and distributes liquors and other related beverages; sells cigarettes and liquors; and provides catering services. In addition, it is involved in the operation and maintenance of IT systems, call center services; and procurement and logistics management related to catering service business. Further, the company operates the Wolfgang Puck restaurant; and Izakaya, Japanese, and Italian Cuisine. The company operates its restaurants under the Doma Doma, Kamadoka, Gyu-Kaku, Shabu Shabu On-Yasai, Tonkatsu Kagurazaka SAKURA, FRESHNESS BURGER, Steak MIYA, KARUBI TAISHO, GANKO-EN & GANKO-TEI, NIGIRI-NO-TOKUBE, KATSUDOKI, CHIISANA MORI COFFEE, OOTOYA, NAGISA BASHI CAFÉ, CANTINA, and M.M MARKET & CAFÉ. It operates various direct management and franchise stores. Colowide Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

7619.name: TANAKA CO LTD
7619.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7619.business_summary: Tanaka Co.,Ltd. engages in the wholesale of electrical materials and appliances in Japan. The company offers fluorescent lighting fixtures, incandescent lighting fixtures, hid fixtures, explosion-proof fixtures, ventilation fans, duct fans, and led fixtures; and high-voltage and low-voltage power cables, communication cables, insulated power distribution cables, synthetic rubber electric wires, steel conduits, polyvinyl chloride conduits, flexible synthetic resin conduits, and various accessories. It also provides high-voltage power receiving equipment, power distribution boards, distribution boards, control equipment, wiring devices, electrical circuit equipment, communication equipment, disaster prevention equipment, and acoustic equipment; home appliances, housing equipment, office equipment, and solar power generation equipment; and concrete pillars, steel pipe poles, overhead wiring materials, measuring equipment, power tools, and security equipment. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7621.name: UKAI CO LTD
7621.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7621.business_summary: Ukai Co.,Ltd. engages in the operation of restaurants and museums in Japan. It operates in three segments: Entertainment Division, Merchandise Division, and Cultural Division. The company operates Japanese and western food restaurants, as well as operates art museum exhibitions. It also manufactures and sells confectionery and food products. Ukai Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Hachioji, Japan.

7624.name: NAITO & CO LTD
7624.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7624.business_summary: Naito & Co., Ltd., a trading company, engages in sale of cutting tools, mechanical tools, industrial equipment, machine tools, and other products in Japan and internationally. The company's cutting tools include carbide tools, special steel tools, abrasives, and diamond tools; and measurement equipment comprise 3D measuring machines, shape measuring devices, optical measurement devices, torque machines, various test equipment, foreign object detectors, and others, as well as vernier calipers, micrometers, dial gauges, and gauges. Its industrial devices consist of tooling products, complementary tools, pneumatic equipment, hydraulic equipment, environmental equipment, and working tools; and machine tools comprise lathes, milling machines, machining centers, grinding machines, electric discharge machines, robots, and CAD/CAM systems. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7625.name: GLOBAL-DINING INC
7625.name_from_universe: グローバルダイニング
7625.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7625.business_summary: Global-Dining, Inc. engages in operating coffee shops and restaurant business in Japan and the United States. It operates restaurants under the Cafe La Boheme, Zest Cantina, Monsoon Cafe, Gonpachi, Tableaux, Legato, Stellato, LIGNIS, Taco Fanatico, Lignis, Food Coliseum, Paradise Village, Hotel Paradiso, DEcadence du Chocolat, Wedding and Saloon, and Bartizan brands. The company was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

7628.name: OHASHI TECHNICA
7628.business_summary: Ohashi Technica Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells automotive parts and other components in Japan, the United States, China, Thailand, ASEAN, Europe, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers automotive parts comprising engine and mission, differential, brake, body and chasse, and interior/exterior components; and information technology (IT) and communications device parts, including mobile phone hinges and other parts. It also provides precision oil pump shafts used in dual clutch transmission; and piezo injector components for diesel engines. In addition, the company plans, develops, produces, and markets precision components assembled to various products in automobile and other industries, as well as engages in procurement, export, and logistics businesses. It serves auto and auto part unit equipment manufacturers. The company was formerly known as Ohashi Shoji, Inc. and changed its name to Ohashi Technica Inc. in May 1987. Ohashi Technica Inc. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

7630.name: ICHIBANYA CO LTD
7630.business_summary: Ichibanya Co., Ltd. operates and franchises curry specialty stores in Japan and internationally. The company operates directly managed and franchised restaurants under the CURRY HOUSE CoCo ICHIBANYA and Pasta de CoCo brands. It also provides store management guidance; and leases its trademarks to food manufacturers. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Ichinomiya, Japan. Ichibanya Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of House Foods Group Inc.

7634.name: HOSHIIRYO-SANKI CO LTD
7634.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7634.business_summary: Hoshi Iryo-Sanki Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pharmaceutical medical oxygen and nitrous oxides in Japan. It operates through the five segments: Medical Gas Related Business; Home Medical Care Related Business; Medical Gas Equipment Construction Related Business; Nursing Care and Welfare Related Business; and Nursing Care Facility-Related Business. The Medical Gas Related Business segment sells medical oxygen gas, anesthetic gas, and other medical gases. The Home Medical Care Related Business segment rents and sells oxygen concentrators for home oxygen therapy, and continuous positive airway and sales. The Medical Gas Equipment Construction Related Business segment designs and constructs medical gas piping works, as well as maintains and inspects medical gas piping equipment. The Nursing Care and Welfare Related Business segment offers rental and sale of care and welfare-related products and equipment, home renovation, visiting nursing, and home care support services. The Nursing Care Facility-Related Business segment operates the paid nursing homes and day care facilities, and other related operations. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7636.name: HANDSMAN CO LTD
7636.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7636.business_summary: Handsman Co., Ltd. operates DIY home centers under the Handsman name in Japan. The company offers household, car, and other leisure goods. The company provides hobby and wood products, building and stone materials, hand and power tools, hardware, paints, adhesives, gardening and exterior supplies, chemical fertilizers, soil, plants, household goods, daily necessities, interior and storage goods, electrical materials, housing equipment, seasonal items, car and pet supplies, outdoor goods, and stationery products. The company offers its products through online. The company was formerly known as Ozono Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Handsman Co., Ltd. in 1995. Handsman Co., Ltd. was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Miyakonojo, Japan.

7637.name: HAKUDO CO LTD
7637.business_summary: Hakudo Co., Ltd. processes and sells metal and plastic materials in Japan, China, Thailand, and Vietnam. It offers aluminum tubes, copper, and stainless-steel plates, and bars; and elongated copper products, as well as special steel, titanium, and engineering plastics. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7638.name: NEW ART HOLDINGS CO LTD
7638.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7638.business_summary: NEW ART HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. operates bridal jewelry business in Japan. The company offers bridal and fashion jewelry; artworks; and planning and operation of art auctions. It operates esthetic salons; manufactures and sales cosmetics and health food products; food processing; resort development; art dealer; and develops and sells sporting goods. In addition, the company offers engagement rings and marriage rings under the Ginza Diamond Shiraishi and Excelco Diamond brands. The company was formerly known as New Art Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NEW ART HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in October 2018. NEW ART HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7640.name: TOP CULTURE CO LTD
7640.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7640.business_summary: TOP CULTURE Co.,Ltd. operates retail stores in Japan. It sells and rents books, stationery, music, video software, and other goods. The company also engages in the buying and selling of used books, music and video software, game consoles, and game software, as well as offers battle spaces. In addition, it manages and operates soccer clubs and schools; plans and operates sports facilities; and operates a brain and mind-visiting nursing station for mental illness and dementia, as well as coworking spaces and cafe. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.

7643.name: DAIICHI CO LTD
7643.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7643.business_summary: Daiichi Co.,Ltd. operates supermarkets for foodstuffs in Japan. It is also involved in the rental of real estate properties. The company was formerly known as first Super Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Daiichi Co.,Ltd. in November 1991. Daiichi Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Obihiro, Japan.

7646.name: PLANT CO LTD
7646.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7646.business_summary: PLANT Co.,Ltd. engages in the retail of food and non-food products through community-based stores in Japan. The company offers food items, such as chicken and pork products, bakery products, rice balls, side dishes, burgers, hors d'oeuvres, and fresh juices, as well as clothing and housing products. It sells its products online. PLANT Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

7649.name: SUGI HOLDINGS CO.LTD.
7649.name_from_universe: スギホールディングス
7649.business_summary: Sugi Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates drugstores in Japan. The company also provides self-care support services, including meal delivery, cancer and other health checkups, specific health guidance, health information, and community comprehensive agreements; health care support, such as medicine support, home-visit dispensing and nursing, prevention programs, shopping assistance, and mobility support services. In addition, it engages in drugstore operation, dispensing pharmacy operation, medical consultation, business in foreign countries, Chinese medicine pharmacy operations, disease prevention and health support, promotion of disabled employment, home visit nursing and elderly home-care support, support for commencement of medical practice, comprehensive staff agency service, and support business for pharmacy operations. Sugi Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Obu, Japan.

7670.name: O-WELL CORPORATION
7670.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7670.business_summary: O-Well Corporation engages in coating and electronics related business in Japan. The company offers paint and coating materials, coating equipment, pollution control equipment, special equipment, painting/coating devices/tools, metallic surface treatment agents, and measuring devices. It also provides tapes, adhesives, plastic moldings, plastic foamed products, ceramic products, mats, heat-resistant materials, protective films, functional films, decoration films, anti-scattering films, marking films, filters, honeycomb cores, antibacterial agents, antimold agents, rustproof oils, waterproof materials, sealants, lining materials, polishing materials, grinding materials, flaw detection materials, damping materials, soundproof materials, reflectors, antistatic products, fluorinated high-performance liquids, inactive liquids, antistatic agents, surfactants, inks, chemicals, cleaners, building materials, raw materials, optical parts, and other electrical and electronic materials. In addition, the company offers semiconductor-related products, such as hall ICs, microcontrollers, and motor drivers; RFID-related readers and sensor tags; distance, temperature, humidity, pressure, CO2, capacitance, and infrared sensors; electrical and electronic mechanical components; and other products. Further, it provides contracting and design/supervision of various incidental construction work. The company was formerly known as Ohmiya Kogyo Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to O-Well Corporation in 1992. O-Well Corporation was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

7673.name: DAIKO TSUSAN CO LTD
7673.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7673.business_summary: Daiko Tsusan Co.,Ltd. operates as a trading company in the fields of CATV and information and telecommunications in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in manufacturing, selling, leasing, and rental of information communication cables, materials, equipment and accessories, tools and measuring equipment; and office automation equipment and software. It also offers Cable television, information and communications consulting, as well as undertakes design and construction, and maintenance works. Daiko Tsusan Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Matsuyama, Japan.

7674.name: NATTY SWANKY HOLDINGS CO LTD
7674.name_from_universe: ＮＡＴＴＹ　ＳＷＡＮＫＹホールディングス
7674.business_summary: NATTY SWANKY holdings Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manages restaurant in Japan. It operates restaurant under the Dandadan Meat Juicy Gyoza name. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

7677.name: YASHIMA & CO LTD
7677.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7677.business_summary: Yashima & Co.,Ltd. engages in the sale, maintenance, and import/export of railway related products and electronic parts for industrial machines in Japan and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Railway Business and General Business. It offers tachometer generators, connectors, optical harness, sensors, door switches, terminal boards, power supply devices, polycarbonate window units, compressors for air conditioning, brake parts, wheelsets, wipers, flooring materials, and other electrical and mechanical parts and maintenance equipment. The company sells its products to railway operators, railway vehicle manufacturers, manufacturers of electrical components for railway vehicles and body equipment, industrial equipment manufacturers, electric power equipment manufacturers, automotive manufacturers, and commercial equipment mail order business operators. Yashima & Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7678.name: ASAKUMA CO LTD
7678.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7678.business_summary: Asakuma Co.,Ltd engages in the restaurant management and franchise businesses in Japan. It operates restaurants under the Steak no Asakuma name; Motsuyaki Izakaya under the Ebisu San name; Indonesian-style Izakaya under the Wayang Bali name; and Indonesian restaurant under the Surabaya name. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Nisshin, Japan. Asakuma Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Tempos Holdings Co., Ltd.

7679.name: YAKUODO HLDGS CO LTD
7679.name_from_universe: 薬王堂ホールディングス
7679.business_summary: YAKUODO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in drugstore business in Japan. It retails health products, including energy drinks, cold medicine, disposable diapers for nursing care, and sanitary products; beauty products comprising skincare, cosmetics, and hair and oral care products; home products, such as detergents and household paper; and food products that include frozen food, beer, and chuhai. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Morioka, Japan.

7680.name: KEIJIDOUSHAKAN CO LTD
7680.business_summary: KEIJIDOUSHAKAN.Co.,Ltd. engages in buying and selling new/used cars in Japan. It also sells auto parts, as well as provides automobile maintenance and insurance agency services. KEIJIDOUSHAKAN.Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

7681.name: LEOCLAN CO LTD
7681.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7681.business_summary: LEOCLAN Co.,Ltd. operates as a medical equipment trading company that meets various medical care, welfare, and health needs. It operates through three segments: Medical Total Solutions Business, Remote Image Diagnosis Service Business, and School Lunch Business. The Medical Total Solutions Business segment provides incidental maintenance services; and interior decoration construction and installation works for medical institutions, preventive/health checkup facilities, nursing care and welfare facilities, etc. based on consulting services, such as selection of medical equipment, as well as sells medical equipment and medical information systems. The Remote Image Diagnosis Service Business segment offers services in which diagnostic radiology specialists remotely diagnose image data taken by MRI, CT, etc., and provides information. The School Lunch Business segment provides school lunch services, including regular meals, medical meals, and other meals to nursing care and welfare facilities. LEOCLAN Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Settsu, Japan.

7682.name: HAMAYUU CO LTD
7682.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7682.business_summary: Hamayuu Co.,Ltd. operates and manages Chinese cuisine restaurants under the Hamamomen, Shiki-tei, Torikei, and Chugoku Shokudo Hamayu brands in Japan. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

7683.name: WA INC
7683.business_summary: WA, Inc. engages in the product planning and development, inspection and quality control, and sale of women's shoes and women's clothing through stores and online stores in Japan. It offers its products under the ORiental Traffic, WA ORiental Traffic, ORTR, KIDS, and MISCH MASCH brands. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

7685.name: BUYSELL TECHNOLOGIES CO LTD
7685.business_summary: BuySell Technologies Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the reuse business for kimonos and branded items in Japan. The company purchases and sells art and antiques, Chinese yuan, kimonos, precious metals, bags, jewelry, watches, alcohol, cameras, and short-term baby and children's items through its EC sites, stores, sales events, and B2B auctions. It also engages in the reuse franchise business; and the recycling of branded goods and precious metals. BuySell Technologies Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

7686.name: HITOMILE CO LTD
7686.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7686.business_summary: HitoMile Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in wholesale business of alcoholic beverages and other foodstuffs in Japan. The company provides investment management, transportation services, home delivery services; and delivers dairy products. It also offers flowers through a select shop. The company was formerly known as Kakuyasu Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to HitoMile Co., Ltd. in July 2025. The company was founded in 1921 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

7687.name: MICREED CO LTD
7687.business_summary: MICREED Co.,Ltd. engages in the mail-order sale of commercial food ingredients to small and medium restaurants in Japan. It offers meat, fish, vegetables, skewers, fried food, and desserts. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

7689.name: COPA CORP INC
7689.name_from_universe: コパ・コーポレーション
7689.business_summary: Copa Corporation Inc. engages in the product demonstration sale and wholesale business in Japan. The company offers interior and bedding, kitchen supplies and cooking utensils, clean, and beauty and health products. It is also involved in TV shopping appearances and product wholesale business; mail order via the internet; demonstration sales school opening and personnel dispatch business; and sales consulting and promotional material production activities. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

7691.name: C CHANNEL CORPORATION
7691.business_summary: C Channel Corporation owns and operates an online lifestyle video outlet that provides information about fashion, food, hair, makeup, and travel. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

7692.name: EARTH INFINITY CO LTD
7692.name_from_universe: アースインフィニティ
7692.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7692.business_summary: Earth Infinity Co.Ltd. engages in the electricity and gas retail businesses in Japan. The company is also involved in the manufacture, sale, installation, and wholesale of electronic equipment, such as inverters and breakers, as well as sale of storage batteries and solar panels. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

7694.name: ITSUMO INC
7694.business_summary: itsumo.inc. provides direct-to-consumer and e-commerce marketing services to brand manufacturers primarily in Japan. The company offers consulting, attracting customers, operation agency, logistics/backyard, strategy planning, site construction/operation, digital marketing, and fulfillment, as well as overseas sale services for e-commerce business. It also provides multi-channel development on brand EC sites; M&A and growth support for D2C and EC brands; EC human resource development; and SNS and EC promotion planning and operation. The company's customers include national manufacturers, small and medium-sized companies, and local governments; and various industries, such as cosmetics, food, home appliances, interior good, apparel, and babies products. itsumo.inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

7695.name: KOUKANDEKIRUKUN INC
7695.business_summary: Koukandekirukun, Inc. engages in the sale of housing equipment online. The company operates through Housing DX Business and Solutions Business segments. It offers built-in gas stoves, dishwashers, range hoods, IH cooking heaters, faucets, and taps, cupboards, toilets, washbasins and vanities, bathroom dryers, water heaters, ceiling-mounted air conditioners, wall-mounted air conditioners, disposers, warm water washing toilet seats, ventilation fans, and built-in ovens. The company also provides replacement, installation, and after-sales support services. In addition, it provides IT systems, including requirements definition, operation, and maintenance. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

7698.name: ICECO INC
7698.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7698.business_summary: Iceco Inc. engages in the wholesale of ice creams and frozen foods. The company sells ice creams and frozen foods for commercial use in retail stores, such as drugstores and food supermarkets. It also operates stores and supermarkets focusing on fresh products, including fruits and vegetables, fresh fish, and meat under the Super Seisenkan TAIGA name. Iceco Inc. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

7699.name: OMNI-PLUS SYSTEM LTD
7699.name_from_universe: オムニ・プラス・システム・リミテッド　ＪＤＲ
7699.business_summary: Omni-Plus System Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of commodity and engineering plastics in Southeast Asia, rest of Asia, the Americas, and internationally. It also offers generic and specialty engineering plastics materials; and resin compounds, as well as engineering plastics for housings and built-in parts in their products, including household electrical appliances, electronic devices, office automation equipment, automobiles, communication-related equipment, and medical equipment. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Singapore.

7701.name: SHIMADZU CORP
7701.business_summary: Shimadzu Corporation provides equipment solutions in Japan and Internationally. It operates through Measuring Instruments, Medical Equipment, Industrial Equipment, and Aircraft Equipment business segments. The company offers analytical and measuring instruments which includes gas and liquid chromatography, gas and liquid chromatograph-mass spectrometry, software and informatics, molecular spectroscopy, elemental analysis, surface analysis, life science lab instrument, material testing, non-destructive testing, total organic carbon analysis, continuous monitoring analysis, thermal analysis, particle size analysis, and balance products, as well as MALDI-based instruments and solutions, columns, reagents, and consumables products. It also provides medical systems comprising angiography, fluoroscopy, mobile C-arm, radiography, mobile X-ray systems, PET, and fluorescence imaging products; optical devices which consist of diffraction gratings, aspherical mirrors, laser mirrors and windows for high power lasers, polka-dot beam splitters, laser spectrum analyzers, and precision refractometers. In addition, the company offers vacuum and industrial machinery, including turbo molecular pumps, helium leak detectors, multi deposition system, vacuum heat-treatment furnaces, liquid delivery equipment gear pumps, mechatronic systems glass fiber winders, ferromagnetic object detector, underwater optical wireless communication, liquid crystal injection system, and dynamic balancing machines. Further, the company provides hydraulic equipment, such as hydraulic gear pumps, power packages, and multi control valves; and aircraft equipment, including electro-mechanical actuators, flight control systems, and landing gear systems. It serves in Spectroscopic Analysis, Optical Communication, Laser, Medical, and Food industries. Shimadzu Corporation was founded in 1875 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

7702.name: JMS CO LTD
7702.market: スタンダード（内国株式）
7702.business_summary: JMS Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture, sale, export, and import of medical devices and pharmaceuticals in Japan, North America, Europe, China, South Korea, Thailand, and internationally. It offers infusion and nutrition solutions, which includes needless access port, closed drug mixing and infusion system, infusion pump, and oral and enteral nutrition system for treatment and laboratory testing; and dialysis solutions including dialysis equipment for hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis solution, and APD equipment that automatically performs the injection and discharge of peritoneal dialysis solution. It also provides surgical treatment solution comprising products that are used in cardiac surgery and cardiovascular internal medicine, such as membrane oxygenator and cardiopulmonary blood tubing sets. In addition, the company offers blood management and cell therapy solutions, which includes serum collection sets and blood bags. Further, it provides logistics and other equipment; and offers maintenance works and sanatorium services. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

7707.name: PRECISION SYSTEM SCIENCE CO
7707.name_from_universe: プレシジョン・システム・サイエンス
